4.84.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca
dvijadevārcanaṃ caiva karoti satataṃ gṛhī .
svadharmācaraṇaṃ caiva cāturvarṇyaṃ ca nityaṇaḥ .. 1 ..
4.84.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
द्विजदेवार्चनं चैव करोति सततं गृही ।
स्वधर्माचरणं चैव चातुर्वर्ण्यं च नित्यणः ॥ 1 ॥
4.84.m: Now begins the eighty-fourth chapter. / The Blessed Lord said: / A householder constantly performs the worship of twice-borns and gods, / and constantly follows his own duty and the system of four classes. // 1

4.84.s:
kurvanti gṛhiṇāmāśāṃ sarve devādayastathā .
akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhasthaśca sadā'śuciḥ .. 2 ..
4.84.d:
कुर्वन्ति गृहिणामाशां सर्वे देवादयस्तथा ।
अकृत्वाऽतिथिपूजां च गृहस्थश्च सदाऽशुचिः ॥ 2 ॥
4.84.m: All beings, beginning with the gods, place their expectations on householders. / Without performing the worship of a guest, a householder is always impure. // 2

4.84.s:
pitaraḥ karmakāle cātithikāle ca devatāḥ .
sarve gṛhasthamāyānti nipānamiva dhenavaḥ .. 3 ..
4.84.d:
पितरः कर्मकाले चातिथिकाले च देवताः ।
सर्वे गृहस्थमायान्ति निपानमिव धेनवः ॥ 3 ॥
4.84.m: The ancestors arrive at the time of ancestral rites, and the deities at the time of a guest; / they all come to the householder like cows to a watering-trough. // 3

4.84.s:
samāyāti prayatnena sayāhne kṣudhito'tithiḥ .
pūjāṃ labdhvā''śiṣaṃ kṛtvā prayāti gṛhiṇo gṛhāt .. 4 ..
4.84.d:
समायाति प्रयत्नेन सयाह्ने क्षुधितोऽतिथिः ।
पूजां लब्ध्वा'ऽशिषं कृत्वा प्रयाति गृहिणो गृहात् ॥ 4 ॥
4.84.m: A hungry guest comes with effort in the evening; / receiving worship and giving a blessing, he departs from the householder's house. // 4

4.84.s:
akṛtvā'tithipūjāṃ ca gṛhī bhavati pātakī .
trailokyajanitaṃ pāpaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 5 ..
4.84.d:
अकृत्वाऽतिथिपूजां च गृही भवति पातकी ।
त्रैलोक्यजनितं पापं लभते नात्र संशयः ॥ 5 ॥
4.84.m: Without performing the worship of a guest, a householder becomes a sinner; / he incurs the sin born of the three worlds—of this there is no doubt. // 5

4.84.s:
atithiryasya bhagnāśo gṛhātpratinirvate .
pitarastasya devāśca vahnayaśca tathaiva ca .. 6 ..
4.84.d:
अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात्प्रतिनिर्वते ।
पितरस्तस्य देवाश्च वह्नयश्च तथैव च ॥ 6 ॥
4.84.m: He from whose house a guest turns away with hopes shattered— / his ancestors, the gods, and the sacrificial fires likewise, // 6

4.84.s:
nirāśāḥ pratigacchanti gṛhiṇo'tithayo gṛhāt .
strīdhnairgoghnaiḥ kṛtaghnaiśca brāhmaṇairgurutalpagaiḥ .. 7 ..
4.84.d:
निराशाः प्रतिगच्छन्ति गृहिणोऽतिथयो गृहात् ।
स्त्रीध्नैर्गोघ्नैः कृतघ्नैश्च ब्राह्मणैर्गुरुतल्पगैः ॥ 7 ॥
4.84.m: along with the guests, depart disappointed from that householder's house. / Equal in guilt to the killers of women, the killers of cows, the ungrateful, // 7

4.84.s:
tulyadoṣo bhavatyeva yenātithiranarcitaḥ .
svātmanaḥ pātakaṃ dattvā puṇyamādāya gacchati .. 8 ..
4.84.d:
तुल्यदोषो भवत्येव येनातिथिरनर्चितः ।
स्वात्मनः पातकं दत्त्वा पुण्यमादाय गच्छति ॥ 8 ॥
4.84.m: and Brahmins who violate their guru’s bed, is the one by whom a guest is left unworshipped. / Leaving his own sin behind, [the guest] departs taking away [the host's] merit. // 8

4.84.s:
tasmātkṛtvā sarvasevāṃ devādīṃśca śubhāśayaḥ .
poṣyāṇāṃ bharaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścādbhuṅkte sa dharmavit .. 9 ..
4.84.d:
तस्मात्कृत्वा सर्वसेवां देवादींश्च शुभाशयः ।
पोष्याणां भरणं कृत्वा पश्चाद्भुङ्क्ते स धर्मवित् ॥ 9 ॥
4.84.m: Therefore, having rendered all service to the deities and others with an auspicious mind, / and having maintained those who are to be supported, he who knows righteousness eats afterward. // 9

4.84.s:
yasya mātā gṛhe nāsti bhāryā ca puṃścalī tathā .
araṇyaṃ tena gantavyamaraṇyādduḥkhadaṃ gṛham .. 10 ..
4.84.d:
यस्य माता गृहे नास्ति भार्या च पुंश्चली तथा ।
अरण्यं तेन गन्तव्यमरण्याद्दुःखदं गृहम् ॥ 10 ॥
4.84.m: He who has no mother in the house, and whose wife is unchaste, / should go to the forest; a home is more sorrowful than the forest. // 10

4.84.s:
patīṃ dveṣṭi sadā duṣṭā viṣatunyaṃ ca paśyati .
dadāti tasmai nā''hāraṃ bhartsanaṃ kurute sadā .. 11 ..
4.84.d:
पतीं द्वेष्टि सदा दुष्टा विषतुन्यं च पश्यति ।
ददाति तस्मै ना'ऽहारं भर्त्सनं कुरुते सदा ॥ 11 ॥
4.84.m: The wicked woman constantly hates her husband and regards him like poison; / she gives him no food and constantly reproaches him. // 11

4.84.s:
pūjitaṃ munitulyaṃ ca sā ca pāpīyasī param .
saṃtataṃ tṛṇavanmatvā nyakkāraṃ kurute sadā .. 12 ..
4.84.d:
पूजितं मुनितुल्यं च सा च पापीयसी परम् ।
संततं तृणवन्मत्वा न्यक्कारं कुरुते सदा ॥ 12 ॥
4.84.m: Though he is revered and equal to a sage, that extremely sinful woman / constantly regards him like a blade of grass and always treats him with contempt. // 12

4.84.s:
durvākyāvahninā dagdho mṛtatulyaśca jīvati .
yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ saṃprāpya duṣṭavaṃśajām .. 13 ..
4.84.d:
दुर्वाक्यावह्निना दग्धो मृततुल्यश्च जीवति ।
यावज्जीवनपर्यन्तं संप्राप्य दुष्टवंशजाम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.84.m: Scorched by the fire of harsh words, he lives like a dead man / for the duration of his life, having married a woman born of a wicked family. // 13

4.84.s:
gṛhiṇīnāṃ sadācāraṃ śrūyatāṃ tacchru tau śrutam .
gṛhiṇī patibhaktā ca devabrāhmaṇabūjitā .. 14 ..
4.84.d:
गृहिणीनां सदाचारं श्रूयतां तच्छ्रु तौ श्रुतम् ।
गृहिणी पतिभक्ता च देवब्राह्मणबूजिता ॥ 14 ॥
4.84.m: Hear the righteous conduct of housewives, as it is heard in the scriptures: / the housewife who is devoted to her husband is worshipped by gods and Brahmins. // 14

4.84.s:
sā śuddhā prātarutthāya namaskṛtya patiṃ suram .
prāṅgaṇe maṅgalaṃ dadyādgomayena jalena ca .. 15 ..
4.84.d:
सा शुद्धा प्रातरुत्थाय नमस्कृत्य पतिं सुरम् ।
प्राङ्गणे मङ्गलं दद्याद्गोमयेन जलेन च ॥ 15 ॥
4.84.m: Pure, having risen early in the morning and bowed to her husband as to a god, / she should apply auspicious markings in the courtyard with cow dung and water. // 15

4.84.s:
gṛhakṛtyaṃ ca kṛtvā ca snātvā''gatya gṛhaṃ satī .
suraṃ vipraṃ patiṃ natvā pūjayedgṛhadevatām .. 16 ..
4.84.d:
गृहकृत्यं च कृत्वा च स्नात्वा'ऽगत्य गृहं सती ।
सुरं विप्रं पतिं नत्वा पूजयेद्गृहदेवताम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.84.m: And having performed household duties, bathed, and returned home, the chaste wife, / having bowed to the god, the Brahmin, and her husband, should worship the household deity. // 16

4.84.s:
gṛhakṛtyaṃ sunirvṛtya bhojayitvā patiṃ satī .
atithiṃ pūjayitvā ca svayaṃ bhuṅkate sukhaṃsatī .. 17 ..
4.84.d:
गृहकृत्यं सुनिर्वृत्य भोजयित्वा पतिं सती ।
अतिथिं पूजयित्वा च स्वयं भुङ्कते सुखंसती ॥ 17 ॥
4.84.m: Having properly accomplished household chores and fed her husband, the chaste wife, / having worshipped the guest, happily eats herself. // 17

4.84.s:
putraiśca pūjitastātaḥ śiṣyaiśca pūjito guruḥ .
ājñayā kurute karma putraḥ śiṣyaśca bhṛtyavat .. 18 ..
4.84.d:
पुत्रैश्च पूजितस्तातः शिष्यैश्च पूजितो गुरुः ।
आज्ञया कुरुते कर्म पुत्रः शिष्यश्च भृत्यवत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.84.m: A father is worshipped by his sons, and a guru is worshipped by his disciples; / by command, the son and the disciple do work like a servant. // 18

4.84.s:
na prerayedguruṃ tātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyaśca karmasu .
pitre ca gurave nityaṃ sarvasvaṃ ca samarpayet .. 19 ..
4.84.d:
न प्रेरयेद्गुरुं तातं पुत्रः शिष्यश्च कर्मसु ।
पित्रे च गुरवे नित्यं सर्वस्वं च समर्पयेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.84.m: A son and a disciple should not command a guru or a father in tasks; / one should always surrender everything to one's father and guru. // 19

4.84.s:
na kuryānnarabuddhiṃ ca gurau pitari saṃtatam .
kṛtvā ca narabuddhiṃ ca brahmahatyāṃ labheddhruvam .. 20 ..
4.84.d:
न कुर्यान्नरबुद्धिं च गुरौ पितरि संततम् ।
कृत्वा च नरबुद्धिं च ब्रह्महत्यां लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 20 ॥
4.84.m: One should never hold the view that a guru or a father is a mere human; / holding the view that they are mere humans, one certainly incurs the sin of killing a Brahmin. // 20

4.84.s:
mātaraṃ pūjayedbhaktyā pituścāpyadhikāṃ tathā .
mātuḥ paraṃ guruṃ caiva pūjayedbhaktiyogataḥ .. 21 ..
4.84.d:
मातरं पूजयेद्भक्त्या पितुश्चाप्यधिकां तथा ।
मातुः परं गुरुं चैव पूजयेद्भक्तियोगतः ॥ 21 ॥
4.84.m: One should worship the mother with devotion, even more than the father; / and through the practice of devotion, one should worship the guru who is higher than the mother. // 21

4.84.s:
pitā mātā gururbhāryā śiṣyaḥ putraḥ sadā'kṣamaḥ .
anāthā bhaginī kanyā nityaṃ poṣyā gurupriyā .. 22 ..
4.84.d:
पिता माता गुरुर्भार्या शिष्यः पुत्रः सदाऽक्षमः ।
अनाथा भगिनी कन्या नित्यं पोष्या गुरुप्रिया ॥ 22 ॥
4.84.m: Father, mother, guru, wife, disciple, a son who is ever incapable, / a helpless sister, an unmarried daughter, and the beloved of the guru are always to be supported. // 22

4.84.s:
evaṃ ca kathitaṃ tāta sarveṣāṃ dharmamuttamam .
śtrījātirvāstapīśuddhā tāśca sarvāḥ pativratāḥ .. 23 ..
4.84.d:
एवं च कथितं तात सर्वेषां धर्ममुत्तमम् ।
श्त्रीजातिर्वास्तपीशुद्धा ताश्च सर्वाः पतिव्रताः ॥ 23 ॥
4.84.m: Thus, O father, has the supreme duty of all been declared. / Womanhood is inherently pure, and all of them are devoted wives; // 23

4.84.s:
sarvā jātirekavidhā cā''dau sṛṣṭā ca brahmaṇā .
tāḥ sarvāḥ prakṛteraṃśāḥ pavitrāḥ paṇḍitādhikāḥ .. 24 ..
4.84.d:
सर्वा जातिरेकविधा चा'ऽदौ सृष्टा च ब्रह्मणा ।
ताः सर्वाः प्रकृतेरंशाः पवित्राः पण्डिताधिकाः ॥ 24 ॥
4.84.m: all womankind was created of a single kind in the beginning by Brahmā. / They are all portions of Prakṛti, pure, and superior even to scholars. // 24

4.84.s:
kedārakanyāśāpena sa hi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ .
tadā kopena dhātrā ca kṛtyā strī ca vinirmitā .. 25 ..
4.84.d:
केदारकन्याशापेन स हि धर्मः क्षयं गतः ।
तदा कोपेन धात्रा च कृत्या स्त्री च विनिर्मिता ॥ 25 ॥
4.84.m: By the curse of Kedāra's daughter, that righteousness perished. / Then, out of anger, the Creator fashioned woman as an evil spirit.

4.84.s:
kṛtyā strī trividhā jātirbrahmaṇā nirmitā purā .
uttamā prathamā sā ca madhyamā cādhamā vraja .. 26 ..
4.84.d:
कृत्या स्त्री त्रिविधा जातिर्ब्रह्मणा निर्मिता पुरा ।
उत्तमा प्रथमा सा च मध्यमा चाधमा व्रज ॥ 26 ॥
4.84.m: Woman was created by Brahmā in ancient times as an evil spirit of three types: / the highest was the first, the middling, and the lowest, O Vraja.

4.84.s:
uttamā patibhaktā sā kiṃciddharmasamanvitā .
prāṇānte'pi na kurute taṃ jāramayaśakaram .. 27 ..
4.84.d:
उत्तमा पतिभक्ता सा किंचिद्धर्मसमन्विता ।
प्राणान्तेऽपि न कुरुते तं जारमयशकरम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.84.m: The highest is devoted to her husband, endowed with some virtue; / even at the risk of her life, she does not take a lover, who brings disgrace.

4.84.s:
pūjayetsā yathā kāntaṃ tathā devadvijātithīn .
vratāni copavāsāṃśca kurute sarvapūjanam .. 28 ..
4.84.d:
पूजयेत्सा यथा कान्तं तथा देवद्विजातिथीन् ।
व्रतानि चोपवासांश्च कुरुते सर्वपूजनम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.84.m: As she honours her husband, so she honours gods, twice-born men, and guests; / she performs observances, fasts, and the worship of all.

4.84.s:
guruṇā rakṣitā yatnājjāraṃ ca na bhajedbhayāt .
sa kṛtrimā madhyamā ca yathākiṃcitpatiṃ bhajet .. 29 ..
4.84.d:
गुरुणा रक्षिता यत्नाज्जारं च न भजेद्भयात् ।
स कृत्रिमा मध्यमा च यथाकिंचित्पतिं भजेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.84.m: Guarded diligently by elders, she does not take a paramour out of fear; / she is the middling, artificial [type], serving her husband only moderately.

4.84.s:
sthānaṃ nāstikṣaṇaṃ nāsti nāsti prārthayitā naraḥ .
tena he nanda tāsāṃ ca satītvamupajāyate .. 30 ..
4.84.d:
स्थानं नास्तिक्षणं नास्ति नास्ति प्रार्थयिता नरः ।
तेन हे नन्द तासां च सतीत्वमुपजायते ॥ 30 ॥
4.84.m: There is no place, no opportunity, and no man entreating her; / therefore, O Nanda, chastity arises in such women.

4.84.s:
adhamā paramā duṣṭā'tyantāsadvaṃśajā tathā .
adharmaśīlā duḥśīlā durmukhā kalahānvitā .. 31 ..
4.84.d:
अधमा परमा दुष्टाऽत्यन्तासद्वंशजा तथा ।
अधर्मशीला दुःशीला दुर्मुखा कलहान्विता ॥ 31 ॥
4.84.m: The lowest is exceedingly wicked, born of a most base family, / inclined to unrighteousness, ill-behaved, foul-mouthed, and quarrelsome.

4.84.s:
patiṃ bhartsayate nityaṃ jāraṃ ca sevate sadā .
duḥśaṃ dadāti kāntāya viṣatulyaṃ ca paśyati .. 32 ..
4.84.d:
पतिं भर्त्सयते नित्यं जारं च सेवते सदा ।
दुःशं ददाति कान्ताय विषतुल्यं च पश्यति ॥ 32 ॥
4.84.m: She always reviles her husband and constantly attends to a paramour; / she causes misery to her spouse and views him as poison.

4.84.s:
jāradvāramupāyena hanti kāntaṃ manoharam .
dharmiṣṭhaṃ ca variṣṭhaṃ ca gariṣṭhaṃ ca mahītale .. 33 ..
4.84.d:
जारद्वारमुपायेन हन्ति कान्तं मनोहरम् ।
धर्मिष्ठं च वरिष्ठं च गरिष्ठं च महीतले ॥ 33 ॥
4.84.m: Through a stratagem involving her paramour, she kills her charming husband, / even if he is most righteous, eminent, and revered on earth.

4.84.s:
kāmadevasamaṃ cāpi jāraṃ paśyati kāmataḥ .
śubhadṛṣṭyā kaṭākṣeṇa śaravatpāpīyasī mudā .. 34 ..
4.84.d:
कामदेवसमं चापि जारं पश्यति कामतः ।
शुभदृष्ट्या कटाक्षेण शरवत्पापीयसी मुदा ॥ 34 ॥
4.84.m: Out of lust, the sinful woman gazes upon a paramour like the god of love, / joyfully shooting glances like arrows with an auspicious look.

4.84.s:
suveṣaṃ puruṣaṃ draṣṭvā yuvānaṃ ratiśūkaram .
yoniḥ klidyati nārīṇāṃ kāminīnāṃ nirantaram .. 35 ..
4.84.d:
सुवेषं पुरुषं द्रष्ट्वा युवानं रतिशूकरम् ।
योनिः क्लिद्यति नारीणां कामिनीनां निरन्तरम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.84.m: Upon seeing a well-dressed youth skilled in love-making, / the vulva of lustful women continually moistens.

4.84.s:
dadāti bhartre nā''hāraṃ viṣoktiṃ vakti saṃtatam .
adharmaṃ cintayecchaśvajjāraṃ ca paramaṃ mudā .. 36 ..
4.84.d:
ददाति भर्त्रे ना'ऽहारं विषोक्तिं वक्ति संततम् ।
अधर्मं चिन्तयेच्छश्वज्जारं च परमं मुदा ॥ 36 ॥
4.84.m: She does not give food to her husband and constantly speaks venomous words; / she incessantly contemplates unrighteousness and rejoices greatly in a paramour.

4.84.s:
gurubhirbhartsitā sā ca rakṣitā ca śatena ca .
tathā'pi jāraṃ kurute nāpi sādhyā nṛperapi .. 37 ..
4.84.d:
गुरुभिर्भर्त्सिता सा च रक्षिता च शतेन च ।
तथाऽपि जारं कुरुते नापि साध्या नृपेरपि ॥ 37 ॥
4.84.m: Though scolded by her elders and guarded by a hundred [men], / still she takes a paramour; she cannot be restrained even by kings.

4.84.s:
nāsti tasyāḥ priyaṃ kiṃcitsarvaṃ kāryavaśena ca .
gāvastṛṇamivāraṇye prārthayantī navaṃ navam .. 38 ..
4.84.d:
नास्ति तस्याः प्रियं किंचित्सर्वं कार्यवशेन च ।
गावस्तृणमिवारण्ये प्रार्थयन्ती नवं नवम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.84.m: Nothing is dear to her, and everything she does is out of self-interest; / like cattle in a forest seeking grass, she craves someone new and fresh.

4.84.s:
vidyudābhā jale rekhā tasyā prītistathaiva ca .
adharmayuktā satataṃ kapaṭaṃ vakti niścitam .. 39 ..
4.84.d:
विद्युदाभा जले रेखा तस्या प्रीतिस्तथैव च ।
अधर्मयुक्ता सततं कपटं वक्ति निश्चितम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.84.m: Her affection is like the flash of lightning, like a line drawn on water; / constantly joined to unrighteousness, she speaks nothing but deceit.

4.84.s:
vrate tapasi dharme ca na mano gṛhakarmaṇi .
na gurau na ca deveṣu jāre snigdhaṃ ca cañcalam .. 40 ..
4.84.d:
व्रते तपसि धर्मे च न मनो गृहकर्मणि ।
न गुरौ न च देवेषु जारे स्निग्धं च चञ्चलम् ॥ 40 ॥
4.84.m: Her mind is not on vow, asceticism, virtue, or household duties, / nor on her elder, nor on the gods; she is tender and unsteady only toward a lover.

4.84.s:
strījātitrividhānāṃ ca kathā ca kathitā mayā .
bhaktānāṃ trividhānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ śrūyatāmiti .. 41 ..
4.84.d:
स्त्रीजातित्रिविधानां च कथा च कथिता मया ।
भक्तानां त्रिविधानां च लक्षणं श्रूयतामिति ॥ 41 ॥
4.84.m: Thus the account of the three types of women has been told by me; / now hear the characteristics of the three types of devotees.

4.84.s:
tṛṇaśayyārato bhakto mannāmaguṇakīrtiṣu .
mano niveśayettyaktvā saṃsārasukhakāraṇam .. 42 ..
4.84.d:
तृणशय्यारतो भक्तो मन्नामगुणकीर्तिषु ।
मनो निवेशयेत्त्यक्त्वा संसारसुखकारणम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.84.m: A devotee resting on a bed of grass fixes his mind / upon praising my names and virtues, casting aside the cause of worldly pleasure.

4.84.s:
vyāyate matpadābjaṃ ca pūjayedbhaktibhāvataḥ .
ahaitukīṃ tasya devāḥ saṃkalparahitasya ca .. 43 ..
4.84.d:
व्यायते मत्पदाब्जं च पूजयेद्भक्तिभावतः ।
अहैतुकीं तस्य देवाः संकल्परहितस्य च ॥ 43 ॥
4.84.m: He meditates on my lotus feet and worships out of devotion; / for him who is free from selfish desires, [his devotion] is motiveless, O gods.

4.84.s:
sarvasiddhiṃna vāñchanti te'ṇimādikamīpsitam .
brahmatvamamaratvaṃ vā suratvaṃ sukhakāraṇam .. 44 ..
4.84.d:
सर्वसिद्धिंन वाञ्छन्ति तेऽणिमादिकमीप्सितम् ।
ब्रह्मत्वममरत्वं वा सुरत्वं सुखकारणम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.84.m: Such devotees do not desire all the [supernatural] powers, the coveted [siddhis] such as becoming microscopic, / nor the status of Brahmā, nor immortality, nor divine status, which cause pleasure.

4.84.s:
dāsyaṃ vinā nahīcchanti sālokyādicatuṣṭayam .
naiva nirvāṇamuktiṃ ca sudhāpānamabhīpsitam .. 45 ..
4.84.d:
दास्यं विना नहीच्छन्ति सालोक्यादिचतुष्टयम् ।
नैव निर्वाणमुक्तिं च सुधापानमभीप्सितम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.84.m: Except for service, they desire neither the four forms of liberation beginning with dwelling in my realm, / nor liberation as extinction, nor the coveted drinking of nectar.

4.84.s:
vāñchanti niścilāṃ bhaktiṃ madīyāmatulāmapi .
strīpuṃvibhedo nāstyeva sarvajīveṣu bhinnatā .. 46 ..
4.84.d:
वाञ्छन्ति निश्चिलां भक्तिं मदीयामतुलामपि ।
स्त्रीपुंविभेदो नास्त्येव सर्वजीवेषु भिन्नता ॥ 46 ॥
4.84.m: They desire only unwavering, peerless devotion to me; / for them there is no distinction of female and male, nor any difference among all living beings.

4.84.s:
teṣāṃ siddheśvarāṇāṃ ca pravarāṇāṃ vrajeśvara .
kṣutpipāsādikaṃ nidrālobhamohādikaṃ ripum .. 47 ..
4.84.d:
तेषां सिद्धेश्वराणां च प्रवराणां व्रजेश्वर ।
क्षुत्पिपासादिकं निद्रालोभमोहादिकं रिपुम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.84.m: For those foremost lords of perfected beings, O lord of Vraja, / hunger, thirst, sleep, greed, delusion, and other enemies [are renounced].

4.84.s:
tpaktvā divāniśaṃ māṃ ca dhyāyante ca digambarāḥ .
samadbhaktottamo nanda śrūyatāṃ madhyamādikam .. 48 ..
4.84.d:
त्पक्त्वा दिवानिशं मां च ध्यायन्ते च दिगम्बराः ।
समद्भक्तोत्तमो नन्द श्रूयतां मध्यमादिकम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.84.m: Having cast these aside, unclothed, they meditate upon me day and night; / such is my highest devotee, O Nanda; now hear of the middling and others.

4.84.s:
nā''saktaḥ karmasu gṛhī pūrvaprāktanataḥ śuciḥ .
karoti satataṃ caiva pūrvakarmanikṛntanam .. 49 ..
4.84.d:
ना'ऽसक्तः कर्मसु गृही पूर्वप्राक्तनतः शुचिः ।
करोति सततं चैव पूर्वकर्मनिकृन्तनम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.84.m: The householder, unattached to actions, purified by past deeds, / continually cuts away the effects of previous actions.

4.84.s:
na karotyaparaṃ vatnātsaṃkalparahitaḥ sa ca .
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇasya yatkiṃcinnāhaṃ kartā ca karmaṇaḥ .. 50 ..
4.84.d:
न करोत्यपरं वत्नात्संकल्परहितः स च ।
सर्वं कृष्णस्य यत्किंचिन्नाहं कर्ता च कर्मणः ॥ 50 ॥
4.84.m: Without undertaking other actions, free from selfish resolve, / [he thinks:] 'Whatever exists belongs to Kṛṣṇa; I am not the agent of action.'

4.84.s:
karmaṇā manasā vācā satataṃ cintayediti .
nyūnabhaktaśca tannyūnaḥ sa ca prākṛtikaḥ śrutau .. 51 ..
4.84.d:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा सततं चिन्तयेदिति ।
न्यूनभक्तश्च तन्न्यूनः स च प्राकृतिकः श्रुतौ ॥ 51 ॥
4.84.m: In deed, mind, and speech he contemplates this constantly; / the lower devotee is inferior to him, considered an ordinary devotee in the scriptures.

4.84.s:
yamaṃ vā yamadūtaṃ vā svapne'pi na ca paśyati .
puruṣāṇāṃ sahasraṃ ca pūrvabhaktaḥ suddharet .. 52 ..
4.84.d:
यमं वा यमदूतं वा स्वप्नेऽपि न च पश्यति ।
पुरुषाणां सहस्रं च पूर्वभक्तः सुद्धरेत् ॥ 52 ॥
4.84.m: He does not see Yama or the messengers of Yama even in a dream; / the first [highest] devotee delivers a thousand men [of his lineage].

4.84.s:
puṃsāṃ śataṃ madhyamaśca taccaturthaṃ ca prākṛtaḥ .
bhaktaśca trividhastāta kathitaśca tavā''jñayā .. 53 ..
4.84.d:
पुंसां शतं मध्यमश्च तच्चतुर्थं च प्राकृतः ।
भक्तश्च त्रिविधस्तात कथितश्च तवा'ऽज्ञया ॥ 53 ॥
4.84.m: The middling delivers a hundred men, and the ordinary [delivers] a quarter of that; / thus the threefold devotee, O father, has been described at your command.

4.84.s:
brahmāṇḍaracanākhyānaṃ śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ .
brahmāṇḍaracanārthaṃ ca bhaktā jānanti yatnataḥ .. 54 ..
4.84.d:
ब्रह्माण्डरचनाख्यानं श्रूयतां सावधानतः ।
ब्रह्माण्डरचनार्थं च भक्ता जानन्ति यत्नतः ॥ 54 ॥
4.84.m: Listen attentively to the account of the creation of the cosmic egg; / devotees diligently understand the meaning of the creation of the cosmic egg.

4.84.s:
munayaśca surāḥ santaḥ kiṃcijjānanti duḥkhataḥ .
jānāmi viśvaṃ sarvārtha brahmā''nanto ..
maheśvaraḥ .. 55 ..
4.84.d:
मुनयश्च सुराः सन्तः किंचिज्जानन्ति दुःखतः ।
जानामि विश्वं सर्वार्थ ब्रह्मा'ऽनन्तो ॥
महेश्वरः ॥ 55 ॥
4.84.m: Sages, gods, and good men know only a little with difficulty; / I know the whole truth of the universe, and so do Brahmā, Ananta,

4.84.s:
dharmaḥ sanatkumāraśca naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī .
kapilaśca gaṇeśaśca durgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī .. 56 ..
4.84.d:
धर्मः सनत्कुमारश्च नरनारायणावृषी ।
कपिलश्च गणेशश्च दुर्गा लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती ॥ 56 ॥
4.84.m: Dharma, Sanatkumāra, the sages Nara and Nārāyaṇa, / Kapila, Gaṇeśa, Durgā, Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī,

4.84.s:
vedāśca vedamātā ca sarvajñā rādhikā svayam .
ete jānanti viśvārtha nānyo jānāti kaścana .. 57 ..
4.84.d:
वेदाश्च वेदमाता च सर्वज्ञा राधिका स्वयम् ।
एते जानन्ति विश्वार्थ नान्यो जानाति कश्चन ॥ 57 ॥
4.84.m: the Vedas, the Mother of the Vedas, and the omniscient Rādhikā herself; / these know the truth of the universe, and no one else knows.

4.84.s:
vaiṣamyārtha ca sudhiyaḥ sarve vijñātumakṣamāḥ .
nityākāśo yathā''tmā ca tathā nityā diśo daśa .. 58 ..
4.84.d:
वैषम्यार्थ च सुधियः सर्वे विज्ञातुमक्षमाः ।
नित्याकाशो यथा'ऽत्मा च तथा नित्या दिशो दश ॥ 58 ॥
4.84.m: Even wise men are unable to know its diversity; / just as space is eternal and the self is eternal, so the ten directions are eternal.

4.84.s:
yathā nityā ca prakṛtistathaiva viśvagolakaḥ .
golokaśca yathā nityastathā vaikuṇṭha eva ca .. 59 ..
4.84.d:
यथा नित्या च प्रकृतिस्तथैव विश्वगोलकः ।
गोलोकश्च यथा नित्यस्तथा वैकुण्ठ एव च ॥ 59 ॥
4.84.m: Just as Prakṛti is eternal, so is the sphere of the universe; / and just as Goloka is eternal, so is Vaikuṇṭha.

4.84.s:
ekadā mayi goloke rāse nityaṃ prakurvati .
āvirbhūtā ca vāmāṅgādbālā ṣoḍhaśavārṣikī .. 60 ..
4.84.d:
एकदा मयि गोलोके रासे नित्यं प्रकुर्वति ।
आविर्भूता च वामाङ्गाद्बाला षोढशवार्षिकी ॥ 60 ॥
4.84.m: Once, while I was continually performing the rāsa in Goloka, / a maiden of sixteen years manifested from my left side,

4.84.s:
śvetacampakavarṇābhā śaraccandrasamaprabhā .
atīva sundarī rāmā ramaṇīnāṃ parāvarā .. 61 ..
4.84.d:
श्वेतचम्पकवर्णाभा शरच्चन्द्रसमप्रभा ।
अतीव सुन्दरी रामा रमणीनां परावरा ॥ 61 ॥
4.84.m: having the colour and lustre of a white campaka, radiant like the autumn moon, / an exceedingly beautiful woman, the foremost of damsels,

4.84.s:
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyā kaumalāṅgī manoharā .
vahniśuddhāṃśukādhānā ratnābharaṇabhūṣitā .. 62 ..
4.84.d:
ईषद्धास्यप्रसन्नास्या कौमलाङ्गी मनोहरा ।
वह्निशुद्धांशुकाधाना रत्नाभरणभूषिता ॥ 62 ॥
4.84.m: with a smiling, bright face, tender-limbed, enchanting, / wearing fire-purified garments and adorned with jewel ornaments,

4.84.s:
yathā jaladapaṅktiśca balākābhirtibhūṣitā .
sindūrabindūnā cārucandracandanabindubhiḥ .. 63 ..
4.84.d:
यथा जलदपङ्क्तिश्च बलाकाभिर्तिभूषिता ।
सिन्दूरबिन्दूना चारुचन्द्रचन्दनबिन्दुभिः ॥ 63 ॥
4.84.m: just like a row of clouds adorned with cranes; / with a mark of vermilion and lovely dots of moon-like sandalwood,

4.84.s:
kastūrībindubhiḥ sārdhaṃ sīmantāndhaḥsyalojjvalā .
amūlyaratnanirmāṇasusnigdhakiraṇojjvalā .. 64 ..
4.84.d:
कस्तूरीबिन्दुभिः सार्धं सीमन्तान्धःस्यलोज्ज्वला ।
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणसुस्निग्धकिरणोज्ज्वला ॥ 64 ॥
4.84.m: along with dots of musk, shining below the parting of her hair, / radiant with the very lustrous rays of priceless jewels,

4.84.s:
vicitraiśca sucitraiśca sukapolasthalojjvalā .
khamendracañcuvijitanāsāmauktikaśobhitā .. 66 ..
4.84.d:
विचित्रैश्च सुचित्रैश्च सुकपोलस्थलोज्ज्वला ।
खमेन्द्रचञ्चुविजितनासामौक्तिकशोभिता ॥ 66 ॥
4.84.m: shining with colourful, lovely paintings on her beautiful cheeks, / adorned with a nose-pearl that surpassed the beak of the king of birds.

4.84.s:
gajendragaṇa़ḍanirmuktamuktābhūṣaṇabhūṣitā .
śuktyā vimuktamuktābhadantapaṅktimanoharā .. 67 ..
4.84.d:
गजेन्द्रगण़डनिर्मुक्तमुक्ताभूषणभूषिता ।
शुक्त्या विमुक्तमुक्ताभदन्तपङ्क्तिमनोहरा ॥ 67 ॥
4.84.m: adorned with pearl ornaments produced from the temples of lordly elephants, / charming with rows of teeth resembling pearls released from oyster-shells,

4.84.s:
valitākalitā'tīva pakvabimbādharā varā .
śaśvatpūrṇendunindāsyā padmaninditalocanā .. 68 ..
4.84.d:
वलिताकलिताऽतीव पक्वबिम्बाधरा वरा ।
शश्वत्पूर्णेन्दुनिन्दास्या पद्मनिन्दितलोचना ॥ 68 ॥
4.84.m: most curved and shapely, excellent with ripe bimba-fruit lips, / her face constantly mocking the full moon, her eyes deriding lotuses,

4.84.s:
kṛṣṇasāranibhodbhinnasucārukajjalojjvalā .
amūlyaratnanirmāṇakeyūrakaṅkaṇojjvalā .. 69 ..
4.84.d:
कृष्णसारनिभोद्भिन्नसुचारुकज्जलोज्ज्वला ।
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणकेयूरकङ्कणोज्ज्वला ॥ 69 ॥
4.84.m: radiant with beautiful lampblack resembling a black antelope, / glittering with armlets and bangles made of priceless gems,

4.84.s:
maṇīndrarājarājībhiḥ śaṅkhayugmakarojjavalā .
ratnāṅgulīyakairebhiramṛtāṅgulibhūṣitā .. 70 ..
4.84.d:
मणीन्द्रराजराजीभिः शङ्खयुग्मकरोज्जवला ।
रत्नाङ्गुलीयकैरेभिरमृताङ्गुलिभूषिता ॥ 70 ॥
4.84.m: shining with a pair of conch bracelets together with rows of the finest jewels, / her nectar-like fingers adorned with these jewelled rings,

4.84.s:
ratnendrarājarājena kvaṇanmañjīrarañjitā .
ratnapāśakarājībhiḥ pādāṅgulivirājitā .. 71 ..
4.84.d:
रत्नेन्द्रराजराजेन क्वणन्मञ्जीररञ्जिता ।
रत्नपाशकराजीभिः पादाङ्गुलिविराजिता ॥ 71 ॥
4.84.m: delightful with tinkling anklets set with rows of kingly jewels, / her toes resplendent with rows of jewelled toe-rings,

4.84.s:
sundarālaktarāgeṇa caraṇādhaḥsthalojjvalā .
gajendragāminī rāmā kāminī vāmalocanā .. 72 ..
4.84.d:
सुन्दरालक्तरागेण चरणाधःस्थलोज्ज्वला ।
गजेन्द्रगामिनी रामा कामिनी वामलोचना ॥ 72 ॥
4.84.m: the soles of her feet bright with the hue of lovely red lac, / moving like a majestic elephant, lovely, passionate, with enchanting eyes,

4.84.s:
māṃ dadarśa kaṭākṣeṇa ramaṇī ramaṇotsukā .
rāse saṃbhūya rāmā sā dadhāra purato mama .. 73 ..
4.84.d:
मां ददर्श कटाक्षेण रमणी रमणोत्सुका ।
रासे संभूय रामा सा दधार पुरतो मम ॥ 73 ॥
4.84.m: the delightful woman, longing for amorous pleasure, looked at me with a side-glance; / manifesting in the rāsa dance, that beautiful lady stood before me.

4.84.s:
tena rādhā samākhyātā burāvidbhiḥ prapūjitā .
prahṛṣṭā prakṛtiścāsyāstena prakṛtirīśvarī .. 74 ..
4.84.d:
तेन राधा समाख्याता बुराविद्भिः प्रपूजिता ।
प्रहृष्टा प्रकृतिश्चास्यास्तेन प्रकृतिरीश्वरी ॥ 74 ॥
4.84.m: Therefore she was called Rādhā, worshipped by the knowers of the past; / and her nature (prakṛti) was full of delight, hence she is the Sovereign Lady Prakṛti.

4.84.s:
śaktā syātsarvakāryeṣu tena śaktiḥ prakīrtitā .
sarvādhārā sarvarūpā maṅgalārhā ca sarvataḥ .. 75 ..
4.84.d:
शक्ता स्यात्सर्वकार्येषु तेन शक्तिः प्रकीर्तिता ।
सर्वाधारा सर्वरूपा मङ्गलार्हा च सर्वतः ॥ 75 ॥
4.84.m: She is capable (śaktā) in all matters, hence she is proclaimed as the Śakti; / she is the support of all, possessing all forms, worthy of auspiciousness in every respect;

4.84.s:
sarvamaṅgaladakṣā sā tena syātsarvamaṅgalā .
vaikuṇṭhe sā mahālakṣmīrmūrtibhede sarasvatī .. 76 ..
4.84.d:
सर्वमङ्गलदक्षा सा तेन स्यात्सर्वमङ्गला ।
वैकुण्ठे सा महालक्ष्मीर्मूर्तिभेदे सरस्वती ॥ 76 ॥
4.84.m: she is adept in granting all auspiciousness, hence she is Sarvamaṅgalā; / in Vaikuṇṭha she is Mahālakṣmī, and by difference of forms she is Sarasvatī.

4.84.s:
prasūya vedānviditā vedamātā ca sā sadā .
sāvitrī sa ca gāyatrī dhātrī trijagatāmapi .. 77 ..
4.84.d:
प्रसूय वेदान्विदिता वेदमाता च सा सदा ।
सावित्री स च गायत्री धात्री त्रिजगतामपि ॥ 77 ॥
4.84.m: Having given birth to the Vedas she is known as the eternal Mother of the Vedas; / she is Sāvitrī, she is Gāyatrī, and the sustainer even of the three worlds.

4.84.s:
purā saṃhṛtya durgaṃ ca sā durgā ca prakīrtitā .
tejasaḥ sarvadevānāmāvirbhūtā purā satī .. 78 ..
4.84.d:
पुरा संहृत्य दुर्गं च सा दुर्गा च प्रकीर्तिता ।
तेजसः सर्वदेवानामाविर्भूता पुरा सती ॥ 78 ॥
4.84.m: Having destroyed the demon Durge in ancient times, she is celebrated as Durgā; / having manifested in ancient times from the splendour of all the gods, the virtuous woman

4.84.s:
tenā''dyā prakṛtirjñeyā sarvāsuravimarditī .
sarvānandā ca sānandā duḥkhadāridrayanāśinī .. 79 ..
4.84.d:
तेना'ऽद्या प्रकृतिर्ज्ञेया सर्वासुरविमर्दिती ।
सर्वानन्दा च सानन्दा दुःखदारिद्रयनाशिनी ॥ 79 ॥
4.84.m: is therefore known as the Primordial Prakṛti, the crusher of all asuras; / she is all-blissful, full of joy, the destroyer of sorrow and poverty,

4.84.s:
śatruṇāṃ bhayadātrau ca bhaktānāṃ bhayahāriṇau .
dakṣakanyā satī kā ca śailajāteti pārvatī .. 80 ..
4.84.d:
शत्रुणां भयदात्रौ च भक्तानां भयहारिणौ ।
दक्षकन्या सती का च शैलजातेति पार्वती ॥ 80 ॥
4.84.m: the giver of fear to enemies and the remover of fear for devotees; / she became Satī, the daughter of Dakṣa, and born from the mountain, she is Pārvatī.

4.84.s:
sarvādhārasvarūpā sā kalayā sā vasuṃdharā .
kalayā tulasī gaṅgā kalayā sarvayoṣitaḥ .. 81 ..
4.84.d:
सर्वाधारस्वरूपा सा कलया सा वसुंधरा ।
कलया तुलसी गङ्गा कलया सर्वयोषितः ॥ 81 ॥
4.84.m: She is the very essence of the universal support; as a part she is the Earth; / as a part she is Tulasī and Gaṅgā; as a part she is all women.

4.84.s:
sṛṣṭiṃ karomi ca yayā tāta śaktyā punaḥ punaḥ .
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ rāsamadhyasthāṃ mama krīḍā ..
tayā saha .. 82 ..
4.84.d:
सृष्टिं करोमि च यया तात शक्त्या पुनः पुनः ।
दृष्ट्वा तां रासमध्यस्थां मम क्रीडा ॥
तया सह ॥ 82 ॥
4.84.m: O dear father, by that Śakti I perform creation again and again; / having seen her standing in the midst of the rāsa circle, my amorous play

4.84.s:
babhūva suciraṃ tāta yāvadvai brahmaṇaḥ śatam .
atyadbhutaṃ kautukaṃ ca mahāśrṛṅgāramīpsitam .. 83 ..
4.84.d:
बभूव सुचिरं तात यावद्वै ब्रह्मणः शतम् ।
अत्यद्भुतं कौतुकं च महाश्रृङ्गारमीप्सितम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.84.m: O dear father, lasted a very long time, as long as a hundred [years] of Brahmā: / an exceedingly wondrous sport, an intense and desired lovemaking.

4.84.s:
tayordvayordharmarāśiḥ susrāva rāsamaṇa़ḍale .
tasmānmanoharaṃ jajñe nāmanākārasarovaram .. 84 ..
4.84.d:
तयोर्द्वयोर्धर्मराशिः सुस्राव रासमण़डले ।
तस्मान्मनोहरं जज्ञे नामनाकारसरोवरम् ॥ 84 ॥
4.84.m: From the two of them a mass of sweat flowed into the rāsa circle; / from that arose a charming lake named Ākāra.

4.84.s:
papāta dharmadhārā'dho vegena viśvagolake .
babhūva jalabūrṇaṃ ca brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca golakam .. 85 ..
4.84.d:
पपात धर्मधाराऽधो वेगेन विश्वगोलके ।
बभूव जलबूर्णं च ब्रह्माण्डानां च गोलकम् ॥ 85 ॥
4.84.m: The stream of sweat fell downward swiftly into the universal globe; / and the globe of cosmic eggs became full of water.

4.84.s:
jalapūrṇa purā sarva śṛṣṭiśūnyaṃ vrajeśvara .
śruṅgārānte ca tasyāṃ ca vīryādhānaṃ mayā kṛtam .. 86 ..
4.84.d:
जलपूर्ण पुरा सर्व शृष्टिशून्यं व्रजेश्वर ।
श्रुङ्गारान्ते च तस्यां च वीर्याधानं मया कृतम् ॥ 86 ॥
4.84.m: In ancient times all was filled with water, empty of creation, O lord of Vraja; / and at the end of the lovemaking, seed was deposited by me into her.

4.84.s:
dadhāra garbha sā rādhā yāvadvai brahmaṇāḥ śatam .
susrāva sā tadante ca ḍimbhaṃ ca paramādbhutam .. 87 ..
4.84.d:
दधार गर्भ सा राधा यावद्वै ब्रह्मणाः शतम् ।
सुस्राव सा तदन्ते च डिम्भं च परमाद्भुतम् ॥ 87 ॥
4.84.m: That Rādhā bore the womb for as long as a hundred [years] of Brahmā; / and at the end of that she discharged an exceedingly wondrous egg.

4.84.s:
cukopa devī taṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda viṣasāda sā .
pādena prerayāmāsa tamadho viśvagolake .. 88 ..
4.84.d:
चुकोप देवी तं दृष्ट्वा रुरोद विषसाद सा ।
पादेन प्रेरयामास तमधो विश्वगोलके ॥ 88 ॥
4.84.m: Seeing it, the goddess became angry; she wept and was filled with despair; / with her foot she kicked it down into the universal globe.

4.84.s:
sa papāta jale tāta sarvādhāro mahānvirāṭ .
dṛṣṭvā'patyaṃ jalasthaṃ ca mayā śaptā ca sā purā .. 89 ..
4.84.d:
स पपात जले तात सर्वाधारो महान्विराट् ।
दृष्ट्वाऽपत्यं जलस्थं च मया शप्ता च सा पुरा ॥ 89 ॥
4.84.m: It fell into the water, O father, [becoming] the great Virāj, the support of all; / and seeing her child in the water, she was cursed by me in ancient times:

4.84.s:
anapatyā ca sā rāthā macchāpena purā vibho .
tena prasūtāḥ kramato durgā lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī .. 90 ..
4.84.d:
अनपत्या च सा राथा मच्छापेन पुरा विभो ।
तेन प्रसूताः क्रमतो दुर्गा लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती ॥ 90 ॥
4.84.m: “That Rādhā shall be childless in ancient times by my curse, O lord;” / by that [curse] Durgā, Lakṣmī, and Sarasvatī were born in succession.

4.84.s:
catasraḥ paribūrṇāstāḥ prasūtāśca suniścitam .
devyo'nyāścāpi kāminyastāḥ prasūtā vrajeśvara .. 91 ..
4.84.d:
चतस्रः परिबूर्णास्ताः प्रसूताश्च सुनिश्चितम् ।
देव्योऽन्याश्चापि कामिन्यस्ताः प्रसूता व्रजेश्वर ॥ 91 ॥
4.84.m: Four complete goddesses were indeed born; / and other goddesses and lovely women were also born, O lord of Vraja,

4.84.s:
kalayā prabhavo yāsāṃ kalāṃśāṃśena vā vraja .
jajñe mahānvirāḍyena ḍimbhena kalayā''śrayaḥ .. 92 ..
4.84.d:
कलया प्रभवो यासां कलांशांशेन वा व्रज ।
जज्ञे महान्विराड्येन डिम्भेन कलया'ऽश्रयः ॥ 92 ॥
4.84.m: whose origin is by a portion, or by a fraction of a portion of a portion, O [lord of] Vraja; / from that egg, as a portion, was born the great Virāj, the refuge.

4.84.s:
amṛtāṅguṣṭhapīyūṣaṃ mayā dattaṃ papau ca saḥ .
jale sthāvararūpaśca śete ca nijakarmaṇaḥ .. 93 ..
4.84.d:
अमृताङ्गुष्ठपीयूषं मया दत्तं पपौ च सः ।
जले स्थावररूपश्च शेते च निजकर्मणः ॥ 93 ॥
4.84.m: And he drank the nectar-sweet milk of my thumb given by me; / assuming an immovable form in the water, he sleeps by his own karma,

4.84.s:
upadhānaṃ jalaṃ talpaṃ tasya yogabalena ca .
tasya lomnāṃ ca kūpāni jalapūrṇāni saṃtatam .. 94 ..
4.84.d:
उपधानं जलं तल्पं तस्य योगबलेन च ।
तस्य लोम्नां च कूपानि जलपूर्णानि संततम् ॥ 94 ॥
4.84.m: with water as his pillow and couch by the power of his yoga; / the pores of his hair are constantly filled with water.

4.84.s:
pratyekaṃ kramatasteṣu śete kṣudravirāṭ punaḥ .
sahasrapatraṃ kamalaṃ jajñe kṣudrasya nābhitaḥ .. 95 ..
4.84.d:
प्रत्येकं क्रमतस्तेषु शेते क्षुद्रविराट् पुनः ।
सहस्रपत्रं कमलं जज्ञे क्षुद्रस्य नाभितः ॥ 95 ॥
4.84.m: In each of them in succession sleeps a lesser Virāj; / from the navel of that lesser one arose a thousand-petalled lotus.

4.84.s:
tatra jajñe varo brahmā tenāyaṃ kamalodbhavaḥ .
tatrā''virbhūya sa vidhiścintāgrasto babhūva saḥ .. 96 ..
4.84.d:
तत्र जज्ञे वरो ब्रह्मा तेनायं कमलोद्भवः ।
तत्रा'ऽविर्भूय स विधिश्चिन्ताग्रस्तो बभूव सः ॥ 96 ॥
4.84.m: There was born the excellent Brahmā; hence he is called lotus-born; / having manifested there, the creator was seized with anxiety:

4.84.s:
kasmāddehaḥkvā mātā me pitā vā kva ca bāndhavaḥ .
divyaṃ trilakṣavarṣañca babhrāma kamalāntare .. 97 ..
4.84.d:
कस्माद्देहःक्वा माता मे पिता वा क्व च बान्धवः ।
दिव्यं त्रिलक्षवर्षञ्च बभ्राम कमलान्तरे ॥ 97 ॥
4.84.m: “From where is this body? Where is my mother, or my father, and where are my kin?” / He wandered inside the lotus for three hundred thousand divine years.

4.84.s:
tato divyaṃ pañcalakṣaṃ sasmāra tapasā ca mām .
tadā mayā dattamantraṃ jajāpa kamalāntare .. 98 ..
4.84.d:
ततो दिव्यं पञ्चलक्षं सस्मार तपसा च माम् ।
तदा मया दत्तमन्त्रं जजाप कमलान्तरे ॥ 98 ॥
4.84.m: Then for five hundred thousand divine years he remembered me through austerity; / then he recited inside the lotus the mantra given by me,

4.84.s:
divyavarṣasaptalakṣaṃ niyataṃ saṃyataḥ śuciḥ .
tadā matto varaṃ labdhvā sraṣṭā sṛṣṭiṃ cakāra saḥ .. 99 ..
4.84.d:
दिव्यवर्षसप्तलक्षं नियतं संयतः शुचिः ।
तदा मत्तो वरं लब्ध्वा स्रष्टा सृष्टिं चकार सः ॥ 99 ॥
4.84.m: restrained, self-controlled, and pure for seven hundred thousand divine years; / then, having obtained a boon from me, the creator brought forth creation:

4.84.s:
māyayā prati brahmāṇḍe brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakāḥ .
dikpālā dvādaśādityā rudrāścaikādaśāpi ca .. 100 ..
4.84.d:
मायया प्रति ब्रह्माण्डे ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकाः ।
दिक्पाला द्वादशादित्या रुद्राश्चैकादशापि च ॥ 100 ॥
4.84.m: through Māyā, in every cosmic egg, the forms consisting of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / the guardians of the directions, the twelve Ādityas, and the eleven Rudras,

4.84.s:
navagrahāṣṭau vasavo devāḥ koṭitrayaṃ tathā .
brāhmaṇākṣatraviṭśūdrā yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ .. 101 ..
4.84.d:
नवग्रहाष्टौ वसवो देवाः कोटित्रयं तथा ।
ब्राह्मणाक्षत्रविट्शूद्रा यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नराः ॥ 101 ॥
4.84.m: the nine planets, the eight Vasus, and thirty million gods, / brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, and śūdras, yakṣas, gandharvas, and kinnaras,

4.84.s:
bhūtādayo rāṅasāścāpyevaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram .
viśve viśve vinirmāṇāḥ svargāḥ sapta krameṇa ca .. 102 ..
4.84.d:
भूतादयो राङसाश्चाप्येवं सर्वं चराचरम् ।
विश्वे विश्वे विनिर्माणाः स्वर्गाः सप्त क्रमेण च ॥ 102 ॥
4.84.m: spirits, rākṣasas, and all this moving and unmoving world; / fashioned in each universe in succession are the seven heavens,

4.84.s:
saptasāgarasaṃyuktā saptadvīpā vasuṃdharā .
kāñcanībhūmisaṃyuktā tamoyuktaṃ sthalaṃ tathā .. 103 ..
4.84.d:
सप्तसागरसंयुक्ता सप्तद्वीपा वसुंधरा ।
काञ्चनीभूमिसंयुक्ता तमोयुक्तं स्थलं तथा ॥ 103 ॥
4.84.m: the earth with its seven oceans and seven continents, / endowed with a land of gold, and likewise a realm of darkness,

4.84.s:
pātālāśca tathā sapta brahmāṇḍamebhireva ca .
viśve viśve candrasūyo puṇyakṣetraṃ ca bhāratam .. 104 ..
4.84.d:
पातालाश्च तथा सप्त ब्रह्माण्डमेभिरेव च ।
विश्वे विश्वे चन्द्रसूयो पुण्यक्षेत्रं च भारतम् ॥ 104 ॥
4.84.m: and likewise the seven netherworlds; with these indeed is the cosmic egg [made]; / in each universe are the moon and the sun, and the holy land of Bhārata,

4.84.s:
tīrthānyetāni sarvatra gaṅgādīti vrajeśvara .
yāvanti lomakūpāni mahāviṣṇoḥ krameṇa ca .. 105 ..
4.84.d:
तीर्थान्येतानि सर्वत्र गङ्गादीति व्रजेश्वर ।
यावन्ति लोमकूपानि महाविष्णोः क्रमेण च ॥ 105 ॥
4.84.m: and all these holy sites, Gaṅgā and the rest, O lord of Vraja; / as many as are the hair-pores of Mahāviṣṇu in succession,

4.84.s:
viśvānyeva hī tāvanti hyamaṃkhyātāni ca dhruvam .
viśveṣāsūrdhvābhāme ca vaikuṇṭhaśca nirāśrayaḥ .. 106 ..
4.84.d:
विश्वान्येव ही तावन्ति ह्यमंख्यातानि च ध्रुवम् ।
विश्वेषासूर्ध्वाभामे च वैकुण्ठश्च निराश्रयः ॥ 106 ॥
4.84.m: just so many are the universes, truly innumerable and eternal; / and in the upper realm above the universes is Vaikuṇṭha, self-supported,

4.84.s:
madicchayā vinirmāṇā vedāḥ kathitumakṣamāḥ .
kuyogināma dṛṣṭaścāmabhaktānāṃ viniścitam .. 107 ..
4.84.d:
मदिच्छया विनिर्माणा वेदाः कथितुमक्षमाः ।
कुयोगिनाम दृष्टश्चामभक्तानां विनिश्चितम् ॥ 107 ॥
4.84.m: fashioned by my will, which the Vedas are unable to describe, / unseen by bad yogins and by non-devotees, most surely.

4.84.s:
tasmādupari golokaḥ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanaḥ .
vāyunā dhāryamāṇaśca vicitraḥ paramāśramaḥ .. 108 ..
4.84.d:
तस्मादुपरि गोलोकः पञ्चाशत्कोटियोजनः ।
वायुना धार्यमाणश्च विचित्रः परमाश्रमः ॥ 108 ॥
4.84.m: Above that is Goloka, extending fifty million yojanas, / supported by the wind, wondrous, a supreme abode,

4.84.s:
atīva ramyanirmāṇo nityarūpo madicchayā .
śataśrṛṅgeṇa śailena puṇyavṛndāvanena ca .. 109 ..
4.84.d:
अतीव रम्यनिर्माणो नित्यरूपो मदिच्छया ।
शतश्रृङ्गेण शैलेन पुण्यवृन्दावनेन च ॥ 109 ॥
4.84.m: of exceedingly delightful design, eternal by my will, / adorned with the Śataśṛṅga mountain and the sacred Vṛndāvana,

4.84.s:
surāsamaṇḍalenāpi nadyā virajayā yutaḥ .
koṭiyojanavistīrṇā prasthena virajā vraja .. 110 ..
4.84.d:
सुरासमण्डलेनापि नद्या विरजया युतः ।
कोटियोजनविस्तीर्णा प्रस्थेन विरजा व्रज ॥ 110 ॥
4.84.m: endowed with the lovely rāsa circle and the river Virajā; / the Virajā, O [lord of] Vraja, is ten million yojanas in breadth,

4.84.s:
dairdhyaṃ tasyāḥ śataguṇaṃ paritaḥ paramā śubhā .
amūlyaratnanikarairhīramāṇikyayostathā .. 111 ..
4.84.d:
दैर्ध्यं तस्याः शतगुणं परितः परमा शुभा ।
अमूल्यरत्ननिकरैर्हीरमाणिक्ययोस्तथा ॥ 111 ॥
4.84.m: and its length is a hundred times that, supremely auspicious all around; / with masses of priceless gems, with diamonds and rubies,

4.84.s:
maṇīnāṃ kaustubhādīnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ manoharā .
amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ tatrāvi pratimandiram .. 112 ..
4.84.d:
मणीनां कौस्तुभादीनामसंख्यानां मनोहरा ।
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणं तत्रावि प्रतिमन्दिरम् ॥ 112 ॥
4.84.m: and innumerable charming jewels such as the Kaustubha; / every palace there is also made of priceless jewels.

4.84.s:
manoharaṃ ca prākāramadṛṣṭaṃ viśvakarmaṇā .
gopībhirgopanikarairvaiṣṭitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ .. 113 ..
4.84.d:
मनोहरं च प्राकारमदृष्टं विश्वकर्मणा ।
गोपीभिर्गोपनिकरैर्वैष्टितं कामधेनुभिः ॥ 113 ॥
4.84.m: And an enchanting wall never seen by Viśvakarman, / surrounded by cowherd women, multitudes of cowherds, and wish-granting cows;

4.84.s:
kalpavṛkṣaiḥ pārijātairasaṃkhyaiśca sarovaraiḥ .
puṣpodyānaiḥkoṭibhiśca saṃvṛtaṃ rāsamaṇḍalam .. 114 ..
4.84.d:
कल्पवृक्षैः पारिजातैरसंख्यैश्च सरोवरैः ।
पुष्पोद्यानैःकोटिभिश्च संवृतं रासमण्डलम् ॥ 114 ॥
4.84.m: by desire-yielding trees, pārijātas, and countless lakes, / and enclosed by tens of millions of flower gardens: [such is] the circle of the rāsa-dance.

4.84.s:
veṣṭitaṃ veṣṭitairgopairmandiraiḥ śatakoṭibhiḥ .
ratnapradīpayuktaiśca puṣpatalpasamanvitaiḥ .. 115 ..
4.84.d:
वेष्टितं वेष्टितैर्गोपैर्मन्दिरैः शतकोटिभिः ।
रत्नप्रदीपयुक्तैश्च पुष्पतल्पसमन्वितैः ॥ 115 ॥
4.84.m: It is encircled by cowherds, encircled by hundreds of millions of palaces, / equipped with jewelled lamps and furnished with beds of flowers;

4.84.s:
sugandhicandanāmodaiḥ kastūrīkuṅkumānvitaiḥ .
krīḍopayuktairbhogeśca tāmbūlairvāsitairjalaiḥ .. 116 ..
4.84.d:
सुगन्धिचन्दनामोदैः कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमान्वितैः ।
क्रीडोपयुक्तैर्भोगेश्च ताम्बूलैर्वासितैर्जलैः ॥ 116 ॥
4.84.m: with fragrances of sweet sandal, and with musk and saffron; / with delights suitable for sport, and with betel and perfumed waters;

4.84.s:
dhūpaiḥ surabhiramyaiśca mālyaiśca ratnadarpaṇaiḥ .
rakṣakai rakṣitaṃ śaśvadrādhādāsītrikoṭibhiḥ .. 117 ..
4.84.d:
धूपैः सुरभिरम्यैश्च माल्यैश्च रत्नदर्पणैः ।
रक्षकै रक्षितं शश्वद्राधादासीत्रिकोटिभिः ॥ 117 ॥
4.84.m: with incense, fragrant and charming, and with garlands and mirrors of jewels; / protected constantly by guards, by thirty million handmaidens of Rādhā;

4.84.s:
amūlyaratnābharaṇairvahniśuddhāṃśukairapi .
lakṣaṇattagajendrāṇāṃ veṣṭitaṃ ca balaiḥ kramāt .. 118 ..
4.84.d:
अमूल्यरत्नाभरणैर्वह्निशुद्धांशुकैरपि ।
लक्षणत्तगजेन्द्राणां वेष्टितं च बलैः क्रमात् ॥ 118 ॥
4.84.m: adorned with ornaments of priceless jewels and garments purified by fire; / and gradually surrounded by forces of a hundred thousand lordly elephants;

4.84.s:
navayauvanasaṃpannai rūpairnirupamairapi .
ramyaṃ ca vartulākāraṃ candrabimbaṃ yathā vraja .. 119 ..
4.84.d:
नवयौवनसंपन्नै रूपैर्निरुपमैरपि ।
रम्यं च वर्तुलाकारं चन्द्रबिम्बं यथा व्रज ॥ 119 ॥
4.84.m: endowed with fresh youth and peerless beauties; / charming and circular, like the orb of the moon, O [ruler of] Vraja;

4.84.s:
amūlyaratnaracitaṃ daśayojanavistṛtam .
kastūrīkuṅkumai rabhyaiḥ sugandhicandanārcitam .. 120 ..
4.84.d:
अमूल्यरत्नरचितं दशयोजनविस्तृतम् ।
कस्तूरीकुङ्कुमै रभ्यैः सुगन्धिचन्दनार्चितम् ॥ 120 ॥
4.84.m: fashioned of priceless gems, ten yojanas wide; / worshiped with charming musk and saffron, and fragrant sandalwood;

4.84.s:
āvṛtaṃ maṅgalaghaṭaiḥ phalapallavasaṃyutaiḥ .
dadhilājaiśca parṇaiśca snigdhadūrvāṅkuraiḥ phalaiḥ .. 121 ..
4.84.d:
आवृतं मङ्गलघटैः फलपल्लवसंयुतैः ।
दधिलाजैश्च पर्णैश्च स्निग्धदूर्वाङ्कुरैः फलैः ॥ 121 ॥
4.84.m: encompassed by auspicious jars filled with fruits and shoots; / with curd, parched grain, leaves, fresh shoots of dūrvā grass, and fruits;

4.84.s:
śrīrāmakadalīstambhairasaṃkhyaiśca manoharaiḥ .
paṭṭasūtranibaddhaiśca snigdhaiścandanapallavaiḥ .. 122 ..
4.84.d:
श्रीरामकदलीस्तम्भैरसंख्यैश्च मनोहरैः ।
पट्टसूत्रनिबद्धैश्च स्निग्धैश्चन्दनपल्लवैः ॥ 122 ॥
4.84.m: with countless charming pillars of śrīrāma-plantain trees / bound with silk threads, and fresh sandalwood leaves;

4.84.s:
candanāsaktamālyaiśca bhūṣaṇaiśca vibhūṣitam .
amūlyaratnaracitaṃ śataśṛṅgamanoharam .. 123 ..
4.84.d:
चन्दनासक्तमाल्यैश्च भूषणैश्च विभूषितम् ।
अमूल्यरत्नरचितं शतशृङ्गमनोहरम् ॥ 123 ॥
4.84.m: and adorned with garlands anointed with sandal and with ornaments. / Fashioned of priceless gems, charming with a hundred peaks,

4.84.s:
koṭiyojanamūrdhvaṃ ca dairdhyaṃ śataguṇottaram .
śailaprasthaparimitaṃ pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam .. 124 ..
4.84.d:
कोटियोजनमूर्ध्वं च दैर्ध्यं शतगुणोत्तरम् ।
शैलप्रस्थपरिमितं पञ्चाशत्कोटियोजनम् ॥ 124 ॥
4.84.m: it rises ten million yojanas high, its length a hundred times greater; / the extent of the mountain range measures five hundred million yojanas;

4.84.s:
atīva kamanīyaṃ ya vedānirvacanīyakam .
prākāramiva tasyāpi golalokasya manoharam .. 125 ..
4.84.d:
अतीव कमनीयं य वेदानिर्वचनीयकम् ।
प्राकारमिव तस्यापि गोललोकस्य मनोहरम् ॥ 125 ॥
4.84.m: exceedingly lovely, indescribable even by the Vedas, / like an enchanting rampart of that Goloka.

4.84.s:
parito veṣṭitaṃ ramyaṃ hīrahārasamanvitam .
tatra vṛndāvanaṃ ramyaṃ yuktaṃ candanapādapaiḥ .. 126 ..
4.84.d:
परितो वेष्टितं रम्यं हीरहारसमन्वितम् ।
तत्र वृन्दावनं रम्यं युक्तं चन्दनपादपैः ॥ 126 ॥
4.84.m: Charming, encircled on all sides, adorned with pearl and diamond necklaces, / there lies the lovely Vṛndāvana, filled with sandalwood trees,

4.84.s:
kalpavṛkṣaiśca namyaiśca mandāraiḥ kāmadhenubhiḥ .
śobhitaṃ śobhanāḍhyaiśca puṣpodyānairmanoharaiḥ .. 127 ..
4.84.d:
कल्पवृक्षैश्च नम्यैश्च मन्दारैः कामधेनुभिः ।
शोभितं शोभनाढ्यैश्च पुष्पोद्यानैर्मनोहरैः ॥ 127 ॥
4.84.m: with wish-fulfilling trees, bowing mandāra trees, and wish-granting cows; / adorned with splendid, charming flower gardens,

4.84.s:
krīḍāsarovarai ramyaiḥ suramyai ratimandiraiḥ .
atīva ramyaṃ rahasi rāsayogyasthalānvitam .. 128 ..
4.84.d:
क्रीडासरोवरै रम्यैः सुरम्यै रतिमन्दिरैः ।
अतीव रम्यं रहसि रासयोग्यस्थलान्वितम् ॥ 128 ॥
4.84.m: with charming lakes for sport, and most lovely pavilions of love; / exceedingly lovely in seclusion, possessing a place fit for the rāsa-dance;

4.84.s:
rakṣitaṃ rakṣakai ramyairasaṃkhyairgopikāgaṇaiḥ .
parito vartulākāraṃ trilakṣayojanaṃ vanam .. 129 ..
4.84.d:
रक्षितं रक्षकै रम्यैरसंख्यैर्गोपिकागणैः ।
परितो वर्तुलाकारं त्रिलक्षयोजनं वनम् ॥ 129 ॥
4.84.m: protected by charming guards and countless hosts of gopīs; / a forest circular on all sides, three hundred thousand yojanas [in extent];

4.84.s:
ṣaṭpadadhvanisaṃyuktaṃ puṃskokilarutānvitam .
tatrākṣayo vaṭo ramyo rahasye bahṛvistṛtaḥ .. 130 ..
4.84.d:
षट्पदध्वनिसंयुक्तं पुंस्कोकिलरुतान्वितम् ।
तत्राक्षयो वटो रम्यो रहस्ये बहृविस्तृतः ॥ 130 ॥
4.84.m: filled with the humming of bees and the calls of male cuckoos. / There stands the charming and imperishable banyan tree, very vast in its secret recess;

4.84.s:
sahasrayojanordhvaśca paritaśca caturguṇaḥ .
gopīnāṃ kalpavṛkṣaśca sarvavāñchāphalapradaḥ .. 131 ..
4.84.d:
सहस्रयोजनोर्ध्वश्च परितश्च चतुर्गुणः ।
गोपीनां कल्पवृक्षश्च सर्ववाञ्छाफलप्रदः ॥ 131 ॥
4.84.m: a thousand yojanas high, and fourfold around, / the wish-granting tree of the gopīs, granting the fruit of all desires;

4.84.s:
krīḍānvitairāvṛtaśca rādhādāsītrilakṣakaiḥ .
virajātīranirāṇāṃ vāyunā śītalena ca .. 132 ..
4.84.d:
क्रीडान्वितैरावृतश्च राधादासीत्रिलक्षकैः ।
विरजातीरनिराणां वायुना शीतलेन च ॥ 132 ॥
4.84.m: surrounded by three hundred thousand handmaidens of Rādhā engaged in sport; / cooled by the gentle, fragrant, and pure breeze,

4.84.s:
puṣpānvitena mandena pavitraśca sugandhinā .
dāsīgaṇairasaṃkhyaiśca vṛndāvanavinodinī .. 133 ..
4.84.d:
पुष्पान्वितेन मन्देन पवित्रश्च सुगन्धिना ।
दासीगणैरसंख्यैश्च वृन्दावनविनोदिनी ॥ 133 ॥
4.84.m: laden with blossoms, from the waters of the banks of the Virajā. / Delighting in Vṛndāvana with countless groups of maidservants,

4.84.s:
tatra krīḍati rādhā sā mama prāṇādhidevatā .
seyaṃ śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā .. 134 ..
4.84.d:
तत्र क्रीडति राधा सा मम प्राणाधिदेवता ।
सेयं श्रीदामशापेन वृषभानसुताऽधुना ॥ 134 ॥
4.84.m: there sports that Rādhā, the presiding deity of my life-breath. / Through the curse of Śrīdāman, she has now become the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu.

4.84.s:
brahmādidevaiḥ siddhendrairmunīndraiḥ pūjitā vraja .
siddhairguṇairbalairbuddhyā jñānayogaiśca vidyayā .. 135 ..
4.84.d:
ब्रह्मादिदेवैः सिद्धेन्द्रैर्मुनीन्द्रैः पूजिता व्रज ।
सिद्धैर्गुणैर्बलैर्बुद्ध्या ज्ञानयोगैश्च विद्यया ॥ 135 ॥
4.84.m: She is worshiped by Brahmā and the gods, by lords of Siddhas, and lords of sages, O [chief of] Vraja, / in perfections, virtues, strengths, intellect, yogas of wisdom, and sacred knowledge;

4.84.s:
tāta sarvaprakāreṇa vandyā satsadṛśī priyā .
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ nanda brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca varṇanam ..
yathocitaṃ parimitaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 136 ..
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo
bhagavannandasaṃo caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 84 ..
4.84.d:
तात सर्वप्रकारेण वन्द्या सत्सदृशी प्रिया ।
इत्येवं कथितं नन्द ब्रह्माण्डानां च वर्णनम् ॥
यथोचितं परिमितं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 136 ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ
भगवन्नन्दसंओ चतुरशीतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 84 ॥
4.84.m:
in every way, dear father, she is venerable and equal to me, my beloved. / Thus, O Nanda, the description of the cosmic eggs has been told,
as appropriate and measured. What more do you wish to hear?
Thus ends the eighty-fourth chapter in the conversation between the Blessed Lord and Nanda, in the Nārada-Nārāyaṇa [section] of the latter half of the Śrī-Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa in the great Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa.

4.85.s:
nanda uvāca
varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca sāṃpratam .
vipākaṃ karmaṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmapi .. 1 ..
4.85.d:
नन्द उवाच
वर्णानां च चतुर्णां च भक्ष्याभक्ष्यं च सांप्रतम् ।
विपाकं कर्मणां चैव सर्वेषां प्राणिनामपि ॥ 1 ॥

4.85.s:
kathayasva mahābhāga kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam .
tvatto'nyaṃ kaṃ ca pṛcchāmi nitāntaṃ santamīśvaram .. 2 ..
4.85.d:
कथयस्व महाभाग कारणानां च कारणम् ।
त्वत्तोऽन्यं कं च पृच्छामि नितान्तं सन्तमीश्वरम् ॥ 2 ॥

4.85.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ caturṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ ca yathocitam .
vedoktaṃ śrūyatā tāta sāvadhānaṃ niśāmaya .. 3 ..
4.85.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
भक्ष्याभक्ष्यं चतुर्णां च वर्णानां च यथोचितम् ।
वेदोक्तं श्रूयता तात सावधानं निशामय ॥ 3 ॥

4.85.s:
ayaḥpātre payaḥpānaṃ gavyaṃ siddhānnameva ca .
bhṛṣṭādikaṃ padhu guḍaṃ nālikerodakaṃ tathā .. 4 ..
4.85.d:
अयःपात्रे पयःपानं गव्यं सिद्धान्नमेव च ।
भृष्टादिकं पधु गुडं नालिकेरोदकं तथा ॥ 4 ॥

4.85.s:
phalaṃ mūlaṃ ca yatkiṃcidabhakṣayaṃ manurabravīt .
dagdhānnaṃ taptasauvīramabhakṣyaṃ vrahmanirmitam .. 5 ..
4.85.d:
फलं मूलं च यत्किंचिदभक्षयं मनुरब्रवीत् ।
दग्धान्नं तप्तसौवीरमभक्ष्यं व्रह्मनिर्मितम् ॥ 5 ॥

4.85.s:
nālikerodakaṃ kāṃsye tāmrapātre sthitaṃ madhu .
gavyaṃ ca tāmrapātrasthaṃ sarvaṃ madyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vinā .. 6 ..
4.85.d:
नालिकेरोदकं कांस्ये ताम्रपात्रे स्थितं मधु ।
गव्यं च ताम्रपात्रस्थं सर्वं मद्यं घृतं विना ॥ 6 ॥

4.85.s:
tāmrapātre payaḥpānamucchiṣṭe ghṛtabhojanam .
dugdhaṃ salavaṇaṃ caiva sadyo gomāṃsabhakṣaṇam .. 7 ..
4.85.d:
ताम्रपात्रे पयःपानमुच्छिष्टे घृतभोजनम् ।
दुग्धं सलवणं चैव सद्यो गोमांसभक्षणम् ॥ 7 ॥

4.85.s:
abhakṣyaṃ madhumikṣaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ guḍaṃ tathā .
ārdrakaṃ guḍasaṃyuktamabhakṣyaṃ śrutisaṃmatam .. 8 ..
4.85.d:
अभक्ष्यं मधुमिक्षं च घृतं तैलं गुडं तथा ।
आर्द्रकं गुडसंयुक्तमभक्ष्यं श्रुतिसंमतम् ॥ 8 ॥

4.85.s:
pītaśeṣajalaṃ caiva māghe ca mūlakaṃ tathā .
japādikaṃ ca śayane sadā prājñaḥ parityajet .. 9 ..
4.85.d:
पीतशेषजलं चैव माघे च मूलकं तथा ।
जपादिकं च शयने सदा प्राज्ञः परित्यजेत् ॥ 9 ॥

4.85.s:
dvirbhojanaṃ ca divase saṃdhyayohbhojanaṃ tathā .
bhakṣyaṃ ca rātriśeṣe ca dhruvaṃ prājñaḥ parityajet .. 10 ..
4.85.d:
द्विर्भोजनं च दिवसे संध्ययोह्भोजनं तथा ।
भक्ष्यं च रात्रिशेषे च ध्रुवं प्राज्ञः परित्यजेत् ॥ 10 ॥

4.85.s:
pānīyaṃ pāyasaṃ cūrṇaṃ ghutaṃ lavaṇameva ca .
svastikaṃ guḍakaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ takraṃ tathā madhu .. 11 ..
4.85.d:
पानीयं पायसं चूर्णं घुतं लवणमेव च ।
स्वस्तिकं गुडकं चैव क्षीरं तक्रं तथा मधु ॥ 11 ॥

4.85.s:
hastāddhastagṛhītaṃ ca sadyo gomāṃsameva ca .
karpūraṃ raupyapātrasthamabhakṣyaṃ śrutisaṃmatam .. 12 ..
4.85.d:
हस्ताद्धस्तगृहीतं च सद्यो गोमांसमेव च ।
कर्पूरं रौप्यपात्रस्थमभक्ष्यं श्रुतिसंमतम् ॥ 12 ॥

4.85.s:
pariveṣaṇakārī cedbhoktāraṃ spṛśate yadi .
mabhakṣyaṃ ca tadannaṃ ca sarveṣāmeva saṃmatam .. 13 ..
4.85.d:
परिवेषणकारी चेद्भोक्तारं स्पृशते यदि ।
मभक्ष्यं च तदन्नं च सर्वेषामेव संमतम् ॥ 13 ॥

4.85.s:
nakulānāṃ gaṇḍakānāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca pakṣiṇām .
sarpāṇāṃ sūkarāṇāṃ ca gardabhānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 14 ..
4.85.d:
नकुलानां गण्डकानां महिषाणां च पक्षिणाम् ।
सर्पाणां सूकराणां च गर्दभानां विशेषतः ॥ 14 ॥

4.85.s:
marjārāṇāṃ sṛgālānāṃ kukkuṭānāṃ vrajeśvara .
vyāghrāṇāmapi siṃhānāṃ tyājyaṃ māṃsaṃ nṛṇāṃ sadā .. 15 ..
4.85.d:
मर्जाराणां सृगालानां कुक्कुटानां व्रजेश्वर ।
व्याघ्राणामपि सिंहानां त्याज्यं मांसं नृणां सदा ॥ 15 ॥

4.85.s:
jalaukasāṃ ca nakrāṇāṃ gedhikānāṃ tathaiva ca .
maṇḍūkānāṃ karkaṭānāṃ cuñcukānāṃ ca niścitam .. 16 ..
4.85.d:
जलौकसां च नक्राणां गेधिकानां तथैव च ।
मण्डूकानां कर्कटानां चुञ्चुकानां च निश्चितम् ॥ 16 ॥

4.85.s:
gavāṃ ca camarīṇāṃ ca na kalau māṃsabhakṣaṇam .
hastināṃ ghoṭakānāṃ ca nṛṇāmeva ca rakṣasām .. 17 ..
4.85.d:
गवां च चमरीणां च न कलौ मांसभक्षणम् ।
हस्तिनां घोटकानां च नृणामेव च रक्षसाम् ॥ 17 ॥

4.85.s:
daṃśaśca maśakaścaiva makṣikā ca pipīnikā .
anyedhāṃ ca niṣiddhānāṃ loke vede vrajeśvara .. 18 ..
4.85.d:
दंशश्च मशकश्चैव मक्षिका च पिपीनिका ।
अन्येधां च निषिद्धानां लोके वेदे व्रजेश्वर ॥ 18 ॥

4.85.s:
vānarāṇāṃ bhallukānāṃ śarabhāṇāṃ tathaiva ca .
niṣiddhaṃ mṛganābhīnāṃ gardabhānāṃ ca māṃsakam .. 19 ..
4.85.d:
वानराणां भल्लुकानां शरभाणां तथैव च ।
निषिद्धं मृगनाभीनां गर्दभानां च मांसकम् ॥ 19 ॥

4.85.s:
abhakṣyaṃ mahiṣīṇāṃ ca dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā .
svastikaṃ ca tathā tatra viprāṇāṃ navanītakam .. 20 ..
4.85.d:
अभक्ष्यं महिषीणां च दुग्धं दधि घृतं तथा ।
स्वस्तिकं च तथा तत्र विप्राणां नवनीतकम् ॥ 20 ॥

4.85.s:
māṃsamucchaiḥśravasakaṃ tasya dugdhādikaṃ tathā .
varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ cāpyabhakṣyaṃ ca śrutau śrutam .. 21 ..
4.85.d:
मांसमुच्छैःश्रवसकं तस्य दुग्धादिकं तथा ।
वर्णानां च चतुर्णां चाप्यभक्ष्यं च श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ॥ 21 ॥

4.85.s:
abhakṣyamārdrakaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ ca raverdine .
paryuṣitaṃ calaṃ cānnaṃ viprāṇāṃ dugdhameva ca .. 22 ..
4.85.d:
अभक्ष्यमार्द्रकं चैव सर्वेषां च रवेर्दिने ।
पर्युषितं चलं चान्नं विप्राणां दुग्धमेव च ॥ 22 ॥

4.85.s:
varṇānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ cāpyavīrānnasya bhakṣaṇam .
tadannaṃ ca surātulyaṃ gomāṃsādhikameva ca .. 23 ..
4.85.d:
वर्णानां च चतुर्णां चाप्यवीरान्नस्य भक्षणम् ।
तदन्नं च सुरातुल्यं गोमांसाधिकमेव च ॥ 23 ॥

4.85.s:
avīrānnaṃ ca yobhuṅkte brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ .
pitṛdevārcanaṃ tasya niṣphalaṃ manurabravīt .. 24 ..
4.85.d:
अवीरान्नं च योभुङ्क्ते ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानदुर्बलः ।
पितृदेवार्चनं तस्य निष्फलं मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ 24 ॥

4.85.s:
brahmāṇānāṃ va2ṣṇavānāmabhakṣyaṃ matsyameva ca .
itareṣāmabhakṣyaṃ ca pañcaparvasu niścitam .. 25 ..
4.85.d:
ब्रह्माणानां व2ष्णवानामभक्ष्यं मत्स्यमेव च ।
इतरेषामभक्ष्यं च पञ्चपर्वसु निश्चितम् ॥ 25 ॥

4.85.s:
pitṛdevāvaśeṣe ca bhakṣyaṃ māṃsaṃ na dūthitam .
pañcaparvasu tyājyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ manurabravīt .. 26 ..
4.85.d:
पितृदेवावशेषे च भक्ष्यं मांसं न दूथितम् ।
पञ्चपर्वसु त्याज्यं च सर्वेषां मनुरब्रवीत् ॥ 26 ॥

4.85.s:
asaṃskṛtaṃ ca lavaṇaṃ tailaṃ cābhakṣyameva ca .
bhakṣyaṃ pavitraṃ sarveṣāṃ vyañjanaṃ vahnisaṃskṛtam .. 27 ..
4.85.d:
असंस्कृतं च लवणं तैलं चाभक्ष्यमेव च ।
भक्ष्यं पवित्रं सर्वेषां व्यञ्जनं वह्निसंस्कृतम् ॥ 27 ॥

4.85.s:
ekahaste ghṛtaṃ toyamabhakṣyaṃ sarvamaṃmatam .
āvilaṃ kṛmiyuktaṃ ca pariśuddhaṃ ca nirmalam .. 28 ..
4.85.d:
एकहस्ते घृतं तोयमभक्ष्यं सर्वमंमतम् ।
आविलं कृमियुक्तं च परिशुद्धं च निर्मलम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.85.m:
especially of snakes, pigs, and donkeys;
of cats, jackals, and roosters, O lord of Vraja;
and the meat even of tigers and lions is ever to be abandoned by men.
[The flesh] of leeches, crocodiles, and monitor lizards likewise,
of frogs, crabs, and birds definitely [must be avoided].
In the Kali [age], the eating of meat from cows and yaks is forbidden,
[as also that] of elephants, horses, men, and demons,
of gadflies, mosquitoes, flies, and ants,
and of others that are forbidden in the world and the Veda, O lord of Vraja.
The flesh of monkeys, bears, and śarabhas likewise,
and of musk deer and donkeys is forbidden.
Inedible is the milk, curd, and ghee of female buffaloes,
and likewise svastika-drink, and for brāhmaṇas, their butter.
The meat of a horse, and likewise its milk and so forth,
is heard in the Veda to be inedible for all four varṇas.
Ginger is inedible for all on Sunday,
as is stale, spoiled food, and [such] milk for brāhmaṇas.
Eating food cooked by a woman without husband or son is [forbidden] for all four varṇas;
that food is equal to liquor, even worse than beef.
The brāhmaṇa, weak in knowledge, who eats food of a woman without husband or son—
his worship of the ancestors and deities is fruitless, said Manu.
Fish is inedible for brāhmaṇas and Vaiṣṇavas;
for others, it is definitely inedible on the five sacred occasions.
Meat left over from [offering to] ancestors and deities is edible, not contaminated;
on the five sacred occasions it must be abandoned by all, said Manu.
Unconsecrated salt and oil are indeed inedible;
edible and pure for all is a dish cooked with fire.
Ghee or water held in one hand is agreed by all to be inedible,
whether turbid, worm-infested, or thoroughly cleansed and spotless.

4.85.s:
abhakṣyaṃ brahmāṇānāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .
anivedyaṃ harereva yatīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām .. 29 ..
4.85.d:
अभक्ष्यं ब्रह्माणानां च वैष्णवानां विशेषतः ।
अनिवेद्यं हरेरेव यतीनां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.85.m:
Inedible for brāhmaṇas, and especially for Vaiṣṇavas,
ascetics, and celibate students, is anything not offered to Hari.
Honey, cow's milk, or jaggery mixed with ants,
or whatever item it may be, dear father, is heard in the Veda to be inedible.
Food tasted by birds, tasted by insects, pure ripe fruit,
and food tasted by crows is an inedible substance for all.
Sweets cooked in ghee or oil that are prepared by a śūdra,
and cakes to be eaten by a śūdra, are inedible for brāhmaṇas.
One should abandon the water and food of all impure persons;
on the day after impurity ends, it is pure indeed, no doubt.
The ripening of karma is difficult [to endure], as agreed by the Veda.
What is edible and inedible has been spoken according to knowledge, O lord of Vraja.
Four views have been stated in succession in the four Vedas;
I shall tell you their essence, father, listen!
Karma is not exhausted even in hundreds of millions of kalpas without being experienced;
one must inevitably experience karma performed, whether auspicious or inauspicious.
By the aid of sacred places and deities,
some assistance is afforded to men through a multitude of bodies everywhere.
Expiations performed, O father, definitely do not purify
one whose face is turned away from Me, just as rivers [cannot purify] a pot of wine.
By expiation, by merit, humans are not purified,
nor by every undertaking, O best of Vaiśyas, nor by gift, nor by yoga.
Whatever karma is auspicious or inauspicious is not destroyed without experiencing [it];
through experience one attains purification, and from that liberation comes to men.
An evil deed is not destroyed by a good deed,
nor is a good deed destroyed by an evil deed done.
By sacrifice, or by asceticism, by observance or fasting,
by bathing at a sacred place, by gift, by recitation or rule,
by circumambulation of the earth, or by listening to a Purāṇa,

4.85.s:
pipīlikāmiśritaṃ ca madhu gavyaṃ guḍaṃ tathā .
yatkiṃcidvastu vā tāta na bhakṣyaṃ ca śrutau śrutam .. 30 ..
4.85.d:
पिपीलिकामिश्रितं च मधु गव्यं गुडं तथा ।
यत्किंचिद्वस्तु वा तात न भक्ष्यं च श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ॥ 30 ॥

4.85.s:
pakṣibhakṣyaṃ kīṭabhakṣyaṃ śṛddhaṃ pakvaphalaṃ tathā .
kākabhakṣyamabhakṣyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dravyameva ca .. 31 ..
4.85.d:
पक्षिभक्ष्यं कीटभक्ष्यं शृद्धं पक्वफलं तथा ।
काकभक्ष्यमभक्ष्यं च सर्वेषां द्रव्यमेव च ॥ 31 ॥

4.85.s:
ghṛtapakvaṃ tailapakvaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ śūdrasaṃskṛtam .
abhakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śūdrabhakṣyaṃ ca pīṭhakam .. 32 ..
4.85.d:
घृतपक्वं तैलपक्वं मिष्टान्नं शूद्रसंस्कृतम् ।
अभक्ष्यं ब्राह्मणानां च शूद्रभक्ष्यं च पीठकम् ॥ 32 ॥

4.85.s:
sarveṣāmaśucīnāṃ ca jalamannaṃ parityajet .
āśaucāntātparadine śuddhameva na saṃśayaḥ .. 33 ..
4.85.d:
सर्वेषामशुचीनां च जलमन्नं परित्यजेत् ।
आशौचान्तात्परदिने शुद्धमेव न संशयः ॥ 33 ॥

4.85.s:
vipākaṃ karmaṇāmeva duṣkaraṃ śrutisaṃmatam .
bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ ca kathitaṃ yathājñānaṃ vraceśvara .. 34 ..
4.85.d:
विपाकं कर्मणामेव दुष्करं श्रुतिसंमतम् ।
भक्ष्याभक्ष्यं च कथितं यथाज्ञानं व्रचेश्वर ॥ 34 ॥

4.85.s:
kramāccaturṣu vedeṣu cauktaṃ matacatuṣṭayam .
sarveṣāṃ sārabhūtaṃ ca kathayāmi pitaḥ śṛṇu .. 35 ..
4.85.d:
क्रमाच्चतुर्षु वेदेषु चौक्तं मतचतुष्टयम् ।
सर्वेषां सारभूतं च कथयामि पितः शृणु ॥ 35 ॥

4.85.s:
nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karma kalpakoṭiśatairapi .
avaśyameva bhoktavyaṃ kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham .. 36 ..
4.85.d:
नाभुक्तं क्षीयते कर्म कल्पकोटिशतैरपि ।
अवश्यमेव भोक्तव्यं कृतं कर्म शुभाशुभम् ॥ 36 ॥

4.85.s:
tīrthānāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca sahāyena nṛṇāmapi .
kiṃcidbhavati sāhāyyaṃ kāyavyūhena sarvataḥ .. 37 ..
4.85.d:
तीर्थानां च सुराणां च सहायेन नृणामपि ।
किंचिद्भवति साहाय्यं कायव्यूहेन सर्वतः ॥ 37 ॥

4.85.s:
prāyaścitāni cīrṇāni niścitamamatparāṅamukham .
na niṣpunanti he tāta surākumbhamivā''pagāḥ .. 38 ..
4.85.d:
प्रायश्चितानि चीर्णानि निश्चितममत्पराङमुखम् ।
न निष्पुनन्ति हे तात सुराकुम्भमिवा'ऽपगाः ॥ 38 ॥

4.85.s:
prāyaścittena puṇyena na hi śudhyanti mānavā .
sarvārambheṇa vaiśyendra dānena yogato'pi vā .. 39 ..
4.85.d:
प्रायश्चित्तेन पुण्येन न हि शुध्यन्ति मानवा ।
सर्वारम्भेण वैश्येन्द्र दानेन योगतोऽपि वा ॥ 39 ॥

4.85.s:
śubhāśubhaṃ ca yatkarma vinā bhogānna ca kṣayaḥ .
bhogena śuddhimāpnoti tato muktirbhavennṛṇām .. 40 ..
4.85.d:
शुभाशुभं च यत्कर्म विना भोगान्न च क्षयः ।
भोगेन शुद्धिमाप्नोति ततो मुक्तिर्भवेन्नृणाम् ॥ 40 ॥

4.85.s:
na naṣṭaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ karma sukṛtena ca karmaṇā .
na naṣṭaṃ sukṛtaṃ karma kṛtena duṣkṛtena ca .. 41 ..
4.85.d:
न नष्टं दुष्कृतं कर्म सुकृतेन च कर्मणा ।
न नष्टं सुकृतं कर्म कृतेन दुष्कृतेन च ॥ 41 ॥

4.85.s:
yajñena tapasā vā'pi vratenānaśanena ca .
tīrthasnānena dānena japena niyamena ca .. 42 ..
4.85.d:
यज्ञेन तपसा वाऽपि व्रतेनानशनेन च ।
तीर्थस्नानेन दानेन जपेन नियमेन च ॥ 42 ॥

4.85.s:
bhuvaḥ pradakṣiṇenaiva purāṇaśravaṇena ca .
upadeṇena puṇyena pūjayā gurudevayoḥ .. 43 ..
4.85.d:
भुवः प्रदक्षिणेनैव पुराणश्रवणेन च ।
उपदेणेन पुण्येन पूजया गुरुदेवयोः ॥ 43 ॥

4.85.s:
svadharmācaraṇenaivātithīnāṃ pūjanena ca .
brahmaṇāṃ pūjanenaiva bhojanena viśeṣataḥ .. 44 ..
4.85.d:
स्वधर्माचरणेनैवातिथीनां पूजनेन च ।
ब्रह्मणां पूजनेनैव भोजनेन विशेषतः ॥ 44 ॥

4.85.s:
yaddhattamapi viprāya tatprāptaṃ pūrṇarūpataḥ .
bījarūpaṃ ca taddānaṃ kṣetrarūpaṃ ca brahmaṇaḥ 45
ekena karmaṇā tāta svargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .
karmaṇā na hi mokṣaṃ ca tadeva mama sevayā .. 46 ..
4.85.d:
यद्धत्तमपि विप्राय तत्प्राप्तं पूर्णरूपतः ।
बीजरूपं च तद्दानं क्षेत्ररूपं च ब्रह्मणः 45
एकेन कर्मणा तात स्वर्गं प्राप्नोति मानवः ।
कर्मणा न हि मोक्षं च तदेव मम सेवया ॥ 46 ॥

4.85.s:
svargaṃ ca sukṛtenaiva narakaṃ duṣkṛtena ca .
vyādhirjanma ca yonau ca kutsite ca tataḥ śuciḥ .. 47 ..
4.85.d:
स्वर्गं च सुकृतेनैव नरकं दुष्कृतेन च ।
व्याधिर्जन्म च योनौ च कुत्सिते च ततः शुचिः ॥ 47 ॥

4.85.s:
goghno yo brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kāmataścopapātakī .
dandaśūkatvamāpnoti golomasamavarṣakam .. 48 ..
4.85.d:
गोघ्नो यो ब्राह्मणानां च कामतश्चोपपातकी ।
दन्दशूकत्वमाप्नोति गोलोमसमवर्षकम् ॥ 48 ॥

4.85.s:
sarpeṇa bhakṣitastena cvālayā garalasya ca .
tṛṣito vyathitaścaiva nirāhāraḥ kṛśodaraḥ .. 49 ..
4.85.d:
सर्पेण भक्षितस्तेन च्वालया गरलस्य च ।
तृषितो व्यथितश्चैव निराहारः कृशोदरः ॥ 49 ॥

4.85.s:
tataḥ kuṇḍātsamutthāya gaurbhavellomavarṣakam .
tataḥ kuṣṭhī ca cāṇḍālo varṣalakṣaṃtato naraḥ .. 50 ..
4.85.d:
ततः कुण्डात्समुत्थाय गौर्भवेल्लोमवर्षकम् ।
ततः कुष्ठी च चाण्डालो वर्षलक्षंततो नरः ॥ 50 ॥

4.85.s:
tadā bhavedbrāhmaṇaśca kuṣṭhayukto hi karmaṇā .
bhojayitvā vipralakṣaṃ nirvyādhiśca bhavecchuciḥ .. 51 ..
4.85.d:
तदा भवेद्ब्राह्मणश्च कुष्ठयुक्तो हि कर्मणा ।
भोजयित्वा विप्रलक्षं निर्व्याधिश्च भवेच्छुचिः ॥ 51 ॥

4.85.s:
akāmatastadardhaṃ ca kṣatriyasyāpi kāmataḥ .
akāmatastadardhaṃ ca tadardhaṃ ca viśastathā .. 52 ..
4.85.d:
अकामतस्तदर्धं च क्षत्रियस्यापि कामतः ।
अकामतस्तदर्धं च तदर्धं च विशस्तथा ॥ 52 ॥

4.85.s:
tadardha śūdragoghnaśca bhuṅkte pāpaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .
prāyaścittena śuddhaśca bhuṅkte śeṣaṃ ca karmaṇaḥ .. 53 ..
4.85.d:
तदर्ध शूद्रगोघ्नश्च भुङ्क्ते पापं न संशयः ।
प्रायश्चित्तेन शुद्धश्च भुङ्क्ते शेषं च कर्मणः ॥ 53 ॥

4.85.s:
anukalpe caturthaṃ ca pāpaṃ bhuṅkte na saṃśayaḥ .
caturguṇaṃ ca goghnānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pātakam .. 54 ..
4.85.d:
अनुकल्पे चतुर्थं च पापं भुङ्क्ते न संशयः ।
चतुर्गुणं च गोघ्नानां ब्राह्मणानां च पातकम् ॥ 54 ॥

4.85.s:
bhuṅkte pāpaṃ ca brahmanno brāhmaṇāścetaro'pi vā .
krameṇānena bodhyaṃ ca kāmato'kāmato'pi vā .. 55 ..
4.85.d:
भुङ्क्ते पापं च ब्रह्मन्नो ब्राह्मणाश्चेतरोऽपि वा ।
क्रमेणानेन बोध्यं च कामतोऽकामतोऽपि वा ॥ 55 ॥

4.85.s:
prāyaścittaṃ janma karma vyādhireva pa saṃśayaḥ .
goghno bhavati gauścāpi yāvadvarṣa ca niścitam .. 56 ..
4.85.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं जन्म कर्म व्याधिरेव प संशयः ।
गोघ्नो भवति गौश्चापि यावद्वर्ष च निश्चितम् ॥ 56 ॥

4.85.s:
caturguṇaṃ ca teṣāṃ ca brahmaghno viṭkṛmirbhavet .
tato bhavati mlecchaśca tāvadvarṣacaturguṇam .. 57 ..
4.85.d:
चतुर्गुणं च तेषां च ब्रह्मघ्नो विट्कृमिर्भवेत् ।
ततो भवति म्लेच्छश्च तावद्वर्षचतुर्गुणम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.85.m:
by teaching, by merit, by worship of the guru and deity,
by performing one's own duty, by honoring guests,
and especially by honoring and feeding brāhmaṇas,
whatever is given to a brāhmaṇa is obtained in full;
that gift is of the nature of seed, and the brāhmaṇa of the nature of a field.
By an action, dear father, a human attains heaven;
by action liberation is not [attained], but rather by service to Me.
Heaven comes from good deeds, and hell from evil deeds;
disease, birth in a vile womb, and thereafter purification.
The killer of a cow, who belongs to the brāhmaṇas, and is a sinner by intention,
attains the state of a venomous snake for as many years as the cow had hairs.
Eaten by that serpent, burned by the venom's flame,
thirsty, afflicted, without food, and with a wasted belly,
then rising from the pit, he becomes a cow for as many years as its hairs.
Then a leper and a cāṇḍāla, then after a hundred thousand years a human;
then he becomes a brāhmaṇa afflicted with leprosy because of his karma.
After feeding a hundred thousand brāhmaṇas, he becomes free of disease and pure.
Unintentionally, it is half of that; for a kṣatriya intentionally,
unintentionally half of that, and half of that for a vaiśya;
half of that a śūdra cow-killer suffers of the sin, without a doubt.
Purified by expiation, he suffers the remainder of his karma.
In an alternative procedure, he suffers one-fourth of the sin, without a doubt;
and fourfold is the sin of brāhmaṇas who kill cows.
The killer of a brāhmaṇa—whether a brāhmaṇa or someone else—suffers sin;
by this succession it should be understood, whether intentionally or unintentionally.
Expiation, birth, karma, and disease [ensue], no doubt.
A cow-killer also becomes a cow for as many years, definitely.
Four times that of these [is the punishment]: the killer of a brāhmaṇa becomes a worm in excrement;
then he becomes a mleccha for four times that number of years.

4.85.s:
tataścāndho bhavedvipraḥ pūrveṣāṃ ca caturguṇam .
brahmaṇānāṃ caturlakṣaṃ bhojayitvā śucirbhavet .. 58 ..
4.85.d:
ततश्चान्धो भवेद्विप्रः पूर्वेषां च चतुर्गुणम् ।
ब्रह्मणानां चतुर्लक्षं भोजयित्वा शुचिर्भवेत् ॥ 58 ॥
4.85.m:
Then that brāhmaṇa becomes blind, [suffering] fourfold compared to previous [births]. / Feeding four hundred thousand brāhmaṇas, he becomes pure. // 58
He becomes sighted and renowned, [cleansed] even from that severe sin. / The killer of a woman among the four varnas is, according to the Veda, also a great sinner. // 59
He reaches Kālasūtra for as many years as there are hairs on a woman's body. / Devoured by worms there, deprived of food, full of torment, // 60
the sinner then exists in the world for just as many years. / Then, through his past deeds, that sinner becomes afflicted with consumption. // 61
For one hundred years [he suffers, and then] he must feed one hundred thousand brāhmaṇas. / Then he becomes a pure brāhmaṇa, learned and restrained in austerity. // 62
He experiences a slight remnant of sin; by giving gold he becomes pure. / The killer of an embryo, a great sinner, goes to Śunīmukha // 63
for one hundred years, and certainly becomes a horse. / For one hundred years, afflicted with sharp weapons, // 64
that sinner then becomes a vaiśya possessed of wealth through [other] deeds. / Up to fifty years, by giving gold, he becomes pure. // 65
Then, born into his own lineage, he is a brāhmaṇa, free from disease and pure. / A brāhmaṇa who kills a kṣatriya, or a kṣatriya [who kills another] outside of battle, // 66
reaches Taptaśūla for a thousand years. / Boiled in molten iron, he utters cries of distress. // 67
Then he becomes a rutting elephant for one hundred years. / Then he becomes a śūdra with blood disorders for one hundred years. // 68
Freed by the gift of an elephant, that twice-born is then sickly. / A vaiśya who kills a vaiśya, a vaiśya who kills a śūdra, // 69
and a śūdra who kills a vaiśya—these surely incur equal sin. / He goes to Kṛmikuṇḍa for one hundred years. // 70
Devoured by worms and wicked, he then becomes a Kirāta. / For one hundred years he is afflicted with a worm-induced disease. // 71
Then, O Vraja, he becomes a brāhmaṇa plagued by weak digestion and full of misery,

4.85.s:
cakṣuṣmāṃśca yaśasvī ca bhavetso'pyatipātakāt .
strīghnacaturṇāṃ varṇānāṃ vede so'pyatipātakī .. 59 ..
4.85.d:
चक्षुष्मांश्च यशस्वी च भवेत्सोऽप्यतिपातकात् ।
स्त्रीघ्नचतुर्णां वर्णानां वेदे सोऽप्यतिपातकी ॥ 59 ॥

4.85.s:
kālasūtraṃ ca prāpnoti strīlomasamavarṣakam .
bhakṣitaḥ kṛmiṇā tatra nirāhāro vyathāyutaḥ .. 60 ..
4.85.d:
कालसूत्रं च प्राप्नोति स्त्रीलोमसमवर्षकम् ।
भक्षितः कृमिणा तत्र निराहारो व्यथायुतः ॥ 60 ॥

4.85.s:
tato bhavati loke ca tāvadvarṣa ca pātakī .
tataḥ pāpī bhavetso'pi yakṣmagrastaśca karmaṇā .. 61 ..
4.85.d:
ततो भवति लोके च तावद्वर्ष च पातकी ।
ततः पापी भवेत्सोऽपि यक्ष्मग्रस्तश्च कर्मणा ॥ 61 ॥

4.85.s:
varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva vipralakṣaṃ ca bhojayet .
tataḥ śuddho brāhmaṇaśca vidvāṃstapasi saṃyataḥ .. 62 ..
4.85.d:
वर्षाणां शतकं चैव विप्रलक्षं च भोजयेत् ।
ततः शुद्धो ब्राह्मणश्च विद्वांस्तपसि संयतः ॥ 62 ॥

4.85.s:
kiṃcidbhuṅakte pāpaśeṣaṃ svarṇadānācchucirbhavet .
garbhaghnaśca mahāpāpī saṃprāpnoti śunīmukham .. 63 ..
4.85.d:
किंचिद्भुङक्ते पापशेषं स्वर्णदानाच्छुचिर्भवेत् ।
गर्भघ्नश्च महापापी संप्राप्नोति शुनीमुखम् ॥ 63 ॥

4.85.s:
varṣāṇāṃ satakaṃ caiva ghoṭakaśca bhaveddhruvam .
varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva sūkṣmaśastreṇa pīḍītaḥ .. 64 ..
4.85.d:
वर्षाणां सतकं चैव घोटकश्च भवेद्ध्रुवम् ।
वर्षाणां शतकं चैव सूक्ष्मशस्त्रेण पीडीतः ॥ 64 ॥

4.85.s:
tataḥ pāpī bhavedvaiśyo dravyayukto hi kamaṃṇā .
pañcāśadvarṣaparyantaṃ svarṇadānādbhavecchuciḥ .. 65 ..
4.85.d:
ततः पापी भवेद्वैश्यो द्रव्ययुक्तो हि कमंणा ।
पञ्चाशद्वर्षपर्यन्तं स्वर्णदानाद्भवेच्छुचिः ॥ 65 ॥

4.85.s:
tataḥ svakulajāto'pi nirvyādhirbrāhmaṇaḥśuciḥ .
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaghnaśca kṣatriyo vā vinā raṇāt .. 66 ..
4.85.d:
ततः स्वकुलजातोऽपि निर्व्याधिर्ब्राह्मणःशुचिः ।
ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियघ्नश्च क्षत्रियो वा विना रणात् ॥ 66 ॥

4.85.s:
taptaśūlaṃ ca prāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam .
kvathitaṃ taptalohena cā''rtanādaṃ karoti ca .. 67 ..
4.85.d:
तप्तशूलं च प्राप्नोति वर्षाणां च सहस्रकम् ।
क्वथितं तप्तलोहेन चा'ऽर्तनादं करोति च ॥ 67 ॥

4.85.s:
tato bhavenmattagajo varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā .
tato raktavikārī ca śūdro varṣaśataṃ tathā .. 68 ..
4.85.d:
ततो भवेन्मत्तगजो वर्षाणां शतकं तथा ।
ततो रक्तविकारी च शूद्रो वर्षशतं तथा ॥ 68 ॥

4.85.s:
gajadānena muktaśca vyādhitaśca tato dvijaḥ .
vaiśyaghnaścāpi vaiśyaśca śūdraghno vaiśya eva ca .. 69 ..
4.85.d:
गजदानेन मुक्तश्च व्याधितश्च ततो द्विजः ।
वैश्यघ्नश्चापि वैश्यश्च शूद्रघ्नो वैश्य एव च ॥ 69 ॥

4.85.s:
vaiśyaghnaścāpi śūdraśca samaṃ pāpaṃ labheddhruvam .
kṛmikuṇḍaṃ ca prāpnoti varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā .. 70 ..
4.85.d:
वैश्यघ्नश्चापि शूद्रश्च समं पापं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ।
कृमिकुण्डं च प्राप्नोति वर्षाणां शतकं तथा ॥ 70 ॥

4.85.s:
kṛmibhirbhakṣito duḥśī kirātaśca bhavettataḥ .
varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva kṛmivyādhisamanvitaḥ .. 71 ..
4.85.d:
कृमिभिर्भक्षितो दुःशी किरातश्च भवेत्ततः ।
वर्षाणां शतकं चैव कृमिव्याधिसमन्वितः ॥ 71 ॥

4.85.s:
tato mandāgniyuktaśca brāhmaṇo dainyavānvraja .
pañcāśadvarṣaparyantaṃ durbalaśca kṛśodaraḥ .. 72 ..
4.85.d:
ततो मन्दाग्नियुक्तश्च ब्राह्मणो दैन्यवान्व्रज ।
पञ्चाशद्वर्षपर्यन्तं दुर्बलश्च कृशोदरः ॥ 72 ॥

4.85.s:
muktirbhavati yuktena tīrthecāśvapradānataḥ .
śūdraghno brahmaṇaścaiva kāmato'kāmato'pi vā .. 73 ..
4.85.d:
मुक्तिर्भवति युक्तेन तीर्थेचाश्वप्रदानतः ।
शूद्रघ्नो ब्रह्मणश्चैव कामतोऽकामतोऽपि वा ॥ 73 ॥

4.85.s:
sāvitrī lakṣayāpyena tadardhena śucirbhavet .
caturvarṇaḥ kukkuraghno hyabhiśaptaśca śaṃbhunā .. 74 ..
4.85.d:
सावित्री लक्षयाप्येन तदर्धेन शुचिर्भवेत् ।
चतुर्वर्णः कुक्कुरघ्नो ह्यभिशप्तश्च शंभुना ॥ 74 ॥

4.85.s:
varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva prāpnoti rauravaṃ naraḥ .
tato bhavetkukkulaśca varṣāṇāmapi ṣoḍaśa .. 75 ..
4.85.d:
वर्षाणां शतकं चैव प्राप्नोति रौरवं नरः ।
ततो भवेत्कुक्कुलश्च वर्षाणामपि षोडश ॥ 75 ॥

4.85.s:
tataḥ śuddho bhavedvipro bhakṣitaḥ kukkureṇai ca .
gaṅgāsnānena dānena svarṇasyāpi bhavecchuciḥ .. 76 ..
4.85.d:
ततः शुद्धो भवेद्विप्रो भक्षितः कुक्कुरेणै च ।
गङ्गास्नानेन दानेन स्वर्णस्यापि भवेच्छुचिः ॥ 76 ॥

4.85.s:
mārjāraghnaścaturvarṇo gaṅgāsnānādbhavecchuciḥ .
viprāya lavaṇaṃ dattvā ṣaṭpalaṃ ca pramucyate .. 77 ..
4.85.d:
मार्जारघ्नश्चतुर्वर्णो गङ्गास्नानाद्भवेच्छुचिः ।
विप्राय लवणं दत्त्वा षट्पलं च प्रमुच्यते ॥ 77 ॥

4.85.s:
hatvā sarpāṃścaturvarṇo mama pādena cihnitān .
brahmahatyācaturthaṃ ca pātakaṃ ca labheddhruvam .. 78 ..
4.85.d:
हत्वा सर्पांश्चतुर्वर्णो मम पादेन चिह्नितान् ।
ब्रह्महत्याचतुर्थं च पातकं च लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 78 ॥

4.85.s:
asipatraṃ ca narakaṃ varṣāṃṇāṃ śatakaṃ tathā .
prāpnoti yātanāyukto vicchinnastīkṣṇadhārayā .. 79 ..
4.85.d:
असिपत्रं च नरकं वर्षांणां शतकं तथा ।
प्राप्नोति यातनायुक्तो विच्छिन्नस्तीक्ष्णधारया ॥ 79 ॥

4.85.s:
tato bhavati sarpaśca ḍuṇḍubho varṣapañcakam .
nareṇa tāḍito duḥkhī mṛtyorbhavati pīḍitaḥ .. 80 ..
4.85.d:
ततो भवति सर्पश्च डुण्डुभो वर्षपञ्चकम् ।
नरेण ताडितो दुःखी मृत्योर्भवति पीडितः ॥ 80 ॥

4.85.s:
tato bhavennaraḥ pāpī jvarayukto hi durbalaḥ .
varṣāṇāṃ pañcakenaiva mṛto bhavati karmaṇā .. 81 ..
4.85.d:
ततो भवेन्नरः पापी ज्वरयुक्तो हि दुर्बलः ।
वर्षाणां पञ्चकेनैव मृतो भवति कर्मणा ॥ 81 ॥

4.85.s:
aśvaghnaśca gajaghnaśca caturvarṇaśca pātakī .
varṣāṇāṃ pañcakenaiva mṛto bhavati karmaṇā .. 82 ..
4.85.d:
अश्वघ्नश्च गजघ्नश्च चतुर्वर्णश्च पातकी ।
वर्षाणां पञ्चकेनैव मृतो भवति कर्मणा ॥ 82 ॥

4.85.s:
tato bhavati hastī ca ghoṭako vā vrajeśvara .
yāvadviṃśativarṣāṇi tataḥ śūdro bhaveddhruvam .. 83 ..
4.85.d:
ततो भवति हस्ती च घोटको वा व्रजेश्वर ।
यावद्विंशतिवर्षाणि ततः शूद्रो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 83 ॥

4.85.s:
ahaṃkṛtī vyādhiyukto raupyadānena mucyate .
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śatakaṃ bhojayitvā śucirbhavet .. 84 ..
4.85.d:
अहंकृती व्याधियुक्तो रौप्यदानेन मुच्यते ।
ब्राह्मणानां च शतकं भोजयित्वा शुचिर्भवेत् ॥ 84 ॥

4.85.s:
kṣudrajantuvadhenaiva kṣudrajanturbhavennaraḥ .
varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva kṣudravyādhiṃ tarettataḥ .. 85 ..
4.85.d:
क्षुद्रजन्तुवधेनैव क्षुद्रजन्तुर्भवेन्नरः ।
वर्षाणां शतकं चैव क्षुद्रव्याधिं तरेत्ततः ॥ 85 ॥

4.85.s:
kṛpā kāryā satā śaśvatahiṃsreṣu ca jantuṣu .
hiṃsāyāṃ na hi doṣaśca hiṃsrāṇāṃ ca vrajeśvara .. 86 ..
4.85.d:
कृपा कार्या सता शश्वतहिंस्रेषु च जन्तुषु ।
हिंसायां न हि दोषश्च हिंस्राणां च व्रजेश्वर ॥ 86 ॥
4.85.m:
weak and emaciated in belly for up to fifty years. // 72
Deliverance comes to the upright [man] by donating a horse at a holy ford. / A brāhmaṇa who kills a śūdra, whether intentionally or unintentionally, // 73
becomes pure by chanting the Sāvitrī one hundred thousand times, or half that amount. / A person of any of the four varnas who kills a dog is cursed by Śambhu. // 74
That man goes to Raurava for one hundred years. / Then he becomes a dog for sixteen years. // 75
Then he becomes a pure brāhmaṇa [after] being devoured by a dog. / By bathing in the Gaṅgā and by donating gold, he becomes pure. // 76
A person of the four varnas who kills a cat becomes pure by bathing in the Gaṅgā. / Giving six palas of salt to a brāhmaṇa, he is released. // 77
Killing snakes marked with my footprint, a person of the four varnas / surely incurs a fourth part of the sin of killing a brāhmaṇa. // 78
He goes to the Asipatra hell for one hundred years, / filled with agony, cleaved by sharp blades. // 79
Then he becomes a harmless snake for five years; / beaten by men, miserable, he is afflicted by death. // 80
Then that sinful man becomes feverish and weak; / in five years he dies due to his deeds. // 81
A person of the four varnas who kills a horse or kills an elephant is a sinner; / in five years he dies due to his deeds. // 82
Then he becomes an elephant or a horse, O lord of Vraja, / for twenty years; after that he surely becomes a śūdra, // 83
haughty and diseased; he is released by donating silver. / Feeding one hundred brāhmaṇas, he becomes pure. // 84
By killing small creatures, a man becomes a small creature. / After one hundred years he overcomes the minor afflictions. // 85
Good people should constantly show mercy to non-violent creatures; / there is no fault in harming creatures that are harmful, O lord of Vraja. // 86

4.85.s:
aśvatthaghnaścatuvaṃrṇo brahmahatyācaturthakam .
pāpaṃ ca labhate tāta cāsipatraṃ vrajeddhruvam .. 87 ..
4.85.d:
अश्वत्थघ्नश्चतुवंर्णो ब्रह्महत्याचतुर्थकम् ।
पापं च लभते तात चासिपत्रं व्रजेद्ध्रुवम् ॥ 87 ॥
4.85.m:
A person of the four varnas who destroys an aśvattha tree, dear one, / incurs a fourth part of the sin of killing a brāhmaṇa and surely goes to Asipatra. // 87
Cleaved day and night by sharp weapons, / he experiences extreme torment for one hundred years. // 88
Then he becomes a silk-cotton tree for one hundred thousand years. / Then he becomes a śūdra with mutilated limbs, beset by disease // 89
for the rest of his life. After that, he surely becomes a brāhmaṇa; / afflicted with the disease of ulcers, he is freed by a gift of gold. // 90
One who gives false witness, an ungrateful person, an extremely ungrateful person, / a betrayer of trust, a slayer of friends, one who steals the wealth of brāhmaṇas, // 91
one who eats food from a śūdra's śrāddha, one who cremates the corpse of a śūdra, / a cook for śūdras, the sinner who drives a bull, // 92
a courier, and a temple-priest—these are very great sinners. / They go to Kumbhīpāka for a thousand years. // 93
Tormented there day and night in boiling oil, / bitten and afflicted by creatures of every form, // 94
[he becomes] a vulture for tens of millions [of births], a hog for a hundred births, / a beast of prey for a hundred births; then he becomes a diseased śūdra. // 95
Afflicted with sluggish digestion and fever for fifty years, / by donating one hundred palas of gold he surely becomes pure. // 96
A man of any of the four varnas who steals clothing, steals dairy products, / steals silver or pearls, or steals the property of a śūdra, // 97
surely becomes a heron for one thousand years. / Having experienced the hell of urine for one hundred years, // 98
he then is born in a śūdra caste for one hundred years, O [lord of] Vraja, / afflicted with leprosy and festering, a sinner. // 99
Then he becomes a brāhmaṇa with the residue of leprosy; / by a gift of six palas of gold, he is freed from the affliction and made pure. // 100
One who steals vegetables or steals fruit...

4.85.s:
sa tīkṣṇenāpi śastreṇa vicchinnaśca divāniśam .
varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ caiva bhuṅkte paramayātanām .. 88 ..
4.85.d:
स तीक्ष्णेनापि शस्त्रेण विच्छिन्नश्च दिवानिशम् ।
वर्षाणां शतकं चैव भुङ्क्ते परमयातनाम् ॥ 88 ॥

4.85.s:
tato bhavati vṛkṣaśca śālamalirahvarṣalakṣakam .
tato bhavati śūdraśca cchinnāṅgo vyādhisaṃyutaḥ .. 89 ..
4.85.d:
ततो भवति वृक्षश्च शालमलिरह्वर्षलक्षकम् ।
ततो भवति शूद्रश्च च्छिन्नाङ्गो व्याधिसंयुतः ॥ 89 ॥

4.85.s:
yāvajjīvanaparyantaṃ tato vipro bhaveddhruvam .
vraṇavyādhisamāyukto mucyate svarṇadānataḥ .. 90 ..
4.85.d:
यावज्जीवनपर्यन्तं ततो विप्रो भवेद्ध्रुवम् ।
व्रणव्याधिसमायुक्तो मुच्यते स्वर्णदानतः ॥ 90 ॥

4.85.s:
mithyāsākṣyapradātā ca kṛtaghno'tikṛtaghnakaḥ .
viśvāsaghātī mitraghno viprāṇāṃ dhanahārakaḥ .. 91 ..
4.85.d:
मिथ्यासाक्ष्यप्रदाता च कृतघ्नोऽतिकृतघ्नकः ।
विश्वासघाती मित्रघ्नो विप्राणां धनहारकः ॥ 91 ॥

4.85.s:
śūdraśrāddhānnabhojī ca śūdrāṇāṃ śavadāhakaḥ .
śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakāraśca vṛṣavāhakapātakī .. 92 ..
4.85.d:
शूद्रश्राद्धान्नभोजी च शूद्राणां शवदाहकः ।
शूद्राणां सूपकारश्च वृषवाहकपातकी ॥ 92 ॥

4.85.s:
dhāvako devalaścāpi caite'tipāpinastathā .
kumbhīpākaṃ prayāntayeva varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam .. 93 ..
4.85.d:
धावको देवलश्चापि चैतेऽतिपापिनस्तथा ।
कुम्भीपाकं प्रयान्तयेव वर्षाणां च सहस्रकम् ॥ 93 ॥

4.85.s:
tatraiva taptatailena saṃtaptaśca divāniśam .
ṇakṣito vyathitaścaiva sarvākāreṇa jantunā .. 94 ..
4.85.d:
तत्रैव तप्ततैलेन संतप्तश्च दिवानिशम् ।
णक्षितो व्यथितश्चैव सर्वाकारेण जन्तुना ॥ 94 ॥

4.85.s:
gṛdhraḥ koṭisamasrāṇi śatajanmāni śūkaraḥ .
śvāpadaḥ śatajanmāni śūdro rogī bhavettataḥ .. 95 ..
4.85.d:
गृध्रः कोटिसमस्राणि शतजन्मानि शूकरः ।
श्वापदः शतजन्मानि शूद्रो रोगी भवेत्ततः ॥ 95 ॥

4.85.s:
