चन्द्र उवाच
द्विजरूपधरो धर्मस्त्वां परीक्षितुमागतः ।
ब्रह्मणा प्रेरितश्चैव निर्दोषश्च विहिंसितः ॥ 116 ॥
4.86.m: Candra said: / “Assuming the form of a twice-born, Dharma came to test you, / impelled by Brahmā; he was innocent, yet harmed.”

4.86.s:
mahendra uvāca
tapasopānjito dharmo dharmeṇa ca phalaṃ nṛpām .
kathaṃ phalaṃ ca tapasāṃ yadi dharmaḥ kṣayaṃ gataḥ .. 117 ..
4.86.d:
महेन्द्र उवाच
तपसोपान्जितो धर्मो धर्मेण च फलं नृपाम् ।
कथं फलं च तपसां यदि धर्मः क्षयं गतः ॥ 117 ॥
4.86.m: Mahendra said: / “Dharma is acquired by austerity, and by dharma comes the fruit for men. / How can there be the fruit of austerities if Dharma has perished?”

4.86.s:
varuṇa uvāca
dharmaṃ jīvaya dharmiṣṭhe dharmaṃ rakṣa sanātanam .
niṣphalaṃ karmiṇāṃ karma vinā dharmeṇā dhārmike .. 118 ..
4.86.d:
वरुण उवाच
धर्मं जीवय धर्मिष्ठे धर्मं रक्ष सनातनम् ।
निष्फलं कर्मिणां कर्म विना धर्मेणा धार्मिके ॥ 118 ॥
4.86.m: Varuṇa said: / “Revive Dharma, O most righteous woman; protect eternal dharma. / Fruitless is the rite of doers of rites without dharma, O righteous one.”

4.86.s:
pavana uvāca
jagatpūtaṃ kuru śubhe dharmaṃ jauvaya sāṃpratam .
dharme pranaṣṭe tapasāṃ tavāpūrvaṃ vinaṅkṣyati .. 119 ..
4.86.d:
पवन उवाच
जगत्पूतं कुरु शुभे धर्मं जौवय सांप्रतम् ।
धर्मे प्रनष्टे तपसां तवापूर्वं विनङ्क्ष्यति ॥ 119 ॥
4.86.m: Pavana said: / “Make the world purified, O auspicious one; revive Dharma now. / If Dharma is destroyed, the unseen merit of your austerities will perish.”

4.86.s:
vahniruvāca
svadharmopārjanaṃ kartumāgatā'si ca bhāratam .
vihaṃsi dharmamajñātvā punarjīvaya sundari .. 120 ..
4.86.d:
वह्निरुवाच
स्वधर्मोपार्जनं कर्तुमागताऽसि च भारतम् ।
विहंसि धर्ममज्ञात्वा पुनर्जीवय सुन्दरि ॥ 120 ॥
4.86.m: Vahni said: / “You have come to Bhārata to acquire your own dharma. / Without knowing, you are destroying Dharma; revive him again, O beautiful one!”

4.86.s:
yama uvāca
vedoktakarmakartaṇāsahaṃ viśve varānane .
dharmānusārātphalado dharma jīvaya satvaram .. 121 ..
4.86.d:
यम उवाच
वेदोक्तकर्मकर्तणासहं विश्वे वरानने ।
धर्मानुसारात्फलदो धर्म जीवय सत्वरम् ॥ 121 ॥
4.86.m: Yama said: / “I am the dispenser of fruits according to dharma for those who perform rites / enjoined by the Vedas in the universe, O fair-faced one; revive Dharma swiftly!”

4.86.s:
devānāṃ vacanaṃ kṣutvā samutthāya pativratā .
namaskṛtya sureśāṃścatānuvāca tapasvinī .. 122 ..
4.86.d:
देवानां वचनं क्षुत्वा समुत्थाय पतिव्रता ।
नमस्कृत्य सुरेशांश्चतानुवाच तपस्विनी ॥ 122 ॥
4.86.m: Hearing the words of the gods, the devoted wife, the ascetic woman, / rose up, bowed to the lords of the gods, and spoke to them.

4.86.s:
vṛndovāca
ahaṃ devā na jānāmi dharmaṃ brāhmaṇarūpiṇam .
kṛtaḥ kṣayo mayā kopānmāṃ parīṅitumāgataḥ .. 123 ..
4.86.d:
वृन्दोवाच
अहं देवा न जानामि धर्मं ब्राह्मणरूपिणम् ।
कृतः क्षयो मया कोपान्मां परीङितुमागतः ॥ 123 ॥
4.86.m: Vṛndā said: / “O gods, I did not know Dharma in the form of a brahmin; / he was made to perish by me in anger when he came to test me.

4.86.s:
jīvayāmi dhruvaṃ dharmaṃ yuṣmākaṃ ca prasādataḥ .
ityevamuktvā sā vṛndā cetyuvāca vpajeśvara .. 124 ..
4.86.d:
जीवयामि ध्रुवं धर्मं युष्माकं च प्रसादतः ।
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा वृन्दा चेत्युवाच व्पजेश्वर ॥ 124 ॥
4.86.m: I will certainly revive Dharma by your grace.” / Having spoken thus, that Vṛndā said, O lord of Vraja:

4.86.s:
tapaḥ satyaṃ yadi mama satyaṃ ca viṣṇupūjanam .
tena puṇyena sadyo'tra dvijo bhavatu vijvaraḥ .. 125 ..
4.86.d:
तपः सत्यं यदि मम सत्यं च विष्णुपूजनम् ।
तेन पुण्येन सद्योऽत्र द्विजो भवतु विज्वरः ॥ 125 ॥
4.86.m: “If my austerity is true, and the worship of Viṣṇu is true, / by that merit let the twice-born immediately become free of fever here!

4.86.s:
yadi me ca bhavetsatyaṃ vrataṃ satyaṃ tapaḥśuci .
tena puṇyena satyena dvijo bhao .. 126 ..
4.86.d:
यदि मे च भवेत्सत्यं व्रतं सत्यं तपःशुचि ।
तेन पुण्येन सत्येन द्विजो भओ ॥ 126 ॥
4.86.m: If my vow is true, and my pure austerity is true, / by that true merit let the twice-born [revive]!

4.86.s:
yadi nārāyaṇaḥ satyaḥ sarvātmā nityavigrahaḥ .
jñānātmakaḥ śivaḥ satyo dvijo bhao .. 127 ..
4.86.d:
यदि नारायणः सत्यः सर्वात्मा नित्यविग्रहः ।
ज्ञानात्मकः शिवः सत्यो द्विजो भओ ॥ 127 ॥
4.86.m: If Nārāyaṇa, the self of all, whose form is eternal, is true, / and Śiva, whose essence is knowledge, is true, let the twice-born [revive]!

4.86.s:
brahma satyaṃ ca te devāḥ prakṛtiḥ paramā yadi .
yajñaḥ satyastapaḥ satyaṃ dvijo bhao .. 128 ..
4.86.d:
ब्रह्म सत्यं च ते देवाः प्रकृतिः परमा यदि ।
यज्ञः सत्यस्तपः सत्यं द्विजो भओ ॥ 128 ॥
4.86.m: If Brahman is true, and those gods, and supreme Prakṛti, / and sacrifice is true, and austerity is true, let the twice-born [revive]!”

4.86.s:
ityevamuktvā sā vṛndā dharma kroḍe cakāra ca .
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca kalārūpaṃ ruroda kṛpayāsatī .. 129 ..
4.86.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा वृन्दा धर्म क्रोडे चकार च ।
तं दृष्ट्वा च कलारूपं रुरोद कृपयासती ॥ 129 ॥
4.86.m: Having spoken thus, that Vṛndā took Dharma upon her lap; / and seeing him reduced to a mere fraction, the chaste woman wept out of pity.

4.86.s:
etasminnantare mūrtirdharmabhāryā śucā''kulā .
nipatya viṣṇupāde ya śirasā cetyuvāca sā .. 130 ..
4.86.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे मूर्तिर्धर्मभार्या शुचा'ऽकुला ।
निपत्य विष्णुपादे य शिरसा चेत्युवाच सा ॥ 130 ॥
4.86.m: In the meantime, Mūrti, the wife of Dharma, agitated by grief, / fell at the feet of Viṣṇu with her head, and spoke:

4.86.s:
mūrtiruvāca
he nātha karuṇāsindho dīnabandho kṛpāṃ kuru .
tūrṇaṃ jīvaya kāntaṃ me jagannātha kṛpāmaya .. 131 ..
4.86.d:
मूर्तिरुवाच
हे नाथ करुणासिन्धो दीनबन्धो कृपां कुरु ।
तूर्णं जीवय कान्तं मे जगन्नाथ कृपामय ॥ 131 ॥
4.86.m: Mūrti said: / “O Lord, ocean of compassion, friend of the lowly, have mercy! / Swiftly revive my beloved, O Lord of the universe full of compassion!

4.86.s:
patihīnā ca yā nārī pāpinī sā bhavārṇave .
yathā''syaṃ cakṣurvirataṃ prāṇahīnā yathā tanūḥ .. 132 ..
4.86.d:
पतिहीना च या नारी पापिनी सा भवार्णवे ।
यथा'ऽस्यं चक्षुर्विरतं प्राणहीना यथा तनूः ॥ 132 ॥
4.86.m: A woman bereft of her husband is a sinner in the ocean of worldly existence, / just as a face without eyes, or a body bereft of life.

4.86.s:
mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ bhrādā mitaṃ sutaḥ .
mitaṃ bandhurmitaṃ mātā sarvadātā patiḥ prabhuḥ .. 133 ..
4.86.d:
मितं ददाति हि पिता मितं भ्रादा मितं सुतः ।
मितं बन्धुर्मितं माता सर्वदाता पतिः प्रभुः ॥ 133 ॥
4.86.m: A father gives a limited amount, a brother a limited amount, a son a limited amount; / a relative gives a limited amount, a mother a limited amount; the husband, the master, is the giver of everything.”

4.86.s:
ityevamuktvā sā devī tatra tasthau ruroda ca .
uvāca vṛndāṃ ṇagavānsarvātmā prakṛteḥ paraḥ .. 134 ..
4.86.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा देवी तत्र तस्थौ रुरोद च ।
उवाच वृन्दां णगवान्सर्वात्मा प्रकृतेः परः ॥ 134 ॥
4.86.m: Having spoken thus, that goddess stood there and wept. / The Blessed Lord, the self of all, beyond Prakṛti, spoke to Vṛndā:

4.86.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca
tvayā''yustapasā labdhaṃ yāvadāyuśca brahmaṇaḥ .
tadeva dehi dharmāya golokaṃ gaccha sundari .. 135 ..
4.86.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
त्वया'ऽयुस्तपसा लब्धं यावदायुश्च ब्रह्मणः ।
तदेव देहि धर्माय गोलोकं गच्छ सुन्दरि ॥ 135 ॥
4.86.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “The lifespan equal to the lifespan of Brahmā that was obtained by you through austerity, / give that very [lifespan] to Dharma, and go to Goloka, O beautiful one!

4.86.s:
tanvā'nayā ca tapasā paścānmāṃ ca labhiṣyasi .
paścādgolokamāgatya vārāhe ca varānane .. 136 ..
4.86.d:
तन्वाऽनया च तपसा पश्चान्मां च लभिष्यसि ।
पश्चाद्गोलोकमागत्य वाराहे च वरानने ॥ 136 ॥
4.86.m: And with this body and through this austerity, you will attain me later. / Later, having come from Goloka in the Vārāha [kalpa], O fair-faced one,

4.86.s:
vṛṣabhānasutā tvaṃ ca rādhācchāyā bhaviṣyasi .
matkalāṃśaśca rāyāṇastvāṃ vivāha grahīṣyati .. 137 ..
4.86.d:
वृषभानसुता त्वं च राधाच्छाया भविष्यसि ।
मत्कलांशश्च रायाणस्त्वां विवाह ग्रहीष्यति ॥ 137 ॥
4.86.m: you will become the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu and the shadow of Rādhā; / and Rāyāṇa, a partial incarnation of mine, will take you in marriage.

4.86.s:
māṃ labhiṣyasi rāse ca gopībhī rādhayā saha .
rādhā śrīdāmaśāpena vṛṣabhānasutā yadā .. 138 ..
4.86.d:
मां लभिष्यसि रासे च गोपीभी राधया सह ।
राधा श्रीदामशापेन वृषभानसुता यदा ॥ 138 ॥
4.86.m: You will attain me in the rāsa along with the gopīs and Rādhā, / when Rādhā, through the curse of Śrīdāman, becomes the daughter of Vṛṣabhānu.”

4.86.s:
sā caiva vāstavī rādhā tvaṃ ca cchāyāsvarupiṇī .
vivāhakāle rāyāṇastvāṃ ca cchāyāṃ grahīṣyati .. 139 ..
4.86.d:
सा चैव वास्तवी राधा त्वं च च्छायास्वरुपिणी ।
विवाहकाले रायाणस्त्वां च च्छायां ग्रहीष्यति ॥ 139 ॥
4.86.m: She alone is the real Rādhā, and you are having the nature of her shadow. / At the time of marriage, Rāyāṇa will take you, the shadow. .. 139 ..

4.86.s:
tvāṃ dattvā vāstavī rādhā sā'ntardhānā bhaviṣyati .
rādhaiveti vimūḍhāśca vijñāsyanti ..
ca gokule .. 140 ..
4.86.d:
त्वां दत्त्वा वास्तवी राधा साऽन्तर्धाना भविष्यति ।
राधैवेति विमूढाश्च विज्ञास्यन्ति ॥
च गोकुले ॥ 140 ॥
4.86.m: Having offered you, the real Rādhā will disappear; / and the bewildered people in Gokula will think: ..

4.86.s:
svapne rādhāpadāmbhojaṃ na ri paśyanti ballavāḥ .
svayaṃ rādhā mama kroḍe chāyā rāyāṇakāminī .. 141 ..
4.86.d:
स्वप्ने राधापदाम्भोजं न रि पश्यन्ति बल्लवाः ।
स्वयं राधा मम क्रोडे छाया रायाणकामिनी ॥ 141 ॥
4.86.m: Even in a dream the cowherds do not behold the lotus feet of Rādhā; / Rādhā herself remains in my embrace, [while] the shadow is Rāyāṇa's beloved. .. 141 ..

4.86.s:
viṣṇośca vacanaṃ śrutvā dadāvāyuśca sundarī .
uttasthau pūrṇa dharmaśca taptakāñcanasaṃnibhaḥ ..
pūrvasmātsundaraḥ śrīmānpraṇanāma parātparam .. 142 ..
4.86.d:
विष्णोश्च वचनं श्रुत्वा ददावायुश्च सुन्दरी ।
उत्तस्थौ पूर्ण धर्मश्च तप्तकाञ्चनसंनिभः ॥
पूर्वस्मात्सुन्दरः श्रीमान्प्रणनाम परात्परम् ॥ 142 ॥
4.86.m:
Hearing the words of Viṣṇu, the beautiful woman granted life; / and full Dharma stood up, resembling molten gold. ..
More beautiful than before, radiant, he bowed to the highest of the high. .. 142 ..

4.86.s:
vṛndovāca
devāḥ śṛṇuta madvākyaṃ durlaṅghyaṃ sāvadhānataḥ .
na hi mithyā bhavedvākyaṃ madīyaṃ ca niśāmaya .. 143 ..
4.86.d:
वृन्दोवाच
देवाः शृणुत मद्वाक्यं दुर्लङ्घ्यं सावधानतः ।
न हि मिथ्या भवेद्वाक्यं मदीयं च निशामय ॥ 143 ॥
4.86.m: Vṛndā said: / O gods, listen attentively to my inviolable word; / hear that my word indeed shall not prove false. .. 143 ..

4.86.s:
kṣayo bhaveti vākyaṃ ca mayoktaṃ kopabhītayā .
vāratrayaṃ punarvaktuṃ vārayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ .. 144 ..
4.86.d:
क्षयो भवेति वाक्यं च मयोक्तं कोपभीतया ।
वारत्रयं पुनर्वक्तुं वारयामास भास्करः ॥ 144 ॥
4.86.m: The words "Be diminished!" were uttered by me out of fear and anger; / as I was about to say them a third time, the Sun-god restrained me. .. 144 ..

4.86.s:
satye ca paripūrṇo'yaṃ yathāpūrvo yathā'dhunā .
tripādaścāpi tretāyāṃ dvāpado dvipare tathā .. 145 ..
4.86.d:
सत्ये च परिपूर्णोऽयं यथापूर्वो यथाऽधुना ।
त्रिपादश्चापि त्रेतायां द्वापदो द्विपरे तथा ॥ 145 ॥
4.86.m: In the Kṛta age he is complete, just as before and as now; / having three feet in the Tretā age, and having two feet in the Dvāpara age likewise. .. 145 ..

4.86.s:
ekapādaśca darmo'yaṃ kaleśca prathame hare .
śeṣe kalāṣoḍaśāṃśaḥ punaḥ satye yathā purā .. 146 ..
4.86.d:
एकपादश्च दर्मोऽयं कलेश्च प्रथमे हरे ।
शेषे कलाषोडशांशः पुनः सत्ये यथा पुरा ॥ 146 ॥
4.86.m: And in the first [part] of the Kali age, O Hari, this Dharma has one foot; / at the end [of Kali], a sixteenth part [remains]; then in the Kṛta age, he becomes as before. .. 146 ..

4.86.s:
trirnirgataṃ mama mukhātkṣayastena tataḥ kramāt .
punarukte ca manasi vārayāmāsa bhāskaraḥ .. 147 ..
4.86.d:
त्रिर्निर्गतं मम मुखात्क्षयस्तेन ततः क्रमात् ।
पुनरुक्ते च मनसि वारयामास भास्करः ॥ 147 ॥
4.86.m: Thrice did [words] go forth from my mouth, therefore decay [occurs] gradually from that; / when it was in my mind to say it again, the Sun-god restrained me. .. 147 ..

4.86.s:
tenaiva retunā'yaṃ ca kariśeṣe kalāmayaḥ .
tathā śaptaḥ sthito durge kaliśeṣe tathā dhruvam .. 148 ..
4.86.d:
तेनैव रेतुनाऽयं च करिशेषे कलामयः ।
तथा शप्तः स्थितो दुर्गे कलिशेषे तथा ध्रुवम् ॥ 148 ॥
4.86.m: For that very reason, at the end of the Kali age he will consist of a single part; / thus cursed, he remains in the fortress, truly so at the end of the Kali age. .. 148 ..

4.86.s:
etasminnantare nanda dadṛśurdevatā ratham .
golokādāgataṃ vegādatīva sundaraṃ śubham .. 149 ..
4.86.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नन्द ददृशुर्देवता रथम् ।
गोलोकादागतं वेगादतीव सुन्दरं शुभम् ॥ 149 ॥
4.86.m: Meanwhile, O Nanda, the deities saw a chariot, / arrived swiftly from Goloka, exceedingly beautiful and auspicious, .. 149 ..

4.86.s:
amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ hīrahārapariṣkṛtam .
maṇimāṇikyamuktābhirvastraiśca śvetacāmarai. .. 150 ..
4.86.d:
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणं हीरहारपरिष्कृतम् ।
मणिमाणिक्यमुक्ताभिर्वस्त्रैश्च श्वेतचामरै॥। 150 ॥
4.86.m: made of priceless gems, adorned with diamond garlands, / with jewels, rubies, pearls, garments, and white fly-whisks, .. 150 ..

4.86.s:
vibhūṣitaṃ bhūṣaṇauśca rucirai stanadarpaṇaiḥ .
natvā hariṃ haraṃ vṛndā brahmāṇaṃ sarvadevatāḥ .. 151 ..
4.86.d:
विभूषितं भूषणौश्च रुचिरै स्तनदर्पणैः ।
नत्वा हरिं हरं वृन्दा ब्रह्माणं सर्वदेवताः ॥ 151 ॥
4.86.m: adorned with ornaments and charming breast-mirrors. / Having bowed to Hari, Hara, Brahmā, and all the deities, .. 151 ..

4.86.s:
samāruṅya rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā golokaṃ ca jagāma sā .
devā jagmuśca svasthānaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi .. 152 ..
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo
4.86.d:
समारुङ्य रथं दृष्ट्वा गोलोकं च जगाम सा ।
देवा जग्मुश्च स्वस्थानं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 152 ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्नन्दसंओ
4.86.m: having seen and mounted the chariot, she went to Goloka. / The gods went to their own abode. What more do you wish to hear? .. 152 ..

4.87.s:
nanda uvāca
tvāṃ jñātuṃ nahi śaktāśca vedā vedaprabhuṃ svayam .
surā brahmeśaseṣādyā munisiddhādayastathā .. 1 ..
4.87.d:
नन्द उवाच
त्वां ज्ञातुं नहि शक्ताश्च वेदा वेदप्रभुं स्वयम् ।
सुरा ब्रह्मेशसेषाद्या मुनिसिद्धादयस्तथा ॥ 1 ॥
4.87.m: Now begins the eighty-seventh chapter. / Nanda said: / The Vedas themselves are not capable of knowing you, the Lord of the Vedas, / nor are the gods, Brahmā, Īśa, Śeṣa, and the others, nor likewise the sages and Siddhas. .. 1 ..

4.87.s:
ko bhavāniti vijñātuṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .
tatsarva svātmayāthārthyaṃ nirjane kathaya prabho .. 2 ..
4.87.d:
को भवानिति विज्ञातुं परं कौतूहलं मम ।
तत्सर्व स्वात्मयाथार्थ्यं निर्जने कथय प्रभो ॥ 2 ॥
4.87.m: My supreme curiosity is to know who you are; / tell all that truth of your own self in solitude, O Lord. .. 2 ..

4.87.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
etasminnantare tatra kṛṣṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ munīśvarāḥ .
ājagmuḥ sahasā vatsa jvalanto brahmatejasā .. 3 ..
4.87.d:
नारायण उवाच
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र कृष्णं द्रष्टुं मुनीश्वराः ।
आजग्मुः सहसा वत्स ज्वलन्तो ब्रह्मतेजसा ॥ 3 ॥
4.87.m: Nārāyaṇa said: / Meanwhile there, O child, the lordly sages came all at once to see Kṛṣṇa, / blazing with the splendour of Brahman: .. 3 ..

4.87.s:
pulahaśca pulastyaśca kratuśca bhṛguraṅgirāḥ .
pracetāśca vasiṣṭhaśca durvāsāḥ kaṇva eva ca .. 4 ..
4.87.d:
पुलहश्च पुलस्त्यश्च क्रतुश्च भृगुरङ्गिराः ।
प्रचेताश्च वसिष्ठश्च दुर्वासाः कण्व एव च ॥ 4 ॥
4.87.m: Pulaha, Pulastya, Kratu, Bhṛgu, Aṅgiras, / Pracetas, Vasiṣṭha, Durvāsas, and Kaṇva, .. 4 ..

4.87.s:
kātyāyanaḥ pāṇiniśca kaṇādo gautamastathā .
sanakaśca sanandaśca dṛtīyaśca sanātanaḥ .. 5 ..
4.87.d:
कात्यायनः पाणिनिश्च कणादो गौतमस्तथा ।
सनकश्च सनन्दश्च दृतीयश्च सनातनः ॥ 5 ॥
4.87.m: Kātyāyana, Pāṇini, Kaṇāda, and Gautama, / Sanaka, Sananda, and the third, Sanātana, .. 5 ..

4.87.s:
kapilaścā''suriścaiva vāyuḥ pañcaśikhastathā .
viśvāmitro vālmīkiśca kaśyapaśca parāśaraḥ .. 6 ..
4.87.d:
कपिलश्चा'ऽसुरिश्चैव वायुः पञ्चशिखस्तथा ।
विश्वामित्रो वाल्मीकिश्च कश्यपश्च पराशरः ॥ 6 ॥
4.87.m: Kapila, Āsuri, Vāyu, Pañcaśikha, / Viśvāmitra, Vālmīki, Kaśyapa, and Parāśara, .. 6 ..

4.87.s:
vibhāṇḍako marīciśca śukrau'triśca bṛhaspatiḥ .
gārgyaśyāpi tathā vātsyo vyāsaśca jaiministathā .. 7 ..
4.87.d:
विभाण्डको मरीचिश्च शुक्रौऽत्रिश्च बृहस्पतिः ।
गार्ग्यश्यापि तथा वात्स्यो व्यासश्च जैमिनिस्तथा ॥ 7 ॥
4.87.m: Vibhāṇḍaka, Marīci, Śukra, Atri, Bṛhaspati, / Gārgya, and likewise Vātsya, Vyāsa, and Jaimini, .. 7 ..

4.87.s:
mitavāgṛṣyaśṛṅgaśca yājñavalkyaḥ śukastathā .
saubhariḥ śuddhajaṭilo bharadvājaḥ subhadrakaḥ .. 8 ..
4.87.d:
मितवागृष्यशृङ्गश्च याज्ञवल्क्यः शुकस्तथा ।
सौभरिः शुद्धजटिलो भरद्वाजः सुभद्रकः ॥ 8 ॥
4.87.m: the soft-spoken Ṛṣyaśṛṅga, Yājñavalkya, Śuka, / Saubhari, Śuddhajaṭila, Bharadvāja, Subhadraka, .. 8 ..

4.87.s:
mārkaṇḍeyo lomaśaśca āsuriśca viṭaṅkaṇaḥ .
aṣṭāvakra śatānando vāmadeśca bhāsuriḥ .. 9 ..
4.87.d:
मार्कण्डेयो लोमशश्च आसुरिश्च विटङ्कणः ।
अष्टावक्र शतानन्दो वामदेश्च भासुरिः ॥ 9 ॥
4.87.m: Mārkaṇḍeya, Lomaśa, Āsuri, Viṭaṅkaṇa, / Aṣṭāvakra, Śatānanda, Vāmadeva, Bhāsuri, .. 9 ..

4.87.s:
saṃvartaścāpyutathyaśca naro'haṃ cāpi nārada .
jābāliḥ parśurāmaścāpyagastyaḥ paila eva ca .. 10 ..
4.87.d:
संवर्तश्चाप्युतथ्यश्च नरोऽहं चापि नारद ।
जाबालिः पर्शुरामश्चाप्यगस्त्यः पैल एव च ॥ 10 ॥
4.87.m: Saṃvarta, Utathya, Nara, and I myself, O Nārada, / Jābāli, Paraśurāma, Agastya, and Paila, .. 10 ..

4.87.s:
yudhāmanyurgau ramukho'pyupamanyuḥ śrṛtaśravāḥ .
maitreyaścyavanaścaiva vararucyarṣireva ca .. 11 ..
4.87.d:
युधामन्युर्गौ रमुखोऽप्युपमन्युः श्रृतश्रवाः ।
मैत्रेयश्च्यवनश्चैव वररुच्यर्षिरेव च ॥ 11 ॥
4.87.m: Yudhāmanyu, Gauramukha, Upamanyu, Śrutaśravas, / Maitreya, Cyavana, and the sage Vararuci. .. 11 ..

4.87.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya namaskṛtya puṭāñjaliḥ .
siṃhāsaneṣu ramyeṣu vāsayāmāsa sādaram .. 12 ..
4.87.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा सहसोत्थाय नमस्कृत्य पुटाञ्जलिः ।
सिंहासनेषु रम्येषु वासयामास सादरम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.87.m: Seeing them, rising up at once and bowing with folded hands, / he respectfully seated them on delightful thrones. .. 12 ..

4.87.s:
pūjayāmāsa vidhivatkuśalapraśnapūrvakam .
parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣya madhye kṛṣṇa uvāsa saḥ .. 13 ..
4.87.d:
पूजयामास विधिवत्कुशलप्रश्नपूर्वकम् ।
परस्परं च संभाष्य मध्ये कृष्ण उवास सः ॥ 13 ॥
4.87.m: He honoured them according to the rules, preceded by inquiries after their welfare; / and conversing with one another, Kṛṣṇa sat in their midst. .. 13 ..

4.87.s:
etasminnantare kṛṣṇastejorāśiṃ dadarśa saḥ .
daduśuste ca munayo'pyākāśe ca samujjvalam .. 14 ..
4.87.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कृष्णस्तेजोराशिं ददर्श सः ।
ददुशुस्ते च मुनयोऽप्याकाशे च समुज्ज्वलम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.87.m: Meanwhile, Kṛṣṇa saw a mass of light; / and those sages too saw it blazing brightly in the sky. .. 14 ..

4.87.s:
tejaso'bhyantare vatsa kumāraṃ kanakaprabhām .
yathaiva pañcavarṣīyaṃ nagnaṃ bālakamīpsitam .. 15 ..
4.87.d:
तेजसोऽभ्यन्तरे वत्स कुमारं कनकप्रभाम् ।
यथैव पञ्चवर्षीयं नग्नं बालकमीप्सितम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.87.m: Within that light, O child, [was] Kumāra of golden splendour, / like an alluring five-year-old naked child. .. 15 ..

4.87.s:
āvirbabhūva sahasā samāmadhye ca nārada .
uttiṣṭamānaṃ sahasā taṃ dṛṣṭvā munapuṃgavāḥ .. 16 ..
4.87.d:
आविर्बभूव सहसा समामध्ये च नारद ।
उत्तिष्टमानं सहसा तं दृष्ट्वा मुनपुंगवाः ॥ 16 ॥
4.87.m: He appeared suddenly in the midst of the assembly, O Nārada. / Seeing him suddenly standing up, the foremost sages .. 16 ..

4.87.s:
praṇemurmunayaḥ sarve śauriśca praṇanāma tam .
sasmitaṃ snigdhanetraṃ cakṛtvā yuktiṃ ca sādaram .. 17 ..
4.87.d:
प्रणेमुर्मुनयः सर्वे शौरिश्च प्रणनाम तम् ।
सस्मितं स्निग्धनेत्रं चकृत्वा युक्तिं च सादरम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.87.m: bowed down, all the sages; and Śauri bowed to him, / making smiling and affectionate eyes, joining his hands respectfully. .. 17 ..

4.87.s:
sa sarvānāśiṣaṃ kṛtvā samuvāsa ca saṃsadi .
uvāca tāṃśca śauriṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 18 ..
4.87.d:
स सर्वानाशिषं कृत्वा समुवास च संसदि ।
उवाच तांश्च शौरिं च भगवन्तं सनातनम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.87.m: Having blessed everyone, he sat in the assembly / and spoke to them and to Śauri, the eternal Blessed One. .. 18 ..

4.87.s:
sanatkumāra uvāca
bhadraṃ vo munayaḥ śaśvattapasāṃ phalamīpsitam .
kṛṣṇasya kuśalapraśnaṃ sivabījasya niṣphalam .. 19 ..
4.87.d:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
भद्रं वो मुनयः शश्वत्तपसां फलमीप्सितम् ।
कृष्णस्य कुशलप्रश्नं सिवबीजस्य निष्फलम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.87.m: Sanatkumāra said: / May there be welfare to you, O sages! Forever [you have] the desired fruit of your austerities. / An inquiry about Kṛṣṇa's welfare, the seed of auspiciousness, is pointless. .. 19 ..

4.87.s:
sāṃprataṃ kuśulaṃ vaśca darśanaṃ paramātmanaḥ .
bhaktānurodhāddehasya parasya prakṛterapi .. 20 ..
4.87.d:
सांप्रतं कुशुलं वश्च दर्शनं परमात्मनः ।
भक्तानुरोधाद्देहस्य परस्य प्रकृतेरपि ॥ 20 ॥
4.87.m: At present your welfare is the sight of the Paramātman, / who, out of regard for his devotees, has taken a body beyond even Prakṛti, .. 20 ..

4.87.s:
nirguṇāsya nirīhasya sarvabījasya teyasā .
bhārāvataraṇāyaiva cā''virbhūtasya sāṃpratam .. 21 ..
4.87.d:
निर्गुणास्य निरीहस्य सर्वबीजस्य तेयसा ।
भारावतरणायैव चा'ऽविर्भूतस्य सांप्रतम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.87.m: who is devoid of the gunas, desireless, the seed of all through his splendour, / and who has now manifested solely to remove the burden [of the earth]. .. 21 ..

4.87.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
śarīradhāriṇaścāpi kuśalapraśnamīpsitam .
tatkathaṃ kuśalapraśnaṃ mayi vipra na vidyate .. 22 ..
4.87.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
शरीरधारिणश्चापि कुशलप्रश्नमीप्सितम् ।
तत्कथं कुशलप्रश्नं मयि विप्र न विद्यते ॥ 22 ॥
4.87.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / For one who bears a body, an inquiry after welfare is desired. / Why then, O brahmin, should an inquiry after welfare not apply to me? .. 22 ..

4.87.s:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śarīre prākṛte nātha saṃtataṃ ca śubhāśubham .
nityadehe kṣemabīje śivapraśnamanarthakam .. 23 ..
4.87.d:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
शरीरे प्राकृते नाथ संततं च शुभाशुभम् ।
नित्यदेहे क्षेमबीजे शिवप्रश्नमनर्थकम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.87.m: Sanatkumāra said: / In a material body, O Lord, good and evil constantly exist; / but in an eternal body, the seed of safety, an inquiry after auspiciousness is meaningless. .. 23 ..

4.87.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca
yo yo vigrahadhārī ca sa ca prākṛtikaḥ smṛtāḥ .
deho na vidyate vipra tāṃ nityāṃ prākṛtiṃ vinā .. 24 ..
4.87.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
यो यो विग्रहधारी च स च प्राकृतिकः स्मृताः ।
देहो न विद्यते विप्र तां नित्यां प्राकृतिं विना ॥ 24 ॥
4.87.m: The Blessed One said: / Whoever possesses a form is remembered as material. / O brahmin, a body does not exist without that eternal Prakṛti. .. 24 ..

4.87.s:
sanatkumāra uvāca
raktabindūdbhavā dehāste ca prākṛtikā smṛtāḥ .
kathaṃ prakṛtināthasya bījasya prākṛtaṃ vapuḥ .. 25 ..
4.87.d:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
रक्तबिन्दूद्भवा देहास्ते च प्राकृतिका स्मृताः ।
कथं प्रकृतिनाथस्य बीजस्य प्राकृतं वपुः ॥ 25 ॥
4.87.m: Sanatkumāra said: / Bodies born from drops of blood are considered material; / how can the form of the master of Prakṛti, the seed, be material? .. 25 ..

4.87.s:
sarvabījasya sarvādirbhavāṃśca bhagavānsvayam .
sarveṣāmavatāraṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam .. 26 ..
4.87.d:
सर्वबीजस्य सर्वादिर्भवांश्च भगवान्स्वयम् ।
सर्वेषामवतारणां प्रधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.87.m: You are the seed of all, the source of all, the Blessed One himself, / the primal, imperishable seed of all incarnations. .. 26 ..

4.87.s:
kṛtvā vadanti vedāśca nityaṃ satyaṃ sanātanam .
jyotiḥsvarūpaṃ pradhānaṃ bījamavyayam .. 27 ..
4.87.d:
कृत्वा वदन्ति वेदाश्च नित्यं सत्यं सनातनम् ।
ज्योतिःस्वरूपं प्रधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.87.m: Having investigated, the Vedas proclaim you to be eternal, true, and without beginning, / having the nature of light, the primal, imperishable seed. .. 27 ..

4.87.s:
māyayā saguṇaṃ caiva māyeśaṃ nirguṇaṃ param .
pravadanti ca vedāṅgāstathā vedavidaḥ prabho .. 28 ..
4.87.d:
मायया सगुणं चैव मायेशं निर्गुणं परम् ।
प्रवदन्ति च वेदाङ्गास्तथा वेदविदः प्रभो ॥ 28 ॥
4.87.m: With the gunas through Māyā, and the Lord of Māyā, beyond the gunas, supreme, / so the auxiliary branches of the Vedas and the knowers of the Vedas proclaim, O Lord. .. 28 ..

4.87.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
saṃprataṃ vāsudevo'haṃ raktapīryāśritaṃ vapuḥ .
kathaṃ na prakṛto vipra śivapraśnamabhīpsitam .. 29 ..
4.87.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
संप्रतं वासुदेवोऽहं रक्तपीर्याश्रितं वपुः ।
कथं न प्रकृतो विप्र शिवप्रश्नमभीप्सितम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.87.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'At present, I am Vāsudeva, a body resting upon blood and semen. / How am I not material, O twice-born? This is the desired question of Śiva.'

4.87.s:
sanatkumāra uvāca
vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvāni yasya lomasu .
tasya devaḥ paraṃ brahma vāsudeva itīritaḥ .. 30 ..
4.87.d:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
वासुः सर्वनिवासश्च विश्वानि यस्य लोमसु ।
तस्य देवः परं ब्रह्म वासुदेव इतीरितः ॥ 30 ॥
4.87.m: Sanatkumāra said: / '"Vāsu" means the dwelling of all, on whose body hairs all the universes rest. / His Lord is the supreme Brahman; therefore He is called Vāsudeva.

4.87.s:
vāsudeveti tannāma vedeṣu ca caturṣu ca .
purāṇeṣvitihāseṣu yātrādiṣu ca dṛśyate .. 31 ..
4.87.d:
वासुदेवेति तन्नाम वेदेषु च चतुर्षु च ।
पुराणेष्वितिहासेषु यात्रादिषु च दृश्यते ॥ 31 ॥
4.87.m: That name Vāsudeva is seen in the four Vedas, / in the Purāṇas, in the Itihāsas, and in sacred journeys and rituals.

4.87.s:
raktavīryāśrito dehaḥ kva te vede nirūpitaḥ .
sākṣiṇo munayaścaiva dharmaḥ sarvatra eva ca .. 32 ..
4.87.d:
रक्तवीर्याश्रितो देहः क्व ते वेदे निरूपितः ।
साक्षिणो मुनयश्चैव धर्मः सर्वत्र एव च ॥ 32 ॥
4.87.m: Where in the Veda is Your body defined as resting upon blood and semen? / The sages and Dharma everywhere are indeed witnesses;

4.87.s: sākṣiṇo mama vedāśca ravicandau ca saṃpratam .. 33 ..
4.87.d: साक्षिणो मम वेदाश्च रविचन्दौ च संप्रतम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.87.m: and the Vedas, the sun, and the moon are presently my witnesses.'

4.87.s:
bhṛguruvāca
satyaṃ vadasi tvameva vaiṣṇavāgraṇīḥ .
svāgataṃ kuśalaṃ śaśvatkiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ .. 34 ..
4.87.d:
भृगुरुवाच
सत्यं वदसि त्वमेव वैष्णवाग्रणीः ।
स्वागतं कुशलं शश्वत्किंनिमित्तमिहा'ऽगतः ॥ 34 ॥
4.87.m: Bhṛgu said: / 'You speak the truth; you are indeed foremost among Vaiṣṇavas. / Welcome, may you be well always! For what reason have you come here?'

4.87.s:
sanatkumāra uvāca
śrūyatāṃ munayaḥ sarve śrūyatāṃ kṛṣṇa sāṃpratam .
aho yena nimittena cātiśīghramihā''gataḥ .. 35 ..
4.87.d:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
श्रूयतां मुनयः सर्वे श्रूयतां कृष्ण सांप्रतम् ।
अहो येन निमित्तेन चातिशीघ्रमिहा'ऽगतः ॥ 35 ॥
4.87.m: Sanatkumāra said: / 'Listen, all sages! Listen now, O Kṛṣṇa! / Ah, for what reason I have come here in great haste.'

4.87.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
bhagavanmarvadharmajña kiṃnimittamihā''gataḥ .
sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvajña tvameva viduṣāṃ varaḥ .. 36 ..
4.87.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
भगवन्मर्वधर्मज्ञ किंनिमित्तमिहा'ऽगतः ।
सर्वं जानासि सर्वज्ञ त्वमेव विदुषां वरः ॥ 36 ॥
4.87.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'O lord, knower of all dharma, for what reason have you come here? / You know all, O omniscient one; you alone are the best among the learned.'

4.87.s:
sanatkumāra uvāca
dhanyo'si bhagavañchaśvanmānyo'si jagatāmapi .
sarveśvareśvaro'si tvaṃ tatparo nāsti viśvataḥ .. 37 ..
4.87.d:
सनत्कुमार उवाच
धन्योऽसि भगवञ्छश्वन्मान्योऽसि जगतामपि ।
सर्वेश्वरेश्वरोऽसि त्वं तत्परो नास्ति विश्वतः ॥ 37 ॥
4.87.m: Sanatkumāra said: / 'You are blessed, O Lord, always revered even by the worlds! / You are the Lord of all lords; there is none beyond Him in the universe.'

4.87.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
yajñānāṃ ca vratānāṃ ca tapasyānāṃ dvijeśvara.
satataṃ phaladātā'haṃ dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ya .. 38 ..
4.87.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
यज्ञानां च व्रतानां च तपस्यानां द्विजेश्वर।
सततं फलदाताऽहं दक्षिणाभिः सहेति य ॥ 38 ॥
4.87.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Of sacrifices, vows, and austerities, O lord of twice-born, / I am always the giver of fruits together with the priestly fees.'

4.87.s:
iti śrutvā kumāraśca javena prayayau vane .
matvā''ścarya ca vacanaṃ vārayāmāsa te'pitam .. 39 ..
4.87.d:
इति श्रुत्वा कुमारश्च जवेन प्रययौ वने ।
मत्वा'ऽश्चर्य च वचनं वारयामास तेऽपितम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.87.m: Hearing this, Kumāra went swiftly into the forest. / Considering His speech an wonder, he stopped what he had spoken.

4.87.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
he siddhendra mahābhāga kumāra karuṇāmaya .
kā śaṅkitakathā proktā bhagavatkṛṣṇasaṃnidhau .. 40 ..
4.87.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः
हे सिद्धेन्द्र महाभाग कुमार करुणामय ।
का शङ्कितकथा प्रोक्ता भगवत्कृष्णसंनिधौ ॥ 40 ॥
4.87.m: The sages said: / 'O lord of Siddhas, most fortunate one, Kumāra, full of compassion! / What doubtful matter was spoken in the presence of the blessed Kṛṣṇa?

4.87.s:
kiṃ putra dṛṣṭamāścarya śrutaṃ kimapi kutracit .
atīva kṛtvā vistīrṇamasmākaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 41 ..
4.87.d:
किं पुत्र दृष्टमाश्चर्य श्रुतं किमपि कुत्रचित् ।
अतीव कृत्वा विस्तीर्णमस्माकं वक्तुमर्हसि ॥ 41 ॥
4.87.m: What wonder was seen, O son, or what was heard anywhere? / You should explain it to us in great detail.'

4.87.s:
eta sminnnatare brahmā pārvatyā saha śaṃkaraḥ .
anantaścāpi dharmaśca śrīsūryaśca niśākaraḥ .. 42 ..
4.87.d:
एत स्मिन्न्नतरे ब्रह्मा पार्वत्या सह शंकरः ।
अनन्तश्चापि धर्मश्च श्रीसूर्यश्च निशाकरः ॥ 42 ॥
4.87.m: In the meantime, Brahmā, Śaṅkara together with Pārvatī, / Ananta, Dharma, the glorious Sūrya, and the Moon,

4.87.s:
ādityā vasavo rudrā dikpālādyāśca devatāḥ .
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sahasotthāya saṃbhādhya capṛthakpṛthaku .. 43 ..
4.87.d:
आदित्या वसवो रुद्रा दिक्पालाद्याश्च देवताः ।
श्रीकृष्णः सहसोत्थाय संभाध्य चपृथक्पृथकु ॥ 43 ॥
4.87.m: the Ādityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, and the deities headed by the guardians of the directions [arrived]. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa, rising suddenly, addressed them each individually;

4.87.s:
madhuparkādikaṃ dattvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .
praṇesurṛṣayaḥ sarve śeṣaṃ śaṃbhuṃ vidhiṃ śivām .. 44 ..
4.87.d:
मधुपर्कादिकं दत्त्वा पूजयामास भक्तितः ।
प्रणेसुरृषयः सर्वे शेषं शंभुं विधिं शिवाम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.87.m: having offered the honey-mixture and other honors, He worshipped them with devotion. / All the sages bowed down to Śeṣa, Śambhu, Vidhi, and Śivā.

4.87.s:
parasparaṃ ca saṃbhāṣā babhūva dvijadevayoḥ .
samuvāsā''sane madhye kumāraḥ kanakaprabhaḥ ..
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe saṃsadi dvijadevayoḥ .. 45 ..
4.87.d:
परस्परं च संभाषा बभूव द्विजदेवयोः ।
समुवासा'ऽसने मध्ये कुमारः कनकप्रभः ॥
कथां कथितुमारेभे संसदि द्विजदेवयोः ॥ 45 ॥
4.87.m:
A conversation took place between the twice-born and the gods. / Kumāra, radiant as gold, sat down upon a seat in their midst,
and began to speak these words in the assembly of twice-born and gods:

4.87.s:
mayā gataśca goloko na dṛṣṭo rādhikāpatiḥ .
tato gataṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ tatra nāsti caturbhujaḥ .. 46 ..
4.87.d:
मया गतश्च गोलोको न दृष्टो राधिकापतिः ।
ततो गतं च वैकुण्ठं तत्र नास्ति चतुर्भुजः ॥ 46 ॥
4.87.m: 'I went to Goloka, but the lord of Rādhikā was not seen. / Then I went to Vaikuṇṭha; the four-armed Lord was not there.

4.87.s:
tato gataśca kṣīrodastatra nāsti hariḥ svayam .
pariśrānto viṣaṇṇaśca snātaṃ kṣīrodadhestaṭe .. 47 ..
4.87.d:
ततो गतश्च क्षीरोदस्तत्र नास्ति हरिः स्वयम् ।
परिश्रान्तो विषण्णश्च स्नातं क्षीरोदधेस्तटे ॥ 47 ॥
4.87.m: Then I went to the Ocean of Milk; Hari Himself was not there. / Weary and despondent, I bathed on the shore of the Ocean of Milk.

4.87.s:
vistīrṇavālukāmadhye kacchapaḥ śatayojanaḥ .
bhītaśca kampitastatra dṛṣṭo duḥkhī ca śuṣkitaḥ .. 48 ..
4.87.d:
विस्तीर्णवालुकामध्ये कच्छपः शतयोजनः ।
भीतश्च कम्पितस्तत्र दृष्टो दुःखी च शुष्कितः ॥ 48 ॥
4.87.m: In the midst of the vast sand, a tortoise of a hundred yojanas, / frightened, trembling, distressed, and dried up, was seen there,

4.87.s:
niḥsārito rāghaveṇa mīnena ca mahātmanā .
dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca nāhaṃ dhanya uvāca saḥ .. 49 ..
4.87.d:
निःसारितो राघवेण मीनेन च महात्मना ।
धन्योऽसीति मयोक्तश्च नाहं धन्य उवाच सः ॥ 49 ॥
4.87.m: cast out by a rāghava fish, that mighty creature. / "You are blessed!" said I, but he said: "I am not blessed.

4.87.s:
kṣīrodaḥ sāgaro dhanyo jantavo yatra madvidhāḥ .
matto mahattarāścāpi hyasaṃkhyāśca mahāmune .. 50 ..
4.87.d:
क्षीरोदः सागरो धन्यो जन्तवो यत्र मद्विधाः ।
मत्तो महत्तराश्चापि ह्यसंख्याश्च महामुने ॥ 50 ॥
4.87.m: The Ocean of Milk is blessed, wherein creatures like me / and countlessly greater than me exist, O great sage!"

4.87.s:
bhavāndhanyo'sti kṣīroda tenokto nāhameva ca .
dhanyā vasuṃdharā devī yatraiva saptasāgarāḥ .. 51 ..
4.87.d:
भवान्धन्योऽस्ति क्षीरोद तेनोक्तो नाहमेव च ।
धन्या वसुंधरा देवी यत्रैव सप्तसागराः ॥ 51 ॥
4.87.m: Said [by me], "You are blessed, O Ocean of Milk," he said, "Not I indeed! / Blessed is the goddess Earth, upon whom are the seven oceans."

4.87.s:
dhanyā'si vasudhetyuktā nāhamevetyuvāca sā .
dhanyo'nanto mamā''dhāraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo nāgarāḍvibhuḥ .. 52 ..
4.87.d:
धन्याऽसि वसुधेत्युक्ता नाहमेवेत्युवाच सा ।
धन्योऽनन्तो ममा'ऽधारः कृष्णांशो नागराड्विभुः ॥ 52 ॥
4.87.m: Said, "You are blessed, O Earth," she said, "Not I indeed! / Blessed is Ananta, my support, a portion of Kṛṣṇa, the all-pervading king of serpents.

4.87.s:
mahasramūrdhnā madhye'haṃ mūrdhni śūrpe ca sarṣapaḥ .
dhanyo'si śeṣetyukto'yaṃ dhanyo nāhamuvāca vai .. 53 ..
4.87.d:
महस्रमूर्ध्ना मध्येऽहं मूर्ध्नि शूर्पे च सर्षपः ।
धन्योऽसि शेषेत्युक्तोऽयं धन्यो नाहमुवाच वै ॥ 53 ॥
4.87.m: Upon his thousand heads, I am in the middle like a mustard seed on a winnowing basket." / Said, "You are blessed, O Śeṣa," he said, "I am truly not blessed.

4.87.s:
dhanyaḥ kūrmo mamā''dhāro gaccha tatraiva vai mune .
dhanyo'si kūrmetyukto'yaṃ nāraṃ dhanyo'smi vai mune .. 54 ..
4.87.d:
धन्यः कूर्मो ममा'ऽधारो गच्छ तत्रैव वै मुने ।
धन्योऽसि कूर्मेत्युक्तोऽयं नारं धन्योऽस्मि वै मुने ॥ 54 ॥
4.87.m: Blessed is the tortoise, my support; go right there, O sage!" / Said, "You are blessed, O Tortoise," he said, "Truly I am not blessed, O sage.

4.87.s:
vāyunā dhāryamāṇo'haṃ matto dhanyatamaśca saḥ .
dhanyo'sītyuktaḥ pavano dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ .. 55 ..
4.87.d:
वायुना धार्यमाणोऽहं मत्तो धन्यतमश्च सः ।
धन्योऽसीत्युक्तः पवनो धन्यो नाहमुवाच सः ॥ 55 ॥
4.87.m: I am sustained by the wind; he is far more blessed than I." / Said, "You are blessed," the Wind said, "I am not blessed.

4.87.s:
dhanyaśca bhagavānbrahmā vidhātā jagatāmapi .
dhanyo'si tatra dhātā ca dhanyo nāhamuvācasaḥ .. 56 ..
4.87.d:
धन्यश्च भगवान्ब्रह्मा विधाता जगतामपि ।
धन्योऽसि तत्र धाता च धन्यो नाहमुवाचसः ॥ 56 ॥
4.87.m: Blessed is the blessed Brahmā, the creator of the worlds." / Said there, "You are blessed, O Creator," he said, "I am not blessed.

4.87.s:
dhanyo maheśvaro devo yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ .
sarvārādhyaḥ sarvapūjyo dharmarūpaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 57 ..
4.87.d:
धन्यो महेश्वरो देवो योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ।
सर्वाराध्यः सर्वपूज्यो धर्मरूपः सनातनः ॥ 57 ॥
4.87.m: Blessed is the god Maheśvara, the guru of the gurus among lords of yogins, / adored by all, worshipful to all, the eternal embodiment of dharma,

4.87.s:
kālakālaśca saṃhartā svayaṃ mṛtyuṃjayaḥ prabhuḥ .
dhanyo'si tatra śaṃbhuśca dhanyo nāhamuvāca saḥ .. 58 ..
4.87.d:
कालकालश्च संहर्ता स्वयं मृत्युंजयः प्रभुः ।
धन्योऽसि तत्र शंभुश्च धन्यो नाहमुवाच सः ॥ 58 ॥
4.87.m: the death of death, the destroyer, the lord Mṛtyuñjaya Himself." / Said there, "You are blessed, O Śambhu," he said, "I am not blessed.

4.87.s:
sarvādau pūjanaṃ yasya jñānināṃ ca gurorguruḥ .
dhanyo gaṇeśvaro devo devānāṃ pravaraḥ paraḥ .. 59 ..
4.87.d:
सर्वादौ पूजनं यस्य ज्ञानिनां च गुरोर्गुरुः ।
धन्यो गणेश्वरो देवो देवानां प्रवरः परः ॥ 59 ॥
4.87.m: The one whose worship is foremost of all, the guru of the gurus among the wise, / blessed is the god Gaṇeśvara, the best and highest among gods.

4.87.s:
siddhendreṣu munīndreṣu devendreṣu śrutau śrutam .
yogīndreṣu ca prājñeṣu na gaṇeśātparaḥ pumān .. 60 ..
4.87.d:
सिद्धेन्द्रेषु मुनीन्द्रेषु देवेन्द्रेषु श्रुतौ श्रुतम् ।
योगीन्द्रेषु च प्राज्ञेषु न गणेशात्परः पुमान् ॥ 60 ॥
4.87.m: Among lords of Siddhas, lords of sages, and lords of gods, it is heard in the Veda / that among lords of yogins and the wise, there is no person higher than Gaṇeśa.

4.87.s:
nimnagāsu yathā gaṅagā tīrtheṣu puṣkaraṃ yathā .
vedapraṇihito dharmo hyadharmastadviparyayaḥ .. 61 ..
4.87.d:
निम्नगासु यथा गङगा तीर्थेषु पुष्करं यथा ।
वेदप्रणिहितो धर्मो ह्यधर्मस्तद्विपर्ययः ॥ 61 ॥
4.87.m: Just as the Gaṅgā is among rivers, just as Puṣkara is among sacred places, / so dharma is that which is ordained by the Veda, and adharma is its opposite.

4.87.s:
vedo nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣādvayaṃ pūjyā vyavasthayā .
tasmācchāstrāṇi sarvāṇi purāṇāni ca santi vai .. 62 ..
4.87.d:
वेदो नारायणः साक्षाद्वयं पूज्या व्यवस्थया ।
तस्माच्छास्त्राणि सर्वाणि पुराणानि च सन्ति वै ॥ 62 ॥
4.87.m: The Veda is Nārāyaṇa directly; we are worshipful according to its ordinance. / From it arise all the scriptures and the Purāṇas.

4.87.s:
yasmānnirūpito dharmaścetihāsaśca saṃhitā .
tasmāddhanyāśca te vedā vadantyatra manīṣiṇāḥ .. 63 ..
4.87.d:
यस्मान्निरूपितो धर्मश्चेतिहासश्च संहिता ।
तस्माद्धन्याश्च ते वेदा वदन्त्यत्र मनीषिणाः ॥ 63 ॥
4.87.m: Since dharma, the Itihāsa, and the Saṃhitā are established by it, / therefore those Vedas are blessed," so the wise say here.

4.87.s:
yūyaṃ dhanyāśca mānyāścetyuktā vedā mayā tataḥ .
ūyuste na vayaṃ dhanyā yajñasaṃghaśya sāṃpratam .. 64 ..
4.87.d:
यूयं धन्याश्च मान्याश्चेत्युक्ता वेदा मया ततः ।
ऊयुस्ते न वयं धन्या यज्ञसंघश्य सांप्रतम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.87.m: Then, addressed by me: "You are blessed and worthy of honor," the Vedas / said: "We are not blessed; the multitude of sacrifices [is now].

4.87.s:
vayaṃ vyavasthākartāro yajñaughaḥ phaladaḥ svayam .
tasmāddhanyaḥ sa evāpi gaccha gaccha mahāmune .. 65 ..
4.87.d:
वयं व्यवस्थाकर्तारो यज्ञौघः फलदः स्वयम् ।
तस्माद्धन्यः स एवापि गच्छ गच्छ महामुने ॥ 65 ॥
4.87.m: We are the makers of the ordinance; the assembly of sacrifices itself gives the fruit. / Therefore, that alone is blessed. Go, go, O great sage!"

4.87.s:
dhanyo'si yajñasaṃgho'sītyuktastatra mayā vibho .
ūcuste na vayaṃ dhanyā dhanyaṃ karma śubhaṃ mune .. 66 ..
4.87.d:
धन्योऽसि यज्ञसंघोऽसीत्युक्तस्तत्र मया विभो ।
ऊचुस्ते न वयं धन्या धन्यं कर्म शुभं मुने ॥ 66 ॥
4.87.m: Addressed by me there: "You are blessed, O multitude of sacrifices," O Lord, / they said: "We are not blessed; auspicious action is blessed, O sage!"

4.87.s:
śubhakarmāsi dhanyaṃ tvaṃ nāhaṃ dhanyamuvāca tat .
karmaṇāṃ phaladātā yaḥ karmahetuśca sāṃpratam .. 67 ..
4.87.d:
शुभकर्मासि धन्यं त्वं नाहं धन्यमुवाच तत् ।
कर्मणां फलदाता यः कर्महेतुश्च सांप्रतम् ॥ 67 ॥
4.87.m: "You are blessed, O auspicious action!"—it said: "I am not blessed. / He who gives the fruit of actions and is the cause of action now,

4.87.s:
dhāturvidhātā bhagavānsarvādiḥ sarvakārakaḥ .
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā ca dhanyo mānyaścaniścitam .. 68 ..
4.87.d:
धातुर्विधाता भगवान्सर्वादिः सर्वकारकः ।
श्रीकृष्णः परमात्मा च धन्यो मान्यश्चनिश्चितम् ॥ 68 ॥
4.87.m: the creator of the Creator, the Lord, the origin of all, the maker of all, / Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman, is certainly blessed and worthy of honor."

4.87.s:
dharmālayaṃ tato gatvā na duṣṭvā jagadīśvaram .
mathurāmāgato draṣṭuṃ paripūrṇatam prabhum .. 69 ..
4.87.d:
धर्मालयं ततो गत्वा न दुष्ट्वा जगदीश्वरम् ।
मथुरामागतो द्रष्टुं परिपूर्णतम् प्रभुम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.87.m: Having gone thence to the abode of Dharma and not having seen the Lord of the universe, / I have come to Mathurā to see the most perfect Lord,

4.87.s:
yajñānāṃ tapasāṃ caiva vratānāṃ śubhakarmaṇām .
īśvaraṃ phaladātāraṃ paramātmānameva ca .. 70 ..
4.87.d:
यज्ञानां तपसां चैव व्रतानां शुभकर्मणाम् ।
ईश्वरं फलदातारं परमात्मानमेव च ॥ 70 ॥
4.87.m: the Lord and giver of fruits of sacrifices, austerities, / vows, and auspicious actions, the Paramātman Himself,

4.87.s:
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca brahmādīnāṃ puraḥsaram .
dhanyo'sīti mayoktaśca dakṣiṇābhiḥ saheti ca .. 71 ..
4.87.d:
कारणं कारणानां च ब्रह्मादीनां पुरःसरम् ।
धन्योऽसीति मयोक्तश्च दक्षिणाभिः सहेति च ॥ 71 ॥
4.87.m: the cause of causes, who precedes Brahmā and the others. / And [so] it was said by me: "You are blessed, together with the priestly fees!"'

4.87.s:
ityuktena bhagavatā kathitaṃ sarvakāraṇam .
dakṣiṇābhiśca phalado hatayajño ṅyadakṣiṇāḥ .. 72 ..
4.87.d:
इत्युक्तेन भगवता कथितं सर्वकारणम् ।
दक्षिणाभिश्च फलदो हतयज्ञो ङ्यदक्षिणाः ॥ 72 ॥
4.87.m: Addressed thus, the Blessed Lord explained the cause of everything: / only with priestly gifts [a sacrifice] bears fruit; a sacrifice without priestly gifts is ruined.

4.87.s:
dakṣiṇā vipramuddiśya tatkāle tu na dīyate .
ekarātre vyatīte tu taddānaṃ dviguṇaṃ bhavet .. 73 ..
4.87.d:
दक्षिणा विप्रमुद्दिश्य तत्काले तु न दीयते ।
एकरात्रे व्यतीते तु तद्दानं द्विगुणं भवेत् ॥ 73 ॥
4.87.m: When a priestly gift intended for a brahmin is not given at that very time, / if a single night passes, that gift becomes doubled.

4.87.s:
māse śataguṇaṃ proktaṃ dvimāse tu sahasrakam .
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu sa dātā narakaṃ vrajet .. 74 ..
4.87.d:
मासे शतगुणं प्रोक्तं द्विमासे तु सहस्रकम् ।
संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु स दाता नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ 74 ॥
4.87.m: In a month it is said to become a hundredfold, and in two months a thousandfold; / if a year passes, that giver goes to hell.

4.87.s:
varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ ca mūtrakuṇḍe nipatya ca .
tataścāṇa़ḍālatāṃ yāti vyādhiyuktaśca pātakī .. 75 ..
4.87.d:
वर्षाणां च सहस्रं च मूत्रकुण्डे निपत्य च ।
ततश्चाण़डालतां याति व्याधियुक्तश्च पातकी ॥ 75 ॥
4.87.m: Falling into the pit of urine for a thousand years, / from there the sinner becomes an outcaste, afflicted with disease.

4.87.s:
dātrā na dīyate dānaṃ grahītrā cenna gṛhyate .
ubhau tau narakaṃ prāptau varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasrakam .. 76 ..
4.87.d:
दात्रा न दीयते दानं ग्रहीत्रा चेन्न गृह्यते ।
उभौ तौ नरकं प्राप्तौ वर्षाणां च सहस्रकम् ॥ 76 ॥
4.87.m: If a gift is not given by the giver, or if it is not accepted by the recipient, / both of them attain hell for a thousand years.

4.87.s:
yajamānaśca cāṇḍālo brahmaṇastatpurohitaḥ .
vyādhiyuktāvubhau tau ca pāpinau karmaṇaḥ phalāt .. 77 ..
4.87.d:
यजमानश्च चाण्डालो ब्रह्मणस्तत्पुरोहितः ।
व्याधियुक्तावुभौ तौ च पापिनौ कर्मणः फलात् ॥ 77 ॥
4.87.m: The patron of the sacrifice becomes an outcaste, and that family priest of the brahmin likewise; / both of those sinners become afflicted with disease through the fruit of their deed.

4.87.s:
sarve devāśca munayo jahasurvismayaṃ yayuḥ .
vismayaṃ ca yayau nandastatyāja putrabhāvakam .. 78 ..
4.87.d:
सर्वे देवाश्च मुनयो जहसुर्विस्मयं ययुः ।
विस्मयं च ययौ नन्दस्तत्याज पुत्रभावकम् ॥ 78 ॥
4.87.m: All the gods and sages laughed and were filled with wonder; / Nanda too was filled with wonder, and gave up his attitude toward him as a son.

4.87.s:
ruroda ca sabhāmadhye lajjāhīnaḥ śucā''kulaḥ .
tyaja mauhamitītyuktvā bodhayāmāsa pārvatī .. 79 ..
4.87.d:
रुरोद च सभामध्ये लज्जाहीनः शुचा'ऽकुलः ।
त्यज मौहमितीत्युक्त्वा बोधयामास पार्वती ॥ 79 ॥
4.87.m: He wept in the midst of the assembly, shameless and overwhelmed with grief; / saying, 'Cast off your delusion,' Pārvatī consoled him.

4.87.s:
nanda uvāca
amūlyaratnaṃ māṇikyaṃ yathā kujanmano gṛhe .
sthitaṃ tena ca deveśa tathā'haṃ vañcitaḥ prabho .. 80 ..
4.87.d:
नन्द उवाच
अमूल्यरत्नं माणिक्यं यथा कुजन्मनो गृहे ।
स्थितं तेन च देवेश तथाऽहं वञ्चितः प्रभो ॥ 80 ॥
4.87.m: Nanda said: / Just as a priceless jewel, a ruby, staying in the house of a low-born man / [is neglected] by him, O Lord of gods, so was I deceived, O Lord.

4.87.s:
mamāparādhaṃ bhagavān kṣamasva prakṛteḥ para .
yāsyāmi na punargehaṃ gokulaṃ yamunātaṭam .. 81 ..
4.87.d:
ममापराधं भगवान् क्षमस्व प्रकृतेः पर ।
यास्यामि न पुनर्गेहं गोकुलं यमुनातटम् ॥ 81 ॥
4.87.m: Forgive my offense, Blessed Lord beyond Prakṛti! / I will not return again to my home, to Gokula, or to the bank of the Yamunā,

4.87.s:
vṛndāvanaṃ tathā''vāsaṃ krīḍāvāsaṃ gadāgraja .
tatsarvaṃ ca yaśodāyā gopikāntikameva ca .. 82 ..
4.87.d:
वृन्दावनं तथा'ऽवासं क्रीडावासं गदाग्रज ।
तत्सर्वं च यशोदाया गोपिकान्तिकमेव च ॥ 82 ॥
4.87.m: nor to Vṛndāvana, nor to our dwelling, nor to the dwelling of pastimes, O elder brother of Gadā, / nor to any of that belonging to Yaśodā, nor to the presence of the cowherd women.

4.87.s:
kiṃ bravīmi yaśodāṃ ya preyasīṃ rādhikāmapi .
premapātraṃ ca bālaughaṃ vada bhoḥ kathayāmi kim .. 83 ..
4.87.d:
किं ब्रवीमि यशोदां य प्रेयसीं राधिकामपि ।
प्रेमपात्रं च बालौघं वद भोः कथयामि किम् ॥ 83 ॥
4.87.m: What shall I say to Yaśodā, or even to your beloved Rādhikā, / or to the group of boys who are the objects of your affection? Tell me, sir, what shall I say?

4.87.s:
ityuktvā ca sabhāmadhye marcchāṃ saṃprāpa nārada .
kroḍe kṛtvā jagannātho bodhayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam .. 84 ..
4.87.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च सभामध्ये मर्च्छां संप्राप नारद ।
क्रोडे कृत्वा जगन्नाथो बोधयामास तत्क्षणम् ॥ 84 ॥
4.87.m: Having spoken thus in the midst of the assembly, he fainted, O Nārada; / taking him on his lap, the Lord of the World immediately consoled him.

4.87.s:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo
saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 87 ..
4.87.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्नन्दसंओ
सप्ताशीतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 87 ॥
4.87.m: Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the great Brahmavaivarta, being the conversation between the Blessed Lord and Nanda, related by Nārada.

4.88.s:
śrīkṛṣṇā uvāca
cetanaṃ kuru he tāta he tāta cetanaṃ kuru .
jalabudbudavatsarvaṃ saṃsāraṃ sacarācaram .. 1 ..
4.88.d:
श्रीकृष्णा उवाच
चेतनं कुरु हे तात हे तात चेतनं कुरु ।
जलबुद्बुदवत्सर्वं संसारं सचराचरम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.88.m: Now the eighty-eighth chapter. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Regain your senses, O father! O father, regain your senses! / The entire world, moving and unmoving, is like a water-bubble.

4.88.s:
tyāja mohaṃ mahābhāga māyāṃ stauhi paratparāmā .
brahmasvarūpāṃ paramāṃ sarvamohanikṛntanīm .. 2 ..
4.88.d:
त्याज मोहं महाभाग मायां स्तौहि परत्परामा ।
ब्रह्मस्वरूपां परमां सर्वमोहनिकृन्तनीम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.88.m: Cast off delusion, O most fortunate one, and praise Māyā, who is higher than the highest, / having the nature of Brahman, supreme, the destroyer of all delusion,

4.88.s:
muktipradāṃ mahābhāgāṃ viṣṇumāyāṃ sanātanīm .
tripurasya vadhe ghore mahāyuddhe bhayākule .. 3 ..
4.88.d:
मुक्तिप्रदां महाभागां विष्णुमायां सनातनीम् ।
त्रिपुरस्य वधे घोरे महायुद्धे भयाकुले ॥ 3 ॥
4.88.m: the bestower of liberation, highly fortunate, the eternal Viṣṇumāyā, / with which hymn of praise, during the terrible slaying of Tripura in the great battle filled with terror,

4.88.s:
yena stotreṇa saṃbhuśca tayā daityaṃ jaghāna saḥ .
stotrarājaṃ pradāsyāmi sarvamohanikṛntanam ..
sarvavāñchāpradaṃ nanda śrūyatāmatra saṃsadi .. 4 ..
4.88.d:
येन स्तोत्रेण संभुश्च तया दैत्यं जघान सः ।
स्तोत्रराजं प्रदास्यामि सर्वमोहनिकृन्तनम् ॥
सर्ववाञ्छाप्रदं नन्द श्रूयतामत्र संसदि ॥ 4 ॥
4.88.m:
Śambhu killed that demon by her [grace]. / I shall give you that king of hymns of praise, which destroys all delusion,
and bestows all desires, O Nanda; let it be heard here in this assembly.

4.88.s:
nanda uvāca
sarvavighnavināśāya duḥkhapraśamanāya ca .
vibhūtaye ca yaśase nṛṇāṃ vāñchitasiddhaye .. 5 ..
4.88.d:
नन्द उवाच
सर्वविघ्नविनाशाय दुःखप्रशमनाय च ।
विभूतये च यशसे नृणां वाञ्छितसिद्धये ॥ 5 ॥
4.88.m: Nanda said: / For the destruction of all obstacles, for the pacification of sorrow, / for prosperity and fame, and for the fulfillment of men's desires,

4.88.s:
stotramekaṃ mahādevyā jaganmāturjagatprabho .
paraṃ durgatināśinyā gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham .. 6 ..
4.88.d:
स्तोत्रमेकं महादेव्या जगन्मातुर्जगत्प्रभो ।
परं दुर्गतिनाशिन्या गोपनीयं सुदुर्लभम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.88.m: give me, O Lord of the world, that one supreme hymn of praise of the Great Goddess, the mother of the universe, / the destroyer of distress, which is to be kept secret and is exceedingly hard to attain;

4.88.s:
dehi marhya vinītāya bhaktāya bhaktavatsala .
vedānāṃ janakastvaṃ ca nirguṇāśca parātparaḥ .. 7 ..
4.88.d:
देहि मर्ह्य विनीताय भक्ताय भक्तवत्सल ।
वेदानां जनकस्त्वं च निर्गुणाश्च परात्परः ॥ 7 ॥
4.88.m: give it to me, your humble devotee, O lover of your devotees! / You are the father of the Vedas, beyond the gunas, and higher than the highest.

4.88.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca
śruṇu vakṣyāmi daiśyendra stotraṃ yatparamādbhutam .
sarvavighnavināśārthaṃ mohapāśanikṛntanam .. 8 ..
4.88.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
श्रुणु वक्ष्यामि दैश्येन्द्र स्तोत्रं यत्परमाद्भुतम् ।
सर्वविघ्नविनाशार्थं मोहपाशनिकृन्तनम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.88.m: The Blessed Lord said: / Listen, O king of cowherds, I shall speak that most wondrous hymn of praise / meant for the destruction of all obstacles and the severing of the bonds of delusion,

4.88.s:
raṇatrastena vibhunā śaṃkareṇa purā kṛtam .
nārāyaṇopadeśena preritena ca brahmaṇā .. 9 ..
4.88.d:
रणत्रस्तेन विभुना शंकरेण पुरा कृतम् ।
नारायणोपदेशेन प्रेरितेन च ब्रह्मणा ॥ 9 ॥
4.88.m: which was composed long ago by the all-pervading Śaṅkara when terrified in battle, / upon the instruction of Nārāyaṇa and impelled by Brahmā.

4.88.s:
śatrugrastaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa brahmāṇamuvāca ha .
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ brahmā rathasthaṃ patitaṃ raṇe .. 10 ..
4.88.d:
शत्रुग्रस्तं शिवं दृष्ट्वा स ब्रह्माणमुवाच ह ।
उवाच शंकरं ब्रह्मा रथस्थं पतितं रणे ॥ 10 ॥
4.88.m: Seeing Śiva overwhelmed by the enemy, he spoke indeed to Brahmā; / then Brahmā spoke to Śaṅkara, who stood in his chariot, fallen in battle:

4.88.s:
surasaṃkaṭaśāntyarthaṃ durgā durgatināśinīm .
mūlaprakṛtimādyāṃ tāṃ stau(stu) hi brahmasvarūpiṇīm .. 11 ..
4.88.d:
सुरसंकटशान्त्यर्थं दुर्गा दुर्गतिनाशिनीम् ।
मूलप्रकृतिमाद्यां तां स्तौ(स्तु) हि ब्रह्मस्वरूपिणीम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.88.m: 'For the pacification of the distress of the gods, praise Durgā, the destroyer of distress, / that primordial Mūlaprakṛti who has the nature of Brahman.

4.88.s:
hariṇā prerito'haṃ ca tvāṃ vadāmi sureśvara .
vinā śaktisahāyena ko vā kaṃ jetumīśvaraḥ .. 12 ..
4.88.d:
हरिणा प्रेरितोऽहं च त्वां वदामि सुरेश्वर ।
विना शक्तिसहायेन को वा कं जेतुमीश्वरः ॥ 12 ॥
4.88.m: Impelled by Hari, I tell you this, O Lord of the gods: / without the aid of Śakti, who indeed is capable of conquering whom?'

4.88.s:
brahmaṇaśca vacaḥ śrutvā durgāṃ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ .
puṭāñjaliparo bhūtvā bhaktinamratmakaṃdharaḥ .. 13 ..
4.88.d:
ब्रह्मणश्च वचः श्रुत्वा दुर्गां सस्मार शंकरः ।
पुटाञ्जलिपरो भूत्वा भक्तिनम्रत्मकंधरः ॥ 13 ॥
4.88.m: Hearing Brahmā's words, Śaṅkara remembered Durgā, / joining his hands in reverence, bowing his neck in devotion.

4.88.s:
snātaḥpādau ca prakṣālya dhṛtvā dhaute vāsasī .
ācāntaḥ kuśahastaśca śucirviṣṇuṃ ca saṃsmaran .. 14 ..
4.88.d:
स्नातःपादौ च प्रक्षाल्य धृत्वा धौते वाससी ।
आचान्तः कुशहस्तश्च शुचिर्विष्णुं च संस्मरन् ॥ 14 ॥
4.88.m: Having bathed and washed his feet, wearing two clean garments, / having sipped water, holding kuśa grass in hand, pure, and remembering Viṣṇu,

4.88.s:
mahādeva uvāca
rakṣa rakṣa mahādevi durge durgatināśini .
māṃ bhaktamanuraktaṃ ca śatrugraste kṛpāmayi .. 15 ..
4.88.d:
महादेव उवाच
रक्ष रक्ष महादेवि दुर्गे दुर्गतिनाशिनि ।
मां भक्तमनुरक्तं च शत्रुग्रस्ते कृपामयि ॥ 15 ॥
4.88.m: Mahādeva said: / Protect me, protect me, O Great Goddess! O Durgā, destroyer of distress! / Protect me, your devoted and affectionate servant, overwhelmed by the enemy, O compassionate one!

4.88.s:
viṣṇumāye mahābhāge nārāyaṇi sanātani .
brahmasvarūpe parame nityānandasvarūpiṇi .. 16 ..
4.88.d:
विष्णुमाये महाभागे नारायणि सनातनि ।
ब्रह्मस्वरूपे परमे नित्यानन्दस्वरूपिणि ॥ 16 ॥
4.88.m: O Viṣṇumāyā, O highly fortunate one, O Nārāyaṇī, O eternal one! / Having the nature of Brahman, supreme one, whose very nature is eternal bliss!

4.88.s:
tvaṃ ca brahmādidevānāmambike jagadambike .
tvaṃ saṃhāre ca guṇato nirākāre ca nirguṇāt .. 17 ..
4.88.d:
त्वं च ब्रह्मादिदेवानामम्बिके जगदम्बिके ।
त्वं संहारे च गुणतो निराकारे च निर्गुणात् ॥ 17 ॥
4.88.m: You are the mother of the gods headed by Brahmā, O Mother of the universe! / In cosmic dissolution you are [manifested] from the gunas, and in the formless [state] from the gunaless.

4.88.s:
māyayā puruṣastvaṃ ca māyayā prakṛtiḥ svayam .
tayoḥ paraṃ brahma paraṃ tvaṃ bibharṣi sanātani .. 18 ..
4.88.d:
मायया पुरुषस्त्वं च मायया प्रकृतिः स्वयम् ।
तयोः परं ब्रह्म परं त्वं बिभर्षि सनातनि ॥ 18 ॥
4.88.m: Through Māyā you are Puruṣa, and through Māyā you yourself are Prakṛti; / beyond both of them, you sustain the supreme Brahman, O eternal one!

4.88.s:
vedānāṃ jananī tvaṃ ca sāvitrī ca parātparā .
vaikuṇṭhe ca mahālakṣmīḥ sarvamaṃpatsvarūpiṇī .. 19 ..
4.88.d:
वेदानां जननी त्वं च सावित्री च परात्परा ।
वैकुण्ठे च महालक्ष्मीः सर्वमंपत्स्वरूपिणी ॥ 19 ॥
4.88.m: You are the mother of the Vedas, Sāvitrī, higher than the highest; / and in Vaikuṇṭha you are Mahālakṣmī, the embodiment of all fortune.

4.88.s:
martyalakṣmīśca kṣīrode kāminī śeṣaśāyinaḥ .
svargeṣu svargalakṣmīstvaṃ rājalakṣmīśca bhūtale .. 20 ..
4.88.d:
मर्त्यलक्ष्मीश्च क्षीरोदे कामिनी शेषशायिनः ।
स्वर्गेषु स्वर्गलक्ष्मीस्त्वं राजलक्ष्मीश्च भूतले ॥ 20 ॥
4.88.m: You are the Lakshmi of mortals, and in the ocean of milk you are the beloved of him who reclines on Śeṣa; / in the heavens you are the Lakshmi of heaven, and on the surface of the earth the Lakshmi of kings;

4.88.s:
nāgādilakṣmīḥ pātāle gṛheṣu gṛhadevatā .
sarvasasyasvarūpā tvaṃ sarvaiśvaryavidhāyinī .. 21 ..
4.88.d:
नागादिलक्ष्मीः पाताले गृहेषु गृहदेवता ।
सर्वसस्यस्वरूपा त्वं सर्वैश्वर्यविधायिनी ॥ 21 ॥
4.88.m: the Lakshmi of the serpent-beings and others in the underworld, and the household deity in homes; / having the nature of all crops, you grant all sovereign power.

4.88.s:
rāgādhiṣṭhātṛdevī tvaṃ brahmaṇaśca sarasvatī .
prāṇānāmadhidepī tvaṃ kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 22 ..
4.88.d:
रागाधिष्ठातृदेवी त्वं ब्रह्मणश्च सरस्वती ।
प्राणानामधिदेपी त्वं कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥ 22 ॥
4.88.m: You are the presiding goddess of musical melodies, and Sarasvatī belonging to Brahmā; / you are the presiding deity of the life-breaths of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

4.88.s:
goloke ca svayaṃ rādhā śrīkṛṣṇasyaiva vakṣasi .
golokādhiṣṭhitā devī dṛndā dṛndāvane vane .. 23 ..
4.88.d:
गोलोके च स्वयं राधा श्रीकृष्णस्यैव वक्षसि ।
गोलोकाधिष्ठिता देवी दृन्दा दृन्दावने वने ॥ 23 ॥
4.88.m: In Goloka you yourself are Rādhā on the chest of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; / presiding over Goloka, you are the goddess Vṛndā in the forest of Vṛndāvana;

4.88.s:
śrīrāsamaṇḍale ramyā vṛndāvanavinodinī .
śataśṛṅgādhidevī tvaṃ nāmnā citrāvalīti ca .. 24 ..
4.88.d:
श्रीरासमण्डले रम्या वृन्दावनविनोदिनी ।
शतशृङ्गाधिदेवी त्वं नाम्ना चित्रावलीति च ॥ 24 ॥
4.88.m: charming in the sacred circular dance, sporting in Vṛndāvana; / you are the presiding goddess of Śataśṛṅga, named Citrāvalī.

4.88.s:
dakṣakanyā kutrakalpe kutrakalpe ca śailajā .
devamātā'ditistvaṃ ca sarvādhārā vasuṃdharā .. 25 ..
4.88.d:
दक्षकन्या कुत्रकल्पे कुत्रकल्पे च शैलजा ।
देवमाताऽदितिस्त्वं च सर्वाधारा वसुंधरा ॥ 25 ॥
4.88.m: In one eon you are the daughter of Dakṣa, and in another eon the daughter of the Mountain; / you are Aditi, the mother of the gods, and the earth, the support of all.

4.88.s:
tvameva gaṅgā tulasī tvaṃ ca svāhā satī .
tvadaṃśāṃśāṃśakalayā sarvadevādiyoṣitaḥ .. 26 ..
4.88.d:
त्वमेव गङ्गा तुलसी त्वं च स्वाहा सती ।
त्वदंशांशांशकलया सर्वदेवादियोषितः ॥ 26 ॥
4.88.m: You alone are Gaṅgā, Tulasī, Svāhā, and the devoted wife Satī; / through your portions of portions and parts of portions, all the wives of the gods and others exist.

4.88.s:
strīrūpaṃ cātipuṃrūpaṃ devi tvaṃ ca napuṃsakam .
vṛkṣāṇāṃ vṛṅarūpā tvaṃ sṛṣṭā cāṅkurarūpiṇī .. 27 ..
4.88.d:
स्त्रीरूपं चातिपुंरूपं देवि त्वं च नपुंसकम् ।
वृक्षाणां वृङरूपा त्वं सृष्टा चाङ्कुररूपिणी ॥ 27 ॥
4.88.m: You are the female form, and the extremely masculine form, O Goddess, and also the neuter; / you are the form of trees among trees, and the sprout in creation.

4.88.s:
vahnau ca dāhikā śaktirjale śaityasvarūpiṇī .
sūrye tejaḥ svarūpā ca prabhārūpā ca saṃtatam .. 28 ..
4.88.d:
वह्नौ च दाहिका शक्तिर्जले शैत्यस्वरूपिणी ।
सूर्ये तेजः स्वरूपा च प्रभारूपा च संततम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.88.m: You are the burning power in fire, the nature of coolness in water, / the nature of splendour in the sun, and perpetually its radiance.

4.88.s:
gandharūpā ca bhūmau ca ākāśe śabdarūpiṇī .
śobhāsvarūpā candre ca padmasaṃghe ca niścitam .. 29 ..
4.88.d:
गन्धरूपा च भूमौ च आकाशे शब्दरूपिणी ।
शोभास्वरूपा चन्द्रे च पद्मसंघे च निश्चितम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.88.m: You are the nature of fragrance in the earth, and the nature of sound in space; / in the moon and in the cluster of lotuses, you are surely the nature of beauty.

4.88.s:
sṛṣṭau sṛṣṭisvarūpā ca pālane paripālikā .
mahāmārī ca saṃhāre jale ca jalarūpiṇī .. 30 ..
4.88.d:
सृष्टौ सृष्टिस्वरूपा च पालने परिपालिका ।
महामारी च संहारे जले च जलरूपिणी ॥ 30 ॥
4.88.m: In creation you are the nature of creation, in maintenance the protectress, / in destruction the great pestilence, and in water having the nature of water.

4.88.s:
kṣuttavaṃ dayā tvaṃ nidrā tvaṃ tṛṣṇā tvaṃ buddhirūpiṇī .
tuṣṭistvaṃ cāpi puṣṭistvaṃ śraddhāstvaṃ ca kṣamā svayam .. 31 ..
4.88.d:
क्षुत्तवं दया त्वं निद्रा त्वं तृष्णा त्वं बुद्धिरूपिणी ।
तुष्टिस्त्वं चापि पुष्टिस्त्वं श्रद्धास्त्वं च क्षमा स्वयम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.88.m: You are hunger, you are compassion, you are sleep, you are thirst, you are the form of intellect; / you are contentment, you are nourishment, you are faith, and you are forbearance itself.

4.88.s:
śāntistvaṃ ca svayaṃ bhrāntiḥ kāntistavaṃ kīrtireva ca .
lajjā tvaṃ ca tathā māyā bhukti- ..
suktisvarūpiṇī .. 32 ..
4.88.d:
शान्तिस्त्वं च स्वयं भ्रान्तिः कान्तिस्तवं कीर्तिरेव च ।
लज्जा त्वं च तथा माया भुक्ति- ॥
सुक्तिस्वरूपिणी ॥ 32 ॥
4.88.m: You are peace, and you yourself are delusion, beauty, and fame; / you are modesty, and likewise [you are] Māyā, enjoyment, —

4.88.s:
sarvaśaktisvarūpā tvaṃ sarvasaṃbatpradāyinī .
vede'nirvacanīyā tvaṃ tvāṃ na jānāti kaścana .. 33 ..
4.88.d:
सर्वशक्तिस्वरूपा त्वं सर्वसंबत्प्रदायिनी ।
वेदेऽनिर्वचनीया त्वं त्वां न जानाति कश्चन ॥ 33 ॥
4.88.m: You are the embodiment of all powers, the giver of all prosperity; / you are indefinable in the Veda, and no one knows you.

4.88.s:
sahasra vaktrastvāṃ stotuṃ na ca śaktaḥ sureśvari .
vedā na śaktāḥ ko vidvānna ca śaktā sarasvatī .. 34 ..
4.88.d:
सहस्र वक्त्रस्त्वां स्तोतुं न च शक्तः सुरेश्वरि ।
वेदा न शक्ताः को विद्वान्न च शक्ता सरस्वती ॥ 34 ॥
4.88.m: Even the thousand-faced [Śeṣa] is unable to praise you, O Queen of the gods; / the Vedas are not able, what wise man [could be]? Nor is Sarasvatī able.

4.88.s:
svayaṃ vidhātā śakto na na ca viṣṇuḥ manātanaḥ .
kiṃ staumi pañcavaktraistu raṇatrasto maheśvari .. 35 ..
4.88.d:
स्वयं विधाता शक्तो न न च विष्णुः मनातनः ।
किं स्तौमि पञ्चवक्त्रैस्तु रणत्रस्तो महेश्वरि ॥ 35 ॥
4.88.m: The Creator himself is not able, nor is eternal Viṣṇu; / how can I praise [you] with five faces, terrified in battle, O Maheśvarī?

4.88.s:
kṛpāṃ kuru mahāmāye mama śatrukṣayaṃ kuru .
ityuktvā ca sakaruṇaṃ rathasthe patite raṇe .. 36 ..
4.88.d:
कृपां कुरु महामाये मम शत्रुक्षयं कुरु ।
इत्युक्त्वा च सकरुणं रथस्थे पतिते रणे ॥ 36 ॥
4.88.m: Have mercy, O Mahāmāyā! Bring about the destruction of my enemy!" / Having spoken thus piteously, when the chariot-rider had fallen in battle,

4.88.s:
āvirbabhūva sā durgā sūryakoṭisamaprabhā .
nārāyaṇena kṛpayā preritā paramātmanā .. 37 ..
4.88.d:
आविर्बभूव सा दुर्गा सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभा ।
नारायणेन कृपया प्रेरिता परमात्मना ॥ 37 ॥
4.88.m: that Durgā appeared, equal in splendour to ten million suns, / impelled through compassion by Nārāyaṇa, the Paramātman,

4.88.s:
śivasya purataḥ śīghraṃ śivāya ca jayāya ca .
ityuvāca mahādevī māyāśaktyā'suraṃ jahi .. 38 ..
4.88.d:
शिवस्य पुरतः शीघ्रं शिवाय च जयाय च ।
इत्युवाच महादेवी मायाशक्त्याऽसुरं जहि ॥ 38 ॥
4.88.m: before Śiva at once, for the auspiciousness and victory of Śiva. / Thus the great goddess spoke: "Slay the demon by your illusory power!"

4.88.s:
durgovāca
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vāñchitam .
bhavānvaraḥ surāṇāṃ ca jayaṃ tubhyaṃ dadāmyaham .. 39 ..
4.88.d:
दुर्गोवाच
वरं वृणीष्व भद्रं ते यत्ते मनसि वाञ्छितम् ।
भवान्वरः सुराणां च जयं तुभ्यं ददाम्यहम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.88.m: Durgā said: / "Choose a boon, blessings upon you, whatever is desired in your heart; / you are the best of the gods, and I grant you victory."

4.88.s:
mahādeva uvāca
kṣayo bhavatu daityasya iti me varamīśvarī .
dehīti vāñchitaṃ durge paramādye malātani .. 40 ..
4.88.d:
महादेव उवाच
क्षयो भवतु दैत्यस्य इति मे वरमीश्वरी ।
देहीति वाञ्छितं दुर्गे परमाद्ये मलातनि ॥ 40 ॥
4.88.m: Mahādeva said: / "'May the destruction of the Daitya take place'—this is my boon, O Goddess; / grant what is desired, O Durgā, O Supreme, Primordial, and Eternal One!"

4.88.s:
bhagavatyuvāca
hariṃ smara mahābhāgā jaya daityaṃ jagadguruḥ .
svayaṃ vidhātā bhagavāṃstvameva jyotirīśvaraḥ .. 41 ..
4.88.d:
भगवत्युवाच
हरिं स्मर महाभागा जय दैत्यं जगद्गुरुः ।
स्वयं विधाता भगवांस्त्वमेव ज्योतिरीश्वरः ॥ 41 ॥
4.88.m: The Blessed Goddess said: / "Remember Hari, O fortunate one; conquer the Daitya, O teacher of the universe! / The Lord, the Creator himself, you alone are the light and the sovereign Lord."

4.88.s:
etasminnantare viṣṇurvṛṣarūpo babhūva ha .
dadhāra kalayā mūrdhnā śūlapāṇe rathaṃ vibhuḥ .. 42 ..
4.88.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुर्वृषरूपो बभूव ह ।
दधार कलया मूर्ध्ना शूलपाणे रथं विभुः ॥ 42 ॥
4.88.m: Meanwhile, Viṣṇu assumed the form of a bull; / with a portion [of himself] the all-pervading lord held up the chariot of the trident-bearer with his head.

4.88.s:
ūrdhvacakramathograṃ ca prakṛtiṃ ca cakāra saḥ .
śastraṃ dadau mantrapūtamuddadhāra tato ratham .. 43 ..
4.88.d:
ऊर्ध्वचक्रमथोग्रं च प्रकृतिं च चकार सः ।
शस्त्रं ददौ मन्त्रपूतमुद्दधार ततो रथम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.88.m: Then he raised the fierce wheel and restored the normal state; / he gave a weapon consecrated by mantras, and then lifted up the chariot.

4.88.s:
śivaḥ śastraṃ gṛhītvā ca dhyātvā viṣṇuṃ maheśvarīm .
jaghāna tripuraṃ śīghraṃ sa papāta mahītale .. 44 ..
4.88.d:
शिवः शस्त्रं गृहीत्वा च ध्यात्वा विष्णुं महेश्वरीम् ।
जघान त्रिपुरं शीघ्रं स पपात महीतले ॥ 44 ॥
4.88.m: Taking the weapon and meditating upon Viṣṇu and Maheśvarī, / Śiva swiftly struck Tripura; he fell to the earth's surface.

4.88.s:
tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ devāścakuśca puṣpavarṣaṇam .
durgā tasmai dadau śūraṃ pinākaṃ viṣṇureva ca .. 45 ..
4.88.d:
तुष्टुवुः शंकरं देवाश्चकुश्च पुष्पवर्षणम् ।
दुर्गा तस्मै ददौ शूरं पिनाकं विष्णुरेव च ॥ 45 ॥
4.88.m: The gods praised Śaṅkara and showered flowers; / Durgā gave him the hero's [valour], and Viṣṇu [gave him] the Pināka bow.

4.88.s:
brahmā śubhāśiṣaṃ caiva munayaścāpi harṣitāḥ .
nanṛturdevatāḥ sarvā jagurgandharvakinnarāḥ .. 46 ..
4.88.d:
ब्रह्मा शुभाशिषं चैव मुनयश्चापि हर्षिताः ।
ननृतुर्देवताः सर्वा जगुर्गन्धर्वकिन्नराः ॥ 46 ॥
4.88.m: Brahmā [gave] auspicious blessings, and the sages were delighted; / all the deities danced, and the Gandharvas and Kinnaras sang.

4.88.s:
etasminnantare tāta stavarājamanuttamam .
vighnavighnakaraṃ śīghraṃ śatrusaṃhārakāraṇam .. 47 ..
4.88.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तात स्तवराजमनुत्तमम् ।
विघ्नविघ्नकरं शीघ्रं शत्रुसंहारकारणम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.88.m: Meanwhile, dear one, this supreme king of hymns / instantly removes obstacles and brings about the destruction of enemies;

4.88.s:
paramaiśvaryajanakaṃ sukhadaṃ paramaṃ śubham .
nirvāṇamokṣadaṃ caiva haribhaktipradaṃ dhruvam .. 48 ..
4.88.d:
परमैश्वर्यजनकं सुखदं परमं शुभम् ।
निर्वाणमोक्षदं चैव हरिभक्तिप्रदं ध्रुवम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.88.m: it produces supreme sovereignty, gives happiness, and is supremely auspicious; / it truly grants the liberation of nirvāṇa and bestows devotion to Hari;

4.88.s:
golokavāsadaṃ caiva sarvasiddhipradaṃ varam .
stotrarājaprapaṭhanātprasannā pārvatī sadā .. 49 ..
4.88.d:
गोलोकवासदं चैव सर्वसिद्धिप्रदं वरम् ।
स्तोत्रराजप्रपठनात्प्रसन्ना पार्वती सदा ॥ 49 ॥
4.88.m: it grants residence in Goloka and bestows all excellent accomplishments; / from reciting this king of hymns, Pārvatī is always pleased.

4.88.s:
lobhamohakāmakrodhakarmamūlanikṛntanam .
balabuddhikaraṃ caiva janmamṛtyuvināśanam .. 50 ..
4.88.d:
लोभमोहकामक्रोधकर्ममूलनिकृन्तनम् ।
बलबुद्धिकरं चैव जन्ममृत्युविनाशनम् ॥ 50 ॥
4.88.m: It cuts away the root of actions arising from greed, delusion, lust, and anger; / it grants strength and intellect, and destroys birth and death;

4.88.s:
dhanaputrapriyābhūmisarvasaṃpatpradaṃ nṛṇām .
śokaduḥkhaharaṃ caiva sarvāmiddhipradaṃ varam .. 51 ..
4.88.d:
धनपुत्रप्रियाभूमिसर्वसंपत्प्रदं नृणाम् ।
शोकदुःखहरं चैव सर्वामिद्धिप्रदं वरम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.88.m: it gives wealth, sons, a beloved, land, and all prosperity to men; / it dispels grief and sorrow, and bestows all excellent accomplishments.

4.88.s:
stotrarājaprapaṭhanānmahāvandhyā prasūyate .
vandhanānmucyate duḥkhī bhayānmucyeta niścitam .. 52 ..
4.88.d:
स्तोत्रराजप्रपठनान्महावन्ध्या प्रसूयते ।
वन्धनान्मुच्यते दुःखी भयान्मुच्येत निश्चितम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.88.m: From reciting this king of hymns, an utterly barren woman gives birth; / one who is sorrowful is freed from bondage, and one is surely freed from fear;

4.88.s:
rogādvimucyate rogī daridraśca dhanī bhaven .
dāvāgnimadhye na mṛto magnaḥ poto mahārṇave .. 53 ..
4.88.d:
रोगाद्विमुच्यते रोगी दरिद्रश्च धनी भवेन् ।
दावाग्निमध्ये न मृतो मग्नः पोतो महार्णवे ॥ 53 ॥
4.88.m: a diseased person is freed from disease, and a pauper becomes wealthy; / one does not die in the midst of a forest fire, [nor] when a boat is sunk in the great ocean;

4.88.s:
dasyugrasto nipugrasto hiṃsrajantusamanvitaḥ .
stotreṇānena vaiśyendra kalyāṇaṃ labhate naraḥ .. 54 ..
4.88.d:
दस्युग्रस्तो निपुग्रस्तो हिंस्रजन्तुसमन्वितः ।
स्तोत्रेणानेन वैश्येन्द्र कल्याणं लभते नरः ॥ 54 ॥
4.88.m: seized by robbers, seized by an enemy, or surrounded by predatory beasts, / a man attains well-being by means of this hymn, O best of Vaiśyas.

4.88.s:
taijasānāṃ yathā ratnamāśramāṇāṃ dvijo yathā .
nadīnāṃ ca yathā gaṅgā mantrāṇāṃ praṇavo yathā .. 55 ..
4.88.d:
तैजसानां यथा रत्नमाश्रमाणां द्विजो यथा ।
नदीनां च यथा गङ्गा मन्त्राणां प्रणवो यथा ॥ 55 ॥
4.88.m: As a jewel is among luminous objects, as a twice-born is among the stages of life, / as Gaṅgā is among rivers, as the praṇava is among mantras,

4.88.s:
tulasī sarvapatrāṇāṃ dharāṇāṃ ca vasuṃdharā .
puṣpāṇāṃ pārijātaṃ ca kāṣṭhānāṃ candanaṃ yathā .. 56 ..
4.88.d:
तुलसी सर्वपत्राणां धराणां च वसुंधरा ।
पुष्पाणां पारिजातं च काष्ठानां चन्दनं यथा ॥ 56 ॥
4.88.m: as Tulasī is among all leaves, and the Earth is among upholders, / as the pārijāta is among flowers, and sandalwood is among woods,

4.88.s:
viṣṇupūjā ca tapasāṃ vrateṣvekādaśī yathā .
jñānināṃ ca yathā śaṃbhuḥ siddhānāṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 57 ..
4.88.d:
विष्णुपूजा च तपसां व्रतेष्वेकादशी यथा ।
ज्ञानिनां च यथा शंभुः सिद्धानां च गणेश्वरः ॥ 57 ॥
4.88.m: as worship of Viṣṇu is among austerities, as Ekādaśī is among vows, / as Śambhu is among the wise, and Gaṇeśvara is among the perfected,

4.88.s:
devānāṃ ca yathā viṣṇurvedāḥ śāstreṣu tantrataḥ .
devīnāṃ ca yathā durgā śāntānāṃ kamalā yathā .. 58 ..
4.88.d:
देवानां च यथा विष्णुर्वेदाः शास्त्रेषु तन्त्रतः ।
देवीनां च यथा दुर्गा शान्तानां कमला यथा ॥ 58 ॥
4.88.m: as Viṣṇu is among gods, and the Vedas are systematically among treatises, / as Durgā is among goddesses, and Kamalā is among the tranquil,

4.88.s:
sarasvatī ca viduṣāṃ rādhikā sundarīṣu ca .
tathā stotreṣvidaṃ stotraṃ nātaḥ parataraṃ vraja .. 59 ..
4.88.d:
सरस्वती च विदुषां राधिका सुन्दरीषु च ।
तथा स्तोत्रेष्विदं स्तोत्रं नातः परतरं व्रज ॥ 59 ॥
4.88.m: as Sarasvatī is among the learned, and Rādhikā is among beauties, / so among hymns, go [knowing that] this hymn has none superior to it.

4.88.s:
purā dattaṃ brahmaṇe ca puṣkare sūryaparvaṇi .
daityagrastāya bhītāya sarvadurgaharaṃ param .. 60 ..
4.88.d:
पुरा दत्तं ब्रह्मणे च पुष्करे सूर्यपर्वणि ।
दैत्यग्रस्ताय भीताय सर्वदुर्गहरं परम् ॥ 60 ॥
4.88.m: Formerly it was given to Brahmā at Puṣkara on a solar eclipse, / when he was seized by a Daitya and terrified—the supreme [hymn] dispelling all distress.

4.88.s:
śivāya śatrugrastāya dadau brahmā madājñayā .
śivaśca sanakādibhyaḥ purā durvāsase dadau .. 61 ..
4.88.d:
शिवाय शत्रुग्रस्ताय ददौ ब्रह्मा मदाज्ञया ।
शिवश्च सनकादिभ्यः पुरा दुर्वाससे ददौ ॥ 61 ॥
4.88.m: Brahmā gave it by my command to Śiva when he was beset by an enemy; / and Śiva gave it long ago to Sanaka and the others, and to Durvāsas.

4.88.s:
sanatkumāro bhagavānkṛpayā gautamāya ca .
pulahāya pulastyāya dadau cāṅgirase mudā .. 62 ..
4.88.d:
सनत्कुमारो भगवान्कृपया गौतमाय च ।
पुलहाय पुलस्त्याय ददौ चाङ्गिरसे मुदा ॥ 62 ॥
4.88.m: The lord Sanatkumāra gave it through compassion to Gautama, / and gladly gave it to Pulaha, Pulastya, and Aṅgiras;

4.88.s:
tathā yandrāya sūryāya sūryaścāpi yamāya ca .
yamāśca citraguptāya kṛpayā ca purā dadau .. 63 ..
4.88.d:
तथा यन्द्राय सूर्याय सूर्यश्चापि यमाय च ।
यमाश्च चित्रगुप्ताय कृपया च पुरा ददौ ॥ 63 ॥
4.88.m: likewise [it was given] to the Moon and the Sun; and the Sun gave it to Yama, / and Yama formerly gave it through compassion to Citragupta.

4.88.s:
nityaṃ paṭhiṣyasi stotraṃ golokagamanāya vai .
sākṣātpaśyasi bho tāta tāmeva pārvatīmiha .. 64 ..
4.88.d:
नित्यं पठिष्यसि स्तोत्रं गोलोकगमनाय वै ।
साक्षात्पश्यसि भो तात तामेव पार्वतीमिह ॥ 64 ॥
4.88.m: You should recite this hymn daily for attainment of Goloka; / O dear one, you will see that very Pārvatī here face to face.

4.88.s:
yasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ pāpine gopanaṃ kuru .
nārāyaṇasya bhaktāya śāntāya viduṣe tathā .. 65 ..
4.88.d:
यस्मै कस्मै न दातव्यं पापिने गोपनं कुरु ।
नारायणस्य भक्ताय शान्ताय विदुषे तथा ॥ 65 ॥
4.88.m: It should not be given to just anyone; keep it concealed from a sinner; / to a devotee of Nārāyaṇa, to one who is tranquil, and likewise to a wise man,

4.88.s:
sarvajñāya ca viprāya dātavyaṃ ca prayatnataḥ .
viprāya vṛṣavāhāya vṛṣalīvataye tathā .. 66 ..
4.88.d:
सर्वज्ञाय च विप्राय दातव्यं च प्रयत्नतः ।
विप्राय वृषवाहाय वृषलीवतये तथा ॥ 66 ॥
4.88.m: and to an all-knowing Brahmin it should be given with great effort. / [Never] to a Brahmin who rides an ox, or to the husband of a Śūdra woman,

4.88.s:
śūdrāṇāṃ sūpakārāya śūdrakṣāddhānnabhojine .
kanyāvikraciṇe caiva brāhmaṇāya viśeṣataḥ .. 67 ..
4.88.d:
शूद्राणां सूपकाराय शूद्रक्षाद्धान्नभोजिने ।
कन्याविक्रचिणे चैव ब्राह्मणाय विशेषतः ॥ 67 ॥
4.88.m: to a cook of Śūdras, to one who eats food from a Śūdra's funeral feast, / and especially to a Brahmin who sells his daughter.

4.88.s:
sarvasiddhiṃ ca labhate siddhastotre bhavedyadi .
daśāyutajapenaiva siddhastotro bhavennaraḥ .. 68 ..
4.88.d:
सर्वसिद्धिं च लभते सिद्धस्तोत्रे भवेद्यदि ।
दशायुतजपेनैव सिद्धस्तोत्रो भवेन्नरः ॥ 68 ॥
4.88.m: And one obtains all perfection if one has mastered the hymn; / by chanting it one hundred thousand times, a man attains mastery of the hymn.

4.88.s:
agnistamabhaṃ jalastambhaṃ mṛtstambhaṃ manasastathā .
aśvamedhasahasrācca pṛthivyāśca pradakṣiṇāt .. 69 ..
4.88.d:
अग्निस्तमभं जलस्तम्भं मृत्स्तम्भं मनसस्तथा ।
अश्वमेधसहस्राच्च पृथिव्याश्च प्रदक्षिणात् ॥ 69 ॥
4.88.m: Arresting fire, arresting water, arresting earth, and likewise [arresting] the mind; / [more than] a thousand horse-sacrifices, and circumambulation of the earth,

4.88.s:
snānācca sarvatīrthānāṃ stotrametacca puṇyadam .
dattaṃ tubhyaṃ mayā tāta mama prāṇasamaṃ vraja .. 70 ..
4.88.d:
स्नानाच्च सर्वतीर्थानां स्तोत्रमेतच्च पुण्यदम् ।
दत्तं तुभ्यं मया तात मम प्राणसमं व्रज ॥ 70 ॥
4.88.m: and bathing in all sacred fords, this hymn bestows greater merit; / given to you by me, dear one, equal to my own life's breath, go!

4.88.s:
stavanaṃ kuru pārvatyāścedānīṃ mama saṃsadi .
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā nandastuṣṭāva pārvatīm .. 71 ..
4.88.d:
स्तवनं कुरु पार्वत्याश्चेदानीं मम संसदि ।
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा नन्दस्तुष्टाव पार्वतीम् ॥ 71 ॥
4.88.m: Make praise now to Pārvatī in my assembly." / Hearing the words of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Nanda praised Pārvatī

4.88.s:
stotreṇānena viprendra sarvasaṃpatpradāyinīm .
varaṃ tasmai dadau durgā golokavāsamīpsitam .. 72 ..
4.88.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन विप्रेन्द्र सर्वसंपत्प्रदायिनीम् ।
वरं तस्मै ददौ दुर्गा गोलोकवासमीप्सितम् ॥ 72 ॥
4.88.m: with this hymn, O best of Brahmins, which bestows all prosperity. / Durgā granted him a boon: his desired residence in Goloka,

4.88.s:
durlabhaṃ paramaṃ jñānaṃ vede yanna śrutaṃ mune .
rājendratvaṃ gokule ca kṛṣṇabhaktiṃ sudurlabhām .. 73 ..
4.88.d:
दुर्लभं परमं ज्ञानं वेदे यन्न श्रुतं मुने ।
राजेन्द्रत्वं गोकुले च कृष्णभक्तिं सुदुर्लभाम् ॥ 73 ॥
4.88.m: supreme knowledge hard to attain, which is not heard in the Veda, O sage, / kingship in Gokula, and devotion to Kṛṣṇa that is very hard to obtain,

4.88.s:
taddāsvaṃ cāvi parato mahattvaṃ siddhameva ca .
varaṃ dattvā yayau durgā saṃbhāṣya śaṃbhunā saha .. 74 ..
4.88.d:
तद्दास्वं चावि परतो महत्त्वं सिद्धमेव च ।
वरं दत्त्वा ययौ दुर्गा संभाष्य शंभुना सह ॥ 74 ॥
4.88.m: servitude to Him, and beyond that, established greatness. / Having granted the boon, Durgā departed after conversing with Śambhu.

4.88.s:
jagmurdevāśca munayaḥ stutvā ca nandanandanam .
uvāca nandaṃ śrīkṛṣṇo vraja nanda vrajānvitaḥ ..
prahaṣṭastyaktamohaśca bodhena durlabhena ca .. 75 ..
4.88.d:
जग्मुर्देवाश्च मुनयः स्तुत्वा च नन्दनन्दनम् ।
उवाच नन्दं श्रीकृष्णो व्रज नन्द व्रजान्वितः ॥
प्रहष्टस्त्यक्तमोहश्च बोधेन दुर्लभेन च ॥ 75 ॥
4.88.m:
And the gods and sages departed after praising the delight of Nanda. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa spoke to Nanda: “Go, Nanda, accompanied by the people of Vraja,
overjoyed, with delusion cast away by means of this rare understanding.” .. 75 ..

4.88.s:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣmajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavannandasaṃo
aṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 88 ..
4.88.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्मजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्नन्दसंओ
अष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 88 ॥
4.88.m: Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, in the dialogue between the Lord and Nanda, in the Nārada-Nārāyaṇa [conversation], in the latter part of the Śrī-Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa, in the glorious Mahā-Brahmavaivarta. .. 88 ..

4.89.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca
gaccha gaccha gṛhaṃ gaccha vrajarāja vrajaṃ vraja .
sarvaṃ tattvaṃ tvayā jñātaṃ dṛṣṭāśca munayaḥ surāḥ .. 1 ..
4.89.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच
गच्छ गच्छ गृहं गच्छ व्रजराज व्रजं व्रज ।
सर्वं तत्त्वं त्वया ज्ञातं दृष्टाश्च मुनयः सुराः ॥ 1 ॥
4.89.m: Now begins the eighty-ninth chapter. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “Go, go, go home, king of Vraja; go to Vraja. / You have known all truth, and you have seen the sages and gods. .. 1 ..

4.89.s:
śrutaṃ me dhanyamākhyānaṃ nānākhyānaṃ sudurlabham .
durgāyāḥ stotrarājaṃ ca janmapāśanikṛntanam .. 2 ..
4.89.d:
श्रुतं मे धन्यमाख्यानं नानाख्यानं सुदुर्लभम् ।
दुर्गायाः स्तोत्रराजं च जन्मपाशनिकृन्तनम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.89.m: You have heard my blessed narrative, diverse and exceedingly rare narratives, / and Durgā's king of hymns, which cuts through the snare of rebirth. .. 2 ..

4.89.s:
sthitaṃ tate nigaditaṃ harṣeṇa ca sukhena ca .
matkṛtaṃ bālabhāvena cāparāddhaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam .. 3 ..
4.89.d:
स्थितं तते निगदितं हर्षेण च सुखेन च ।
मत्कृतं बालभावेन चापराद्धं च तत्क्षणम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.89.m: It has been told to you, father, with joy and happiness. / Forgive in an instant whatever offence I committed as a child. .. 3 ..

4.89.s:
yatsukhaṃ na kṛtaṃ tāta pitrośca nṛpamandire .
kṛtaṃ sukhaṃ tatparaṃ ca svargādapi sudurlabham .. 4 ..
4.89.d:
यत्सुखं न कृतं तात पित्रोश्च नृपमन्दिरे ।
कृतं सुखं तत्परं च स्वर्गादपि सुदुर्लभम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.89.m: The happiness that was not given to [my] parents in the king’s palace, father, / was given [to you] as supreme bliss, exceedingly rare even in heaven. .. 4 ..

4.89.s:
madīyaṃ priyavākyaṃ ca prahvatvaṃ vinayaṃ nayam .
parihāsaṃ bahataraṃ yaśodāṃ gopikāgaṇam .. 5 ..
4.89.d:
मदीयं प्रियवाक्यं च प्रह्वत्वं विनयं नयम् ।
परिहासं बहतरं यशोदां गोपिकागणम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.89.m: My affectionate speech, humility, modesty, right conduct, / and frequent jesting with Yaśodā, the group of gopīs, .. 5 ..

4.89.s:
bālakānāṃ samūhaṃ ca rādhāṃ cāpi viśeṣataḥ .
ekatra ca sthitaṃ teṣu bandhuvargeṣu karmaṇā .. 6 ..
4.89.d:
बालकानां समूहं च राधां चापि विशेषतः ।
एकत्र च स्थितं तेषु बन्धुवर्गेषु कर्मणा ॥ 6 ॥
4.89.m: the assembly of boys, and especially with Rādhā, / abiding together among those kinsfolk by the power of past deeds. .. 6 ..

4.89.s:
ihaivāpi sukhaṃ bhuktvā gaccha golokamuttamam .
sārdha yaśodayā tāta rohiṇyā gopikāgaṇaiḥ .. 7 ..
4.89.d:
इहैवापि सुखं भुक्त्वा गच्छ गोलोकमुत्तमम् ।
सार्ध यशोदया तात रोहिण्या गोपिकागणैः ॥ 7 ॥
4.89.m: Having enjoyed happiness right here, go to supreme Goloka / together with Yaśodā, father, Rohiṇī, and the hosts of gopīs. .. 7 ..

4.89.s:
gopānāṃ bālakaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛṣabhānena gopakaiḥ .
rādhāmātrā kalāvatyā rādhayā saha yāsyasi .. 8 ..
4.89.d:
गोपानां बालकैः सार्धं वृषभानेन गोपकैः ।
राधामात्रा कलावत्या राधया सह यास्यसि ॥ 8 ॥
4.89.m: Together with the boys of the cowherds, with Vṛṣabhānu and the cowherds, / with Rādhā's mother Kalāvatī, and with Rādhā, you will go. .. 8 ..

4.89.s:
rathānāṃ śatalakṣaṃ ca golokādāgataṃ pitaḥ .
amūlyaratnanirmāṇaṃ hīrahārapariṣkṛtam .. 9 ..
4.89.d:
रथानां शतलक्षं च गोलोकादागतं पितः ।
अमूल्यरत्ननिर्माणं हीरहारपरिष्कृतम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.89.m: A hundred hundred-thousand chariots have come from Goloka, father, / fashioned of priceless jewels and adorned with diamond necklaces, .. 9 ..

4.89.s:
maṇimāṇikyamuktānāṃ mālājālavibhūṣitam .
vahniśuddhāṃśukai ramyairācchannaṃ pītavarṇakaiḥ .. 10 ..
4.89.d:
मणिमाणिक्यमुक्तानां मालाजालविभूषितम् ।
वह्निशुद्धांशुकै रम्यैराच्छन्नं पीतवर्णकैः ॥ 10 ॥
4.89.m: decorated with nets of garlands of gems, rubies, and pearls, / and covered with charming garments purified by fire, yellow in color, .. 10 ..

4.89.s:
pārṣadapravarai ramyairveṣṭitaṃ śvetacāmaraiḥ .
sadratnadarpaṇai ramyairgopikābhiśca gopakaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.89.d:
पार्षदप्रवरै रम्यैर्वेष्टितं श्वेतचामरैः ।
सद्रत्नदर्पणै रम्यैर्गोपिकाभिश्च गोपकैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.89.m: surrounded by excellent attendants, charming with white chowries, / and surrounded by lovely mirrors of fine gems, by gopīs and cowherds. .. 11 ..

4.89.s:
veṣṭitaṃ ca tadāruhya kautukādyāsyasi dhruvam .
tyaktvā ca pārthivaṃ dehaṃ divyadehaṃ vidhāya ca .. 12 ..
4.89.d:
वेष्टितं च तदारुह्य कौतुकाद्यास्यसि ध्रुवम् ।
त्यक्त्वा च पार्थिवं देहं दिव्यदेहं विधाय च ॥ 12 ॥
4.89.m: Ascending that, you will surely go with delight, / abandoning the earthly body and assuming a divine body. .. 12 ..

4.89.s:
ayonisaṃbhavā rādhā rādhāmātā kalāvatī .
yāsyatyeva hi tenaiva nityadehena niścitam .. 13 ..
4.89.d:
अयोनिसंभवा राधा राधामाता कलावती ।
यास्यत्येव हि तेनैव नित्यदेहेन निश्चितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.89.m: Rādhā, not born of a womb, and Rādhā's mother Kalāvatī / will indeed go with that very eternal body, certainly. .. 13 ..

4.89.s:
pitṛṇāṃ mānasī kanyā dhanyā mānyā kalāvatī .
dhanyā ca sītāmātā ca durgāmātā ca menakā .. 14 ..
4.89.d:
पितृणां मानसी कन्या धन्या मान्या कलावती ।
धन्या च सीतामाता च दुर्गामाता च मेनका ॥ 14 ॥
4.89.m: The mind-born daughter of the ancestors, the blessed and venerable Kalāvatī; / blessed also is Sītā’s mother, and Durgā's mother Menakā. .. 14 ..

4.89.s:
ayonisaṃbhavā durgā tārā sītā ca sundarī .
ayonisaṃbhavāstāśca dhanyā menā kalāvatī .. 15 ..
4.89.d:
अयोनिसंभवा दुर्गा तारा सीता च सुन्दरी ।
अयोनिसंभवास्ताश्च धन्या मेना कलावती ॥ 15 ॥
4.89.m: Not born of a womb are Durgā, Tārā, and beautiful Sītā; / and those [mothers] who bore them without a womb—blessed Menā and Kalāvatī. .. 15 ..

4.89.s:
ityeva kathitaṃ tāta gopanīyaṃ sudurlabham .
varo'yaṃ tattastubhyaṃ ca mayā ca durgayā tathā .. 16 ..
4.89.d:
इत्येव कथितं तात गोपनीयं सुदुर्लभम् ।
वरोऽयं तत्तस्तुभ्यं च मया च दुर्गया तथा ॥ 16 ॥
4.89.m: Thus, father, has been told this secret, exceedingly rare; / this boon was given in truth to you both by me and by Durgā.” .. 16 ..

4.89.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca vrajeśvaraḥ .
punareva jagannāthaṃ ta dbhakto bhaktavātsalam .. 17 ..
4.89.d:
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच व्रजेश्वरः ।
पुनरेव जगन्नाथं त द्भक्तो भक्तवात्सलम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.89.m: Having heard Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s words, the lord of Vraja spoke back / once again to the Lord of the Universe, his devotee [speaking] to the one affectionate to devotees. .. 17 ..

4.89.s:
nanda uvāca
yugānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca yaṃ yaṃ dharma sanātanam .
krameṇa kṛṣṇa vistīrṇaṃ kṛtvā māṃ kathaya prabho .. 18 ..
4.89.d:
नन्द उवाच
युगानां च चतुर्णां च यं यं धर्म सनातनम् ।
क्रमेण कृष्ण विस्तीर्णं कृत्वा मां कथय प्रभो ॥ 18 ॥
4.89.m: Nanda said: / “Whichever eternal duty belongs to each of the four yugas, / tell me that at length in proper order, O Lord Kṛṣṇa! .. 18 ..

4.89.s:
kaliśeṣe bhavedyadyadguṇadoṣaṃ kalestathā .
kā gatirvā pṛthivyāśca dharmasya praṇināṃ tathā .. 19 ..
4.89.d:
कलिशेषे भवेद्यद्यद्गुणदोषं कलेस्तथा ।
का गतिर्वा पृथिव्याश्च धर्मस्य प्रणिनां तथा ॥ 19 ॥
4.89.m: Whatever virtue and fault of Kali will arise at the close of Kali, / and what will be the state of the earth, of dharma, and of living beings?” .. 19 ..

4.89.s:
nandasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hṛṣṭaḥ kamalalocanaḥ .
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe vicitrāṃ madhurānvitām .. 20 ..
4.89.d:
नन्दस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा हृष्टः कमललोचनः ।
कथां कथितुमारेभे विचित्रां मधुरान्विताम् ॥ 20 ॥
4.89.m: Having heard Nanda’s words, the lotus-eyed one rejoiced / and began to tell a wondrous and exceedingly sweet story. .. 20 ..

4.89.s:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇa janmakhao uttao nāradanāo bhagavanna-
ndasaṃo ekonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 89 ..
4.89.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्ण जन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ भगवन्न-
न्दसंओ एकोननवतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 89 ॥
4.89.m: Thus ends the eighty-ninth chapter, in the dialogue between the Lord and Nanda, in the Nārada-Nārāyaṇa [conversation], in the latter part of the Śrī-Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa, in the glorious Mahā-Brahmavaivarta. .. 89 ..
